- [ ] **Step 3: write `lib/scope-defaults.ts`:**
  ```ts
  // The progress items every new project starts with.
  //
  // Progress in Belin is computed, never estimated (lib/progress.ts). A project
  // with no scope items sits at 0 % forever and the crew form has nothing to
  // count, so no project is created without them. The three items, units and
  // weights are the demo seed's own (scripts/seed-demo.mjs). The names are in
  // the PROJECT's language because they print on that project's documents.

  export interface ScopeDraft {
    name: string;
    unit: string;
    targetQty: number;
    weight: number;
  }

  type Lang = "sl" | "de" | "en";

  const NAMES: Record<Lang, { substructure: string; modules: string; dc: string; piece: string }> = {
    sl: { substructure: "Podkonstrukcija", modules: "Moduli", dc: "DC kabliranje", piece: "kos" },
    de: { substructure: "Unterkonstruktion", modules: "Module", dc: "DC-Verkabelung", piece: "Stk." },
    en: { substructure: "Substructure", modules: "Modules", dc: "DC cabling", piece: "pcs" },
  };

  /** Metres of DC cable per module: the seed's portfolio ratio (modules * 2). */
  export const DC_METRES_PER_MODULE = 2;
  export const MAX_SCOPE_ITEMS = 30;

  export function defaultScopeItems(moduleCount: number | null, language: string): ScopeDraft[] {
    const lang: Lang = language === "de" || language === "en" ? language : "sl";
    const n = NAMES[lang];
    const modules =
      moduleCount !== null && Number.isFinite(moduleCount) && moduleCount > 0 ? Math.round(moduleCount) : 0;
    return [
      { name: n.substructure, unit: n.piece, targetQty: modules, weight: 2 },
      { name: n.modules, unit: n.piece, targetQty: modules, weight: 4 },
      { name: n.dc, unit: "m", targetQty: modules * DC_METRES_PER_MODULE, weight: 1 },
    ];
  }

  /** What the server accepts from the review screen, whatever the client sent. */
  export function cleanScope(items: unknown): ScopeDraft[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
    const out: ScopeDraft[] = [];
    for (const raw of items) {
      const item = (raw ?? {}) as Partial<ScopeDraft>;
      const name = typeof item.name === "string" ? item.name.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 120) : "";
      if (!name) continue;
      const unit = typeof item.unit === "string" && item.unit.trim() ? item.unit.trim().slice(0, 12) : "kos";
      const target = Number(item.targetQty);
      const weight = Number(item.weight);
      out.push({
        name,
        unit,
        targetQty: Number.isFinite(target) && target > 0 ? target : 0,
        weight: Number.isFinite(weight) && weight >= 0 ? weight : 1,
      });
      if (out.length === MAX_SCOPE_ITEMS) break;
    }
    return out;
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 5: write the migration** `supabase/migrations/20261006004500_project_scope_and_manual_plans.sql` (body = the Step 1 live body plus the marked additions):
  ```sql
  -- Every new project gets progress items, and a project can start without a
  -- plan file (demo-day plan 2026-10-06, Tasks 4.5a and 4.5b).
  --
  -- 1. create_project_from_review gains p_scope and writes scope_items in the
  --    same transaction as the project. Without them progress is 0 % forever
  --    (lib/progress.ts) and the crew form has nothing to count.
  -- 2. The old eight-argument signature is DROPPED first: "create or replace"
  --    with a new argument list adds an overload instead of replacing, which is
  --    the trap 20260812101000 removed once already.
  -- 3. p_roofs and p_scope default to null so the wizard that is live while this
  --    migration lands (it sends eight named arguments) resolves to the one
  --    function that exists instead of failing. lib/database.types.ts keeps both
  --    required, so no new caller can omit them.
  -- 4. plan_imports accepts source 'manual' (no file); its storage_path is '' and
  --    the project's plan_pdf_path stays null.
  -- 5. EXECUTE is revoked from public, anon and authenticated: a SECURITY
  --    DEFINER function that creates projects in any organization is a
  --    server-only tool (flows-correctness L3). A dropped and recreated function
  --    gets default grants again, so this must be repeated here.

  alter table public.plan_imports drop constraint if exists plan_imports_source_check;
  alter table public.plan_imports
    add constraint plan_imports_source_check check (source in ('k2_pdf', 'k2_xlsx', 'manual'));

  drop function if exists public.create_project_from_review(
    uuid, uuid, uuid, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, jsonb
  );

  create function public.create_project_from_review(
    p_import_id uuid,
    p_epc_org_id uuid,
    p_sub_org_id uuid,
    p_project jsonb,
    p_items jsonb,
    p_epc_token text,
    p_sub_token text,
    p_roofs jsonb default null,
    p_scope jsonb default null
  ) returns uuid
  language plpgsql
  security definer
  set search_path to 'public'
  as $function$
  declare
    v_project_id uuid;
    v_import record;
    v_item jsonb;
    v_idx integer := 0;
    v_roof jsonb;
    v_roof_idx integer := 0;
    v_scope jsonb;
    v_scope_idx integer := 0;
    v_country text;
    v_language text;
  begin
    v_country := lower(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_project->>'country'), ''), 'si'));
    if v_country not in ('de','at','si') then
      raise exception 'country must be de, at or si';
    end if;

    v_language := lower(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_project->>'language'), ''), 'sl'));
    if v_language not in ('sl','de','en') then
      raise exception 'language must be sl, de or en';
    end if;

    -- NEW: a bounded scope list. Nested, not one AND: SQL does not promise to
    -- evaluate AND left to right, and jsonb_array_length raises on a scalar.
    if p_scope is not null and jsonb_typeof(p_scope) = 'array' then
      if jsonb_array_length(p_scope) > 30 then
        raise exception 'too many scope items';
      end if;
    end if;

    select * into v_import from plan_imports where id = p_import_id for update;
    if not found then
      raise exception 'plan import not found';
    end if;
    if v_import.status <> 'review' or v_import.project_id is not null then
      raise exception 'plan import already committed';
    end if;

    if p_epc_org_id is null then
      raise exception 'epc org required';
    end if;

    if p_sub_org_id is not null then
      if not exists (select 1 from organizations where id = p_sub_org_id and type = 'sub') then
        raise exception 'sub org invalid';
      end if;
    end if;

    insert into projects (
      epc_org_id, sub_org_id, name, country, language,
      address_street, address_zip, address_city,
      kwp, module_count, module_type, mounting_system, roof_type,
      planned_start, planned_end, plan_pdf_path
    ) values (
      p_epc_org_id,
      p_sub_org_id,
      coalesce(nullif(trim(p_project->>'name'), ''), 'Nov projekt'),
      v_country,
      v_language,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_project->>'addressStreet', '')), ''),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_project->>'addressZip', '')), ''),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_project->>'addressCity', '')), ''),
      (p_project->>'kwp')::numeric,
      (p_project->>'moduleCount')::integer,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_project->>'moduleType', '')), ''),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_project->>'mountingSystem', '')), ''),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_project->>'roofType', '')), ''),
      (p_project->>'plannedStart')::date,
      (p_project->>'plannedEnd')::date,
      -- CHANGED: a manual project has no plan file.
      nullif(v_import.storage_path, '')
    ) returning id into v_project_id;

    insert into project_tokens (project_id, role, token, label)
    values (v_project_id, 'epc', p_epc_token, 'EPC');

    if p_sub_org_id is not null and p_sub_token is not null then
      insert into project_tokens (project_id, role, token, label)
      values (v_project_id, 'sub', p_sub_token, 'Podizvajalec');
    end if;

    if p_items is not null and jsonb_typeof(p_items) = 'array' then
      for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items) loop
        if coalesce(trim(v_item->>'name'), '') <> '' then
          insert into material_items (project_id, name, qty, unit, sort_order)
          values (
            v_project_id,
            trim(v_item->>'name'),
            coalesce((v_item->>'qty')::numeric, 0),
            coalesce(nullif(trim(coalesce(v_item->>'unit', '')), ''), 'kos'),
            v_idx
          );
          v_idx := v_idx + 1;
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    if p_roofs is not null and jsonb_typeof(p_roofs) = 'array' then
      for v_roof in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_roofs) loop
        if coalesce(trim(v_roof->>'name'), '') <> '' then
          insert into project_roofs (
            project_id, name, module_count, kwp, module_type, pitch_deg, covering, sort_order
          )
          values (
            v_project_id,
            trim(v_roof->>'name'),
            (v_roof->>'moduleCount')::integer,
            (v_roof->>'kwp')::numeric,
            nullif(trim(coalesce(v_roof->>'moduleType', '')), ''),
            (v_roof->>'pitchDeg')::numeric,
            nullif(trim(coalesce(v_roof->>'covering', '')), ''),
            v_roof_idx
          );
          v_roof_idx := v_roof_idx + 1;
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    -- NEW: the progress items, numbered from 1 like the seed's.
    if p_scope is not null and jsonb_typeof(p_scope) = 'array' then
      for v_scope in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_scope) loop
        if coalesce(trim(v_scope->>'name'), '') <> '' then
          v_scope_idx := v_scope_idx + 1;
          insert into scope_items (project_id, name, unit, target_qty, weight, sort_order)
          values (
            v_project_id,
            left(trim(v_scope->>'name'), 120),
            coalesce(nullif(trim(coalesce(v_scope->>'unit', '')), ''), 'kos'),
            greatest(coalesce((v_scope->>'targetQty')::numeric, 0), 0),
            greatest(coalesce((v_scope->>'weight')::numeric, 1), 0),
            v_scope_idx
          );
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    update plan_imports
      set project_id = v_project_id, status = 'committed'
      where id = p_import_id;

    return v_project_id;
  end;
  $function$;

  revoke execute on function public.create_project_from_review(
    uuid, uuid, uuid, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, jsonb, jsonb
  ) from public, anon, authenticated;
  grant execute on function public.create_project_from_review(
    uuid, uuid, uuid, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, jsonb, jsonb
  ) to service_role;
  ```

### Task 4.5c: Coordinates on every new project, for the weather (P0, lane D, 1.0 h)

**Why:** flows-correctness H5, spec-gaps SG-05: `lib/weather.ts:18` returns null without coordinates, `create_project_from_review` never sets `projects.lat/lng` and no geocoding exists, so "Vreme se pripne samo" (landing copy) is false for every customer project.

**Geocoder chosen: OpenStreetMap Nominatim, structured search on postcode, town and country only.** Read on 2026-10-05 (operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim): at most 1 request per second, a User-Agent that identifies the application, results must be cached, bulk geocoding discouraged, ODbL attribution required, commercial use allowed when geocoding is not the service's purpose. Belin geocodes once per project and stores the result in `projects.lat/lng` (that is the cache), which is well inside the policy. Open-Meteo's geocoding was rejected: its free API terms (open-meteo.com/en/terms, read 2026-10-05) allow non-commercial use only. Sending only postcode, town and country (no street, no name) keeps a private homeowner's address out of a third-party request and is plenty for weather, whose grid is kilometres wide. Verified live: `postalcode=4000&city=Kranj&countrycodes=si` returns 46.2433, 14.3549 (the seed has 46.2455, 14.3555); `postalcode=1100&city=Wien&countrycodes=at` returns the Wien centroid; postcode-only and town-only queries also answer.

**Debt to log (exists already, now written down):** the weather itself comes from Open-Meteo's free API (`lib/weather.ts:22-24`), whose terms forbid commercial use. Before a paying customer, subscribe to an Open-Meteo API plan (commercial host `customer-api.open-meteo.com` with an API key; price shown only at checkout, unverified) and add `OPEN_METEO_API_KEY`. Attribution (OSM ODbL, Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0) is in the Zasebnost text from Task 4.8 only.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/geocode-shared.ts` (pure), `lib/geocode.ts` (server-only), `lib/data/geo.ts` (server-only)
- Test: `tests/geocode-shared.test.ts`, `tests/geocode.test.ts`, `tests/geo.test.ts`
- Modify: `lib/data/plan-imports.ts` (`createProjectFromReview`, after the rpc result check, current line 248)
- Modify: `lib/data/reports.ts` lines 128-134 (the project select and the weather call inside `submitDailyReport`; Waves 1 and 3 may have moved them, anchor on `fetchWeatherSnapshot(`)

- `geocodePlace(input, opts?: { timeoutMs?: number; maxQueries?: number; spacingMs?: number }): Promise<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>`; never throws.
- `ensureProjectCoordinates(projectId: string, opts?): Promise<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>`: returns stored coordinates, or geocodes and stores them with a conditional update (`lat is null`).

  ```ts
  // Turning a site's postcode and town into coordinates for the weather, the
  // pure half. Only postcode, town and country ever leave Belin: never the
  // street, never a name. A homeowner's address is personal data; the weather
  // grid is kilometres wide and does not need it.

  export interface GeocodeInput {
    zip: string | null;
    city: string | null;
    country: string;
  }

  export interface LatLng {
    lat: number;
    lng: number;
  }

  const COUNTRIES = new Set(["si", "at", "de"]);

  export function nominatimQueries(input: GeocodeInput): string[] {
    const country = String(input.country ?? "").toLowerCase();
    if (!COUNTRIES.has(country)) return [];
    const zip = input.zip?.trim() || null;
    const city = input.city?.trim() || null;
    const base = { format: "jsonv2", limit: "1", countrycodes: country };

    const out: string[] = [];
    if (zip && city) out.push(new URLSearchParams({ ...base, postalcode: zip, city }).toString());
    if (zip) out.push(new URLSearchParams({ ...base, postalcode: zip }).toString());
    if (city) out.push(new URLSearchParams({ ...base, city }).toString());
    return out;
  }

  export function parseNominatim(json: unknown): LatLng | null {
    if (!Array.isArray(json) || json.length === 0) return null;
    const first = json[0] as { lat?: unknown; lon?: unknown };
    const lat = Number(first.lat);
    const lng = Number(first.lon);
    if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng)) return null;
    if (lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180) return null;
    return { lat: Math.round(lat * 1e5) / 1e5, lng: Math.round(lng * 1e5) / 1e5 };
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: `lib/geocode.ts`:**
  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { OPERATOR } from "@/lib/legal";
  import { nominatimQueries, parseNominatim, type GeocodeInput, type LatLng } from "@/lib/geocode-shared";

  // OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Usage policy (read 2026-10-05): at most one request
  // per second, an identifying User-Agent, cache the results. Belin asks once
  // per project and keeps the answer in projects.lat/lng, which is the cache.
  const ENDPOINT = "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search";
  const USER_AGENT = `Belin/1.0 (+https://getbelin.com; ${OPERATOR.email ?? "info@getbelin.com"})`;

  async function fetchOne(query: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<LatLng | null> {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${ENDPOINT}?${query}`, {
        headers: { "User-Agent": USER_AGENT, Accept: "application/json" },
        cache: "no-store",
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      return parseNominatim(await res.json());
    } catch {
      return null;
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  /** Most precise query first; never throws; at most one request per second. */
  export async function geocodePlace(
    input: GeocodeInput,
    opts: { timeoutMs?: number; maxQueries?: number; spacingMs?: number } = {},
  ): Promise<LatLng | null> {
    const queries = nominatimQueries(input).slice(0, opts.maxQueries ?? 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < queries.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, opts.spacingMs ?? 1100));
      const hit = await fetchOne(queries[i], opts.timeoutMs ?? 3000);
      if (hit) return hit;
    }
    return null;
  }
  ```
- [ ] **Step 4: `lib/data/geo.ts`:**
  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import { geocodePlace } from "@/lib/geocode";
  import type { LatLng } from "@/lib/geocode-shared";

  /**
   * The project's coordinates, finding and storing them the first time they are
   * needed. The write is conditional on lat still being null, so a seeded or
   * hand-corrected position is never overwritten by a guess.
   */
  export async function ensureProjectCoordinates(
    projectId: string,
    opts: { timeoutMs?: number; maxQueries?: number } = {},
  ): Promise<LatLng | null> {
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const { data } = await db
      .from("projects")
      .select("lat, lng, address_zip, address_city, country")
      .eq("id", projectId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!data) return null;
    if (data.lat !== null && data.lng !== null) return { lat: data.lat, lng: data.lng };

    const hit = await geocodePlace({ zip: data.address_zip, city: data.address_city, country: data.country }, opts);
    if (!hit) return null;
    await db.from("projects").update({ lat: hit.lat, lng: hit.lng }).eq("id", projectId).is("lat", null);
    return hit;
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  /**
   * Who may attach their EXISTING company to a project they were invited to.
   * The same people who would have created the company: the subcontractor's
   * office. A Bauleiter or a roofer must not be able to tie their employer to a
   * new client's project.
   */
  export function canAttachToInvite(orgType: OrgType, role: PersonRole, kind: InviteKind): boolean {
    return kind === "sub_company" && orgType === "sub" && (role === "admin" || role === "owner");
  }

  /** Login that comes back to the invitation afterwards. */
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: `lib/data/invites.ts`**, add `canAttachToInvite` to the import from `@/lib/invites-shared` (line 5) and insert before `ensureCrewLink`:
  ```ts
  export type AttachResult =
    | { ok: true; projectId: string }
    | { ok: false; reason: "invalid" | "alreadyLinked" | "forbidden" };

  /**
   * An existing subcontractor joins a project it was invited to, as itself.
   *
   * Never across the demo line: a demo company joins only a demo project and
   * a real company only a real one (organizations.is_demo, Task 2.1a).
   * Then the same two guards as a new company: the invite is claimed with one conditional
   * update (pending and unexpired in the WHERE clause), and the project slot is
   * filled only while it is still empty. If the slot was taken in between, the
   * invitation is handed back so the page can say so.
   */
  export async function attachOrgToInvite(actor: PersonActor, token: string): Promise<AttachResult> {
    const view = await loadInvite(token);
    if (!view || view.kind !== "sub_company" || !view.projectId) return { ok: false, reason: "invalid" };
    if (!canAttachToInvite(actor.orgType, actor.role as PersonRole, view.kind)) return { ok: false, reason: "forbidden" };
    if (view.alreadyLinked) return { ok: false, reason: "alreadyLinked" };

    const db = createAdminClient();

    // Demo and real never mix (D6). A demo company (organizations.is_demo) joins
    // only a demo EPC's project, and a real company never joins the demo. A demo
    // company on a customer's project would show that project to every Demo
    // Door persona and to every holder of the door key until 13.10, and tie it
    // to rows every reseed rewrites (the seed purges the demo org's sessions,
    // vault and people).
    const { data: target } = await db.from("projects").select("epc_org_id").eq("id", view.projectId).maybeSingle();
    if (!target) return { ok: false, reason: "invalid" };
    const { data: flags } = await db.from("organizations").select("id, is_demo").in("id", [actor.orgId, target.epc_org_id]);
    const mine = flags?.find((org) => org.id === actor.orgId);
    const theirs = flags?.find((org) => org.id === target.epc_org_id);
    if (!mine || !theirs || mine.is_demo !== theirs.is_demo) return { ok: false, reason: "forbidden" };

    const { data: claimed, error: claimError } = await db
      .from("invites")
      .update({ status: "accepted" })
      .eq("token", token)
      .eq("status", "pending")
      .gt("expires_at", new Date().toISOString())
      .select("id, project_id")
      .maybeSingle();
    if (claimError || !claimed?.project_id) return { ok: false, reason: "invalid" };

    const { data: linked } = await db
      .from("projects")
      .update({ sub_org_id: actor.orgId })
      .eq("id", claimed.project_id)
      .is("sub_org_id", null)
      .select("id")
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!linked) {
      await db.from("invites").update({ status: "pending" }).eq("id", claimed.id);
      return { ok: false, reason: "alreadyLinked" };
    }
    return { ok: true, projectId: claimed.project_id };
  }
  ```
  (`PersonRole` is already exported from `lib/invites-shared.ts`; add it to the import.)
- [ ] **Step 4: the action**, append to `app/[locale]/invite/[token]/actions.ts` (add imports `attachOrgToInvite` and `resolveActorFromSession` from `@/lib/auth`):
  ```ts
  export type AttachState = { error: "invalid" | "alreadyLinked" | "forbidden" | null };

  /** POST only, like accepting: the GET of an invitation never changes anything. */
  export async function attachInviteAction(_prev: AttachState, formData: FormData): Promise<AttachState> {
    const token = String(formData.get("token") ?? "");
    const locale = safeLocale(formData.get("locale"));
    if (!token) return { error: "invalid" };

    const actor = await resolveActorFromSession();
    if (!actor || actor.kind !== "person") return { error: "forbidden" };

    const result = await attachOrgToInvite(actor, token);
    if (!result.ok) return { error: result.reason };

    // redirect throws, so it stays outside any try/catch.
    redirect(`/${locale}/app/${result.projectId}`);
  }
  ```

Wave 5 turns the stylesheet into a system without changing the look (dark navy, gold, Inter) and removes every visible bug a buyer would see on the screens the meeting walks: tokens with measured contrast, one type scale, one button family, icons, toasts with undo, one app header, localized numbers, the portfolio, the EPC dashboard order, the subcontractor office home (P0) and the crew report screen (P0 layout fixes plus the 30 second report).

- **CSS:** only Task 5.1b edits existing rules in app/globals.css in place (Task 5.1a only appends). Every other Wave 5 task APPENDS one block at the end of the file, opened with `/* === 5.x: <title> === */`, and overrides by cascade. Two tasks appending at the same time conflict only at the end of the file: resolve by keeping both blocks.
- **Messages:** each task adds keys only in the namespace it names. New keys go into all three catalogs; de and en carry the Slovenian string as a placeholder. `tests/messages-parity.test.ts` FAILS on any Slovenian string left in de or en (test "carry no Slovenian left over in de or en") unless the key is in the translation-debt ledger of Task 1.4a (`tests/translation-debt/<task-id>.json`, full keys; the test also fails on a listed key that does not exist or is already translated). Every task that adds placeholder keys writes its own ledger file with the Wave 4 ledger command (w4.md, 'Rules that apply to every task in this wave'), run after the catalogs are edited, plus one CHANGELOG DEBT line naming the file. No Wave 5 task edits `tests/messages-parity.test.ts`. The command, from the repo root (arguments: the file name, then namespaces or exact keys; keys already listed in another ledger file are skipped, so a task's file holds only its own new keys):
  ```bash
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('messages/sl.json','utf8'));const flat=(o,p)=>Object.entries(o).flatMap(([k,v])=>v&&typeof v==='object'?flat(v,p+k+'.'):[p+k]);const dir='tests/translation-debt';const [file,...prefixes]=process.argv.slice(1);const taken=new Set(fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')&&f!==file).flatMap(f=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dir+'/'+f,'utf8'))));const keys=flat(m,'').filter(k=>prefixes.some(p=>k===p||k.startsWith(p+'.'))).filter(k=>!taken.has(k));fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/'+file,JSON.stringify(keys,null,2)+'\n');console.log(file,keys.length,'keys')" <file> <prefix or key> [...]
  ```
  Each task below names its exact invocation. An existing key whose MEANING changes gets real de and en text in the same task.
- **Shared database:** local dev and production use the same Supabase project. Never run `npm run seed`. Verification never submits a report, a material check, a decision or a status change on the demo projects unless a step says so and names the cleanup. The QA sign-in writes one `login_tokens` row per sign-in, which is what a magic-link request writes anyway.
- **Packages and worktrees:** Task 5.1a is the only package change of this wave. Stop a worktree's dev server before any `npm install` or `npm ci` in it (Windows EPERM trap, Wave 1 rules), and restart it afterwards with run_in_background. After merging or rebasing main into any worktree, if package-lock.json changed (`git diff --name-only ORIG_HEAD HEAD -- package-lock.json` prints it), stop that worktree's dev server, run `npm ci`, restart it. This applies to main after the 5.1a merge, to lane C after Gate 5, to the A2 track worktree and to every Wave 8 branch made in an old lane worktree (8.4 imports sonner). The same rule belongs in the index merge paragraph.
- **Ports:** scripts/qa/lib.mjs defaults `BASE` to http://localhost:3000, which is main. A check run in lane C sets `BASE=http://localhost:3002`, in the A2 worktree `BASE=http://localhost:3003`, in the same command; curl lines use the same port.
- **.next clash:** never run `npm run build` in a folder whose dev server is running. Use `git worktree add ../belin-build HEAD` for a production build check, or rely on the Vercel build of the pushed commit.
- **The in-app preview pane reports `document.hidden = true` permanently.** All visual verification here uses Playwright through `scripts/qa/lib.mjs` (created in 5.1a), never the preview pane. Every screenshot is opened with the Read tool and looked at.
- **No client-only signal decides a server render** (DECISIONS 2026-08-13). Platform detection, relative times and live state render nothing on the server and fill in after mount.
- **Commits:** conventional prefix, no em or en dashes. The executor appends its own attribution lines to every commit message, and every commit carries its CHANGELOG.md lines under `## 2026-10-06` in the same commit.

### Task 5.1: split into 5.1a and 5.1b (schedule review)

Task 5.1 is two tasks. **5.1a** lays the shared primitives every other Wave 5 task uses and changes nothing a buyer can see; it is P0 support and runs early, in lane C, so the two P0 screens (5.8, 5.10) never wait for the design pass. **5.1b** is the visible design pass (type scale, contrast, colour literals, the button family, focus, motion, tap targets): it rewrites 217 font sizes and many colour literals in place across every screen the founder has rehearsed, so it is P1, GREEN tier only, and merged only together with the Gate 5 screenshot sweep. Step numbers below are the original 5.1 numbers, kept so references stay valid; the old Step 9 (a PENDING_TRANSLATION list in the parity test) is deleted, because the Task 1.4a ledger is the only placeholder mechanism.

#### Task 5.1a: Shared primitives: libraries, Icon, EmptyState, Toaster, mapsUrl, new tokens, the QA helper (P0 support, lane C, 0.75 h)

**Why:** 5.8 (SubHome), 5.10 (crew layout) and every other Wave 5 task use `Icon`, `EmptyState`, `toast`, the `--fs-*` steps and the semantic colour tokens (`--e-warn`, `--e-danger`, `--e-on-gold`, `--e-line-strong`). A task that only adds them, and edits no existing rule, lets 5.8, 5.10 and 5.6 start before Gate 3 and keeps 5.1b off their critical path. It installs the two libraries once (decision D7), so package-lock.json changes once in this wave, and it creates the Playwright helper every Wave 5 verification uses.

**When and where:** lane C (`..\belin-lane-c`, port 3002), on its own branch `w5-primitives` (never on `lane-c`; Wave 5 intro), branched from main after Gate 1, so Task 1.3's Next upgrade is already in package-lock.json. The orchestrator merges it at Gate 2, right after lane B: rebase lane C on main first; if package-lock.json conflicts, take main's lock and rerun the Step 1 install to regenerate it; then, on main, stop the dev server, `npm ci`, restart. Every verification in lane C passes `BASE=http://localhost:3002` in the same command (scripts/qa/lib.mjs defaults to port 3000, which is main).

If npm resolves a higher minor, keep it and write the resolved versions in CHANGELOG. lucide-react 1.x ships `"use client"` in its icon modules and `sideEffects: false`; Next 15 optimizes `lucide-react` imports by default, so named imports are tree-shaken.

- [ ] **Step 2: create `components/ui/Icon.tsx`** (no "use client": it renders on the server inside server components and on the client inside client components; never pass `icon={X}` from a server file into a "use client" component as a prop, render `<Icon>` in the file that imports the glyph):
  ```tsx
  import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";

  // One way to draw an icon: 16 px, 1.75 stroke, hidden from assistive tech
  // unless it carries meaning on its own (then pass a label).
  export function Icon({
    icon: Glyph,
    size = 16,
    strokeWidth = 1.75,
    label,
    className,
  }: {
    icon: LucideIcon;
    size?: number;
    strokeWidth?: number;
    label?: string;
    className?: string;
  }) {
    return (
      <Glyph
        size={size}
        strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
        className={className ? `ui-icon ${className}` : "ui-icon"}
        aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
        aria-label={label}
        role={label ? "img" : undefined}
        focusable="false"
      />
    );
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: create `scripts/qa/lib.mjs`**, the sign-in and measuring helper every Wave 5 verification and Gate 5 use. Person ids are the seed's fixed ids (scripts/seed-demo.mjs lines 26, 27, 33), which Task 2.2 renames but does not change:
  ```js
  // Shared Playwright helpers for Wave 5 verification and the Gate 5 sweep.
  // Signs in exactly like a magic link: one login_tokens row, then the verify
  // page's confirm button. Never submits anything else.
  import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
  import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
  import path from "node:path";
  import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
  import { chromium } from "playwright";
  import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

  const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../..");
  function envValue(name) {
    if (process.env[name]) return process.env[name];
    const line = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, ".env.local"), "utf8")
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .find((l) => l.startsWith(`${name}=`));
    return line ? line.slice(name.length + 1).trim() : undefined;
  }

  export const BASE = (process.env.BASE ?? "http://localhost:3000").replace(/\/$/, "");
  export const TR = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333";
  export const D1 = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333334";
  export const PERSONAS = {
    epc: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666605",
    sub: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666603",
    crew: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666602",
  };
  export const VIEWPORTS = {
    w1440: { viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 },
    w390: { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true },
    w360: { viewport: { width: 360, height: 740 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true },
  };

  let client = null;
  export function db() {
    client ??= createClient(envValue("NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL"), envValue("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"), {
      auth: { persistSession: false },
    });
    return client;
  }

  export function launch() {
    return chromium.launch();
  }

  export async function signedInContext(browser, persona, vp) {
    const raw = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
    const { error } = await db().from("login_tokens").insert({
      person_id: PERSONAS[persona],
      token_hash: createHash("sha256").update(raw, "utf8").digest("hex"),
      expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60_000).toISOString(),
    });
    if (error) throw new Error(`login token for ${persona}: ${error.message}`);
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ ...VIEWPORTS[vp], locale: "sl-SI" });
    const page = await ctx.newPage();
    await page.goto(`${BASE}/sl/auth/verify/${raw}`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 90_000 });
    await page.getByRole("button").first().click();
    await page.waitForURL((u) => !u.pathname.includes("/auth/verify"), { timeout: 90_000 });
    await page.close();
    return ctx;
  }

  export async function settle(page) {
    await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle", { timeout: 20_000 }).catch(() => {});
    await page.waitForSelector("[data-splash]", { state: "detached", timeout: 8_000 }).catch(() => {});
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  }

  export async function measure(page, { phone }) {
    return page.evaluate((isPhone) => {
      const sel = 'a[href], button, input:not([type=hidden]), textarea, select, [role=button], [role=radio], [role=tab], summary';
      const small = [];
      if (isPhone) {
        for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) {
          const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
          if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0 || cs.visibility === "hidden" || cs.display === "none") continue;
          if (el.closest("nextjs-portal, [data-sonner-toaster], .lp-foot, .lg-doc")) continue;
          if (cs.display === "inline" && el.closest("p")) continue;
          if (r.width < 44 || r.height < 44) {
            const text = (el.getAttribute("aria-label") || el.innerText || el.value || "").toString().trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 30);
            small.push({ cls: String(el.className).slice(0, 40), text, w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height) });
          }
        }
      }
      const zeroBars = [...document.querySelectorAll(".sh-bar i, .e-sfill, .sb-fill")].filter(
        (el) => el.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0 && parseFloat(el.style.width || "0") > 0,
      ).length;
      const sizes = new Set();
      for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(".belin-dark *")) sizes.add(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize);
      return {
        url: location.pathname + location.search,
        title: document.title,
        innerWidth,
        scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
        overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth,
        hasHeader: Boolean(document.querySelector(".ah")),
        oldBar: Boolean(document.querySelector(".e-bar")),
        liveFixed: Boolean(document.querySelector(".e-live-fixed")),
        fontSizes: [...sizes].sort((a, b) => parseFloat(a) - parseFloat(b)),
        zeroBars,
        small,
      };
    }, phone);
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  import type { ReactNode } from "react";

  // An empty section says what will appear here and, where somebody can make it
  // appear, offers the action. A grey sentence alone reads as "broken".
  export function EmptyState({
    icon,
    title,
    body,
    action,
    compact = false,
  }: {
    icon: ReactNode;
    title: string;
    body?: string;
    action?: ReactNode;
    compact?: boolean;
  }) {
    return (
      <div className={compact ? "es es--compact" : "es"}>
        <span className="es-ic" aria-hidden>
          {icon}
        </span>
        <div className="es-t">{title}</div>
        {body ? <p className="es-b">{body}</p> : null}
        {action ? <div className="es-a">{action}</div> : null}
      </div>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  // One tap from an address to directions. Google's documented search URL
  // opens the Maps app on iOS and Android, and a browser elsewhere.
  export function mapsUrl(p: {
    street: string | null;
    zip: string | null;
    city: string | null;
    lat: number | null;
    lng: number | null;
  }): string | null {
    const base = "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=";
    if (p.lat != null && p.lng != null) return `${base}${p.lat},${p.lng}`;
    const query = [p.street, [p.zip, p.city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
    return query ? `${base}${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : null;
  }
  ```

  ```js
  import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
  const FILE = "C:/DevEnv/belin-app/app/globals.css";
  const STEP = { 9.5: 11, 10: 11, 10.5: 11, 11: 11, 11.5: 12, 12: 12, 12.5: 13, 13: 13, 13.5: 14, 14: 14, 14.5: 15, 15: 15,
    15.5: 16, 16: 16, 16.5: 16, 17: 18, 18: 18, 19: 20, 20: 20, 21: 20, 22: 20, 23: 20, 24: 24, 26: 24, 28: 28, 30: 30, 32: 30, 34: 30 };
  const SKIP = new Set([828, 831, 1104, 1113, 1117, 1163, 1175, 1180, 1199, 1200, 1251, 1263, 1265, 1266, 1277, 1281, 1292,
    1313, 1357, 1478, 2763, 2771, 2777, 2794, 2831, 2832, 2840, 2843, 2856, 2861]);
  const lines = readFileSync(FILE, "utf8").split("\n");
  if (!lines[805].startsWith("/* BELIN mobile crew utilities") || lines[2896] !== "}") {
    throw new Error("globals.css moved since 2026-10-05: re-derive the line list before rewriting");
  }
  let changed = 0;
  for (let i = 805; i < 2897; i++) {
    if (SKIP.has(i + 1)) continue;
    lines[i] = lines[i].replace(/font-size:\s*([0-9.]+)px/g, (_m, v) => {
      const step = STEP[Number(v)];
      if (step === undefined) throw new Error(`line ${i + 1}: no step for ${v}px`);
      changed++;
      return `font-size: var(--fs-${step})`;
    });
  }
  writeFileSync(FILE, lines.join("\n"));
  console.log(`rewrote ${changed}`);
  ```
  Run `node <scratchpad>/fs-rewrite.mjs`. Expected output: `rewrote 217`. Then `git diff --stat app/globals.css` shows only font-size changes. If the guard throws, another wave edited an existing rule against the shared-file rule: stop and tell the orchestrator.

  ```css
  /* Cards: a one-pixel top highlight so surfaces hold their edge on a projector. */

  .belin-dark :is(button, [role="button"], [role="radio"], [role="tab"], summary, label.np-switch):not(:disabled):not([aria-disabled="true"]) { cursor: pointer; }

    transition: transform .14s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow .14s, filter .14s;
  }

  }
  .belin-dark :is(.b-btn, .lp-submit, .mp-add-btn, .wz-primary, .pl-new, .sh-crew, .hr-submit, .cl-join):active:not(:disabled) {
    transform: translateY(1px); filter: brightness(.97);
  ```

### Task 5.3: Toasts (sonner) after every action, undo on approve (P1, lane A, 1.5 h)

**Why:** ux-standards H11 (silent `router.refresh()` after every action; the buyer clicks approve and nothing confirms it) and the idea "Undo toasts on approvals". Owns the NEW namespace `toast`, appended at the end of each catalog.

**Undo design, picked and justified:** the approval is DELAYED on the client for 5 seconds, not reverted on the server. `decideSheet` (lib/data/hours.ts:259-302) and `decideChangeOrder` emit `hours_decided` and `change_order_decided` immediately through `emitEventDeferred`, which writes the notification and sends the email; a server-side revert would arrive after the subcontractor was already told "approved". A revert would also need an `approved` to `submitted` transition that the conditional-update state machine forbids on purpose, and it could race the deemed-approval clock (`persistDeemed`, the daily cron of Task 1.8). The delay needs no schema change, no new transition and no retraction. Its cost is stated plainly: if the tab is CLOSED within the 5 seconds, the pending approval is fired on `pagehide` and the browser may cut that request; the sheet then simply stays submitted and is still protected by its deadline, which is the safe direction. In-app navigation does not lose it: unmounting fires it immediately. Rejection is not undoable: after Task 3.6 it requires a written reason, which is a deliberate act.

- [ ] **Step 2: `lib/undo-queue.ts`:**
  ```ts
  // A client-side delay that can be called off. Used to give a money decision
  // five seconds of "Razveljavi" before the server ever hears about it: the
  // server emits the notification the moment it decides, so an undo has to
  // happen BEFORE the call, not after it. Framework-free so vitest pins it.

  export const UNDO_MS = 5000;

  export interface UndoQueue {
    schedule(id: string, fire: () => void, delayMs?: number): void;
    cancel(id: string): boolean;
    flushAll(): void;
    has(id: string): boolean;
  }

  interface Timers {
    set(fn: () => void, ms: number): unknown;
    clear(handle: unknown): void;
  }

  const realTimers: Timers = {
    set: (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
    clear: (handle) => clearTimeout(handle as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>),
  };

  export function createUndoQueue(timers: Timers = realTimers): UndoQueue {
    const pending = new Map<string, { handle: unknown; fire: () => void }>();
    return {
      schedule(id, fire, delayMs = UNDO_MS) {
        const existing = pending.get(id);
        if (existing) timers.clear(existing.handle);
        const handle = timers.set(() => {
          pending.delete(id);
          fire();
        }, delayMs);
        pending.set(id, { handle, fire });
      },
      cancel(id) {
        const entry = pending.get(id);
        if (!entry) return false;
        timers.clear(entry.handle);
        pending.delete(id);
        return true;
      },
      flushAll() {
        for (const [id, entry] of [...pending]) {
          timers.clear(entry.handle);
          pending.delete(id);
          entry.fire();
        }
      },
      has(id) {
        return pending.has(id);
      },
    };
  }
  ```
  `npm test -- tests/undo-queue.test.ts`: 4 passed.

- [ ] **Step 3: `components/ui/useUndoQueue.ts`:**
  ```ts
  "use client";
  import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
  import { createUndoQueue, type UndoQueue } from "@/lib/undo-queue";

  // A pending approval is never silently dropped: leaving the screen or the
  // page fires it at once rather than forgetting it.
  export function useUndoQueue(): UndoQueue {
    const ref = useRef<UndoQueue | null>(null);
    if (ref.current === null) ref.current = createUndoQueue();
    useEffect(() => {
      const queue = ref.current!;
      const flush = () => queue.flushAll();
      window.addEventListener("pagehide", flush);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener("pagehide", flush);
        queue.flushAll();
      };
    }, []);
    return ref.current;
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  import { useEffect } from "react";
  import { toast } from "sonner";
  import { UNDO_MS } from "@/lib/undo-queue";
  import { useUndoQueue } from "@/components/ui/useUndoQueue";
  import { unwrap } from "@/lib/action-result"; // already imported by Task 1.5

  const tToast = useTranslations("toast");

        }

      duration: UNDO_MS,
      action: {
        label: tToast("undo"),
        onClick: () => {
          if (undo.cancel(sheet.id)) {
            dropApproving(sheet.id);
            toast(tToast("approveUndone"));

        },
      },
    });
  };
  ```

  ```ts
  // What the header says under the project, and whose initials sit in the
  // account button. Pure, so the rule is pinned rather than remembered.

  /** The EPC always sees its subcontractor; the subcontractor always sees the site. */
  export function headerMeta(
    role: "epc" | "sub",
    input: { subName: string | null; addressStreet: string | null; addressCity: string | null },
  ): string | null {
    if (role === "epc") return input.subName?.trim() || null;
    const parts = [input.addressStreet, input.addressCity].filter((p): p is string => Boolean(p && p.trim()));
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(", ") : null;
  }

  export function initials(name: string): string {
    const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 0) return "?";
    const first = parts[0][0] ?? "";
    const last = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[parts.length - 1][0] ?? "") : "";
    return (first + last).toUpperCase();
  }
  ```
  `lib/live-store.ts`:
  ```ts
  // Whether the project's realtime channel is up, shared between LiveRefresh
  // (which owns the channel) and the header badge (which shows it). A module
  // store rather than a second subscription: one channel per page is enough.
  // Only ever written from client effects; the server snapshot is always
  // "not subscribed", so the badge renders nothing during SSR and hydration.

  export interface LiveSnapshot {
    subscribed: boolean;
  }

  const SERVER: LiveSnapshot = { subscribed: false };
  let current: LiveSnapshot = SERVER;
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  export function setLiveSubscribed(subscribed: boolean): void {
    if (current.subscribed === subscribed) return;
    current = { subscribed };
    for (const listener of listeners) listener();
  }

  export function subscribeLive(listener: () => void): () => void {
    listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  export function getLiveSnapshot(): LiveSnapshot {
    return current;
  }

  export function getServerLiveSnapshot(): LiveSnapshot {
    return SERVER;
  }
  ```
  `npm test -- tests/header-meta.test.ts tests/live-store.test.ts`: all pass.

  ```ts
  /** The organization's display name for the account menu. */
  export async function getOrgName(orgId: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const { data, error } = await createAdminClient()
      .from("organizations")
      .select("name")
      .eq("id", orgId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error || !data) return null;
    return data.name;
  }
  ```
  `lib/data/page-title.ts`:
  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { cache } from "react";
  import type { Metadata } from "next";
  import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import { resolveActorFromSession } from "@/lib/auth";
  import { requireProjectActor } from "@/lib/actor";
  import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";

  // A tab title names the project only for someone who is a party to it: the
  // title is visible before the page renders, so it must not answer "which
  // project ids are real" for a stranger.
  export const projectNameForTitle = cache(async (projectId: string): Promise<string | null> => {
    if (!isUuid(projectId)) return null;
    const actor = await resolveActorFromSession();
    if (!actor) return null;
    try {
      await requireProjectActor(actor, projectId);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    const { data } = await createAdminClient().from("projects").select("name").eq("id", projectId).maybeSingle();
    return data?.name ?? null;
  });

  export async function projectMetadata(locale: string, projectId: string, section: string | null): Promise<Metadata> {
    const name = await projectNameForTitle(projectId);
    if (!name) {
      const t = await getTranslations({ locale, namespace: "app.title" });
      return { title: t("fallback") };
    }
    return { title: section ? `${name} · ${section}` : name };
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 4: the client pieces.** `components/app/LiveBadge.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  "use client";
  import { useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
  import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from "next-intl";
  import { getLiveSnapshot, getServerLiveSnapshot, subscribeLive } from "@/lib/live-store";

  // "v živo · posodobljeno pred 2 minutama": the time is when the server last
  // rendered this page, which is exactly when the data on screen was fetched.
  // A ping from the crew re-renders the page, so the phrase resets itself.
  export function LiveBadge({ renderedAt }: { renderedAt: string }) {
    const t = useTranslations("app.header");
    const tDash = useTranslations("dashboard");
    const format = useFormatter();
    const live = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeLive, getLiveSnapshot, getServerLiveSnapshot);
    const [now, setNow] = useState<number | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      setNow(Date.now());
      const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 30_000);
      return () => window.clearInterval(id);
    }, [renderedAt]);

    if (!live.subscribed) return null;

    const at = Date.parse(renderedAt);
    let when: string | null = null;
    if (now !== null) {
      const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.round((now - at) / 1000));
      when =
        seconds < 60
          ? t("updatedJustNow")
          : t("updated", { when: format.relativeTime(at, { now, unit: seconds < 3600 ? "minute" : "hour" }) });
    }

    return (
      <span className="ah-live" title={when ?? undefined}>
        <span className="e-live">{tDash("live")}</span>
        {when ? <span className="ah-live-t">{when}</span> : null}
      </span>
    );
  }
  ```
  `components/app/ProjectSwitcher.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  "use client";
  import Link from "next/link";
  import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
  import { Check, ChevronsUpDown } from "lucide-react";
  import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/Icon";

  export interface SwitcherProject {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    meta: string;
    href: string;
  }

  // The project name in the breadcrumb is also the way to every other project:
  // one click from Kranj to Ljubljana without going back to the list.
  export function ProjectSwitcher({
    currentId,
    currentName,
    projects,
    label,
  }: {
    currentId: string;
    currentName: string;
    projects: SwitcherProject[];
    label: string;
  }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!open) return;
      const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
      };
      const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
      };
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
        document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      };
    }, [open]);

    return (
      <div className="ah-switchwrap" ref={ref}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ah-switch"
          aria-haspopup="menu"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-label={`${label}: ${currentName}`}
          onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        >
          <span className="ah-current">{currentName}</span>
          <Icon icon={ChevronsUpDown} size={15} />
        </button>
        {open ? (
          <div className="ah-pop ah-pop--left" role="menu">
            {projects.map((p) => (
              <Link
                key={p.id}
                href={p.href}
                role="menuitem"
                className="ah-item"
                aria-current={p.id === currentId ? "page" : undefined}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              >
                <span className="ah-item-main">
                  <b>{p.name}</b>
                  <span className="ah-item-sub">{p.meta}</span>
                </span>
                {p.id === currentId ? <Icon icon={Check} size={16} /> : null}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  "use client";

  export function AccountMenu({
    locale,
    person,
    logout,
    labels,
  }: {
    locale: string;
    person: { name: string; initials: string; org: string | null; role: string; settingsHref: string | null } | null;
    logout: ((formData: FormData) => Promise<void>) | null;
    labels: { open: string; language: string; languageNav: string; settings: string; logout: string };
  }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!open) return;
      const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
      };
      const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
      };
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
        document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      };
    }, [open]);

    return (
      <div className="ah-acct" ref={ref}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ah-avatar"
          aria-haspopup="menu"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-label={labels.open}
          onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        >
          {person ? person.initials : <Icon icon={Languages} size={18} />}

            {person?.settingsHref ? (
              <Link href={person.settingsHref} className="ah-item" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                <Icon icon={Settings} size={16} />
                {labels.settings}

            ) : null}
            {logout ? (
              <form action={logout}>
                <input type="hidden" name="locale" value={locale} />
                <button type="submit" className="ah-item ah-logout" role="menuitem">
                  <Icon icon={LogOut} size={16} />
                  {labels.logout}
                </button>
              </form>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
  ```

  ```tsx
  import Link from "next/link";
  import { getLocale, getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
  import { Clock, FileCheck, FileText, LayoutDashboard, Plus } from "lucide-react";
  import { BelinMark } from "@/components/BelinMark";
  import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/Icon";
  import { NotificationBell } from "@/components/app/NotificationBell";
  import { ProjectSwitcher, type SwitcherProject } from "@/components/app/ProjectSwitcher";
  import { AccountMenu } from "@/components/app/AccountMenu";
  import { LiveBadge } from "@/components/app/LiveBadge";
  import { ProjectStatusControl } from "@/components/project/ProjectStatusControl";
  import { logoutAction } from "@/app/actions/auth";
  import { resolveActorFromSession } from "@/lib/auth";
  import { getUnreadCount } from "@/lib/data/notifications";
  import { listProjectsForPerson, type ProjectListRow } from "@/lib/data/projects-list";
  import { getOrgName } from "@/lib/data/orgs";
  import { initials } from "@/lib/header-meta";
  import type { ProjectStatus } from "@/lib/project-status";

  export type HeaderCrumb =
    | { kind: "portfolio" }
    | { kind: "settings" }
    | { kind: "new" }
    | { kind: "project"; projectId: string; projectName: string };

  export interface HeaderProject {
    projectId: string;
    status: ProjectStatus;
    role: "epc" | "sub";
    /** Null on a signed-in session; the link token otherwise. */
    token: string | null;
    meta: string | null;
    /** The office tab row. Off for the crew and for link surfaces. */
    officeNav: boolean;
    active?: "overview" | "po" | "hours" | "final";
  }

  // The crew picks between the sites they can work on today.
  const CREW_PICKABLE = new Set(["active", "draft"]);

  // ONE header for every signed-in screen: where am I, how do I get back, who
  // am I. Replaces five hand-built bars that disagreed with each other.
  export async function AppHeader({
    locale: localeProp,
    crumb,
    project,
  }: {
    locale?: string;
    crumb: HeaderCrumb;
    project?: HeaderProject;
  }) {
    const locale = localeProp ?? (await getLocale());
    const actor = await resolveActorFromSession();
    const person = actor?.kind === "person" ? actor : null;
    const isCrew = person?.role === "crew";
    const isOffice = person?.role === "admin" || person?.role === "owner";

    const [t, tNav, tProjects, tSettings, tAuth, tLanding] = await Promise.all([
      getTranslations("app.header"),
      getTranslations("nav"),
      getTranslations("projects"),
      getTranslations("settings"),
      getTranslations("auth"),
      getTranslations("landing"),
    ]);

    let unread = 0;
    let projects: ProjectListRow[] = [];
    let orgName: string | null = null;
    if (person) {
      [unread, projects, orgName] = await Promise.all([
        getUnreadCount(person),
        crumb.kind === "project" ? listProjectsForPerson(person) : Promise.resolve([] as ProjectListRow[]),
        getOrgName(person.orgId),
      ]);
    }

    const currentId = crumb.kind === "project" ? crumb.projectId : null;
    const switcher: SwitcherProject[] = projects
      .filter((p) => !isCrew || CREW_PICKABLE.has(p.status) || p.id === currentId)
      .map((p) => ({
        id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        meta: [p.city, tProjects(`status.${p.status}`)].filter(Boolean).join(" · "),
        href: `/${locale}/app/${p.id}`,
      }));

    const home = person ? `/${locale}/app` : null;
    const base = currentId ? `/${locale}/app/${currentId}` : "";
    const tabs =
      project?.officeNav && currentId
        ? ([
            { key: "overview", href: base, label: tNav("overview"), short: tNav("overview"), icon: LayoutDashboard },
            { key: "po", href: `${base}/po`, label: tNav("po"), short: tNav("po"), icon: FileText },
            { key: "hours", href: `${base}/hours`, label: tNav("hours"), short: tNav("hoursShort"), icon: Clock },
            { key: "final", href: `${base}/final`, label: tNav("final"), short: tNav("final"), icon: FileCheck },
          ] as const)
        : null;

    const brand = (
      <>
        <BelinMark />
        <span className="e-wm ah-wm">BELIN</span>
      </>
    );

    return (
      <header className="ah">
        <div className="ah-in">
          {home ? (
            <Link href={home} className="ah-home" aria-label={t("home")}>
              {brand}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <span className="ah-home">{brand}</span>
          )}

          <nav className="ah-crumbs" aria-label={t("breadcrumb")}>
            {crumb.kind === "portfolio" ? (
              <>
                <span className="ah-sep" aria-hidden>/</span>
                <span className="ah-current">{tProjects("title")}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                {home ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="ah-sep ah-root" aria-hidden>/</span>
                    <Link href={home} className="ah-crumb ah-root">
                      {tProjects("title")}
                    </Link>
                  </>
                ) : null}
                <span className="ah-sep" aria-hidden>/</span>
                {crumb.kind === "project" ? (
                  person && switcher.length > 1 ? (
                    <ProjectSwitcher
                      currentId={crumb.projectId}
                      currentName={crumb.projectName}
                      projects={switcher}
                      label={t("switchProject")}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span className="ah-current">{crumb.projectName}</span>
                  )
                ) : (
                  <span className="ah-current">{crumb.kind === "settings" ? tSettings("title") : tProjects("new")}</span>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </nav>

          <div className="ah-right">
            {project?.meta && !isCrew ? <span className="ah-meta">{project.meta}</span> : null}
            {project ? <LiveBadge renderedAt={new Date().toISOString()} /> : null}
            {project && !isCrew ? (
              <ProjectStatusControl
                token={project.token}
                projectId={project.projectId}
                role={project.role}
                status={project.status}
              />
            ) : null}
            {crumb.kind === "portfolio" && person?.orgType === "epc" && !isCrew ? (
              <Link href={`/${locale}/app/new`} className="pl-new ah-new" aria-label={tProjects("new")}>
                <Icon icon={Plus} size={16} />
                <span className="ah-new-t">{tProjects("new")}</span>
              </Link>
            ) : null}
            {person ? <NotificationBell initialUnread={unread} /> : null}
            <AccountMenu
              locale={locale}
              person={
                person
                  ? {
                      name: person.fullName,
                      initials: initials(person.fullName),
                      org: orgName,
                      role: t(`role.${person.role}`),
                      settingsHref: isOffice ? `/${locale}/app/settings` : null,
                    }
                  : null
              }
              logout={person ? logoutAction : null}
              labels={{
                open: t("account"),
                language: t("language"),
                languageNav: tLanding("languageLabel"),
                settings: tSettings("title"),
                logout: tAuth("logout"),
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {tabs ? (
          <nav className="e-nav ah-tabs" aria-label={t("sections")}>
            {tabs.map((tab) => (
              <Link
                key={tab.key}
                href={tab.href}
                className={`e-nav-l${project?.active === tab.key ? " on" : ""}`}
                aria-current={project?.active === tab.key ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <Icon icon={tab.icon} size={15} />
                <span className="full">{tab.label}</span>
                <span className="short">{tab.short}</span>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </nav>
        ) : null}
      </header>
    );
  }
  ```
  `new Date().toISOString()` here is a server value handed to the client as a prop, not a client signal, so SSR and hydration agree.

### Task 5.5: Localized numbers and dates on every screen; one tempo (P1, lane A, 1.5 h)

**Why:** ux-standards H6, epc-walk H1 and H2, I18N-14, I18N-19, SG-20: "245.7 kWp", "58.3 %", "5.9" next to "6,5", ISO dates in the vault, DD.MM without a year on a certificate's validity, and two different tempo numbers on the hero. Consumes `lib/format.ts` from Task 1.11. Owns the `dashboard` key `tempoSub`. Sites owned by other Wave 5 tasks are excluded here and done there: portfolio (5.6), SubHome (5.8), CrewHome and CrewReportForm (5.9), MaterialCheck (5.10); the suggested PO line in `po/page.tsx:55` belongs to Task 3.7; `app/[locale]/app/projects/page.tsx:64` is deleted by 5.4.

**The tempo decision:** ONE definition, the projection's `ratePctPerDay` (lib/projection-shared.ts:77-93): the cumulative gain over the last up to six reported days divided by the working days between them. It is the number the projected finish date and the buffer badge are computed from, so the chip, the stat tile and the chart headline now all show it, labelled "povprečje zadnjih 6 poročil". The chart's own mean of all daily gains (TempoChart.tsx:100, 115) is removed from the headline; the curve still draws each day's gain, and scrubbing still shows that day's value with its date.

**Interfaces (consumed from Task 1.11; these are its real signatures, read in w1.md):**
- `fmtNumber(value: number, locale: string, options?: { decimals?: number; maxDecimals?: number }): string` (grouping always on; `decimals` fixes both minimum and maximum; `maxDecimals` defaults to 2)
- `fmtKwp(kwp: number, locale: string): string` ("245,7\u00a0kWp", a no-break space before the unit)
- `fmtPct(percent: number, locale: string, decimals?: number): string` (percent is 0 to 100; `decimals` defaults to 0: "58\u00a0%", with 1 "58,3\u00a0%")
- `fmtDate(value: string | Date, locale: string, options?: { style?: "short" | "long"; timeZone?: string }): string` (a `yyyy-mm-dd` string is a calendar day, formatted in UTC; a timestamp is shown in `timeZone`, default `Europe/Ljubljana`; sl "6. 10. 2026", de "06.10.2026", en "06/10/2026"). Task 5.1a Step 12a adds the style `"dayMonth"` (sl "5. 10.", de "05.10.", en "05/10").
- `fmtDateTime(value, locale, timeZone?)`, `asAppLocale`, `AppLocale`, `DEFAULT_ZONE` (unchanged).

If it prints nothing, add it now exactly as 5.1a Step 12a says, test first. Never change an existing signature of lib/format.ts (Waves 3 and 6 and the PDFs call them). ### Task 5.8: SubHome rebuilt with real "Čaka na vas" data (P0, lane A, 2.0 h)

**Why:** crew-walk H1 and H2, ux-standards H4, findings 14. Confirmed live on 2026-10-05 (recon/crew-sub-live/shots/p390-sub-tr-home-full.png): the card labels "Napredek projekta" and "Manki pri materialu" sit outside their cards, piled at the bottom left, because `SubHome.tsx` uses `.e-proj-lab`, the chart's absolutely positioned axis label (globals.css:978); the four "Čaka na vas" cards are hard-coded empty states, so the office reads "Naročilnice še ni." on a project whose naročilnica waits for its signature, and "Nadgradnje" for dodatna dela. Runs second in track A1 (after 5.10), in lane C as soon as Task 5.1a is merged and Wave 3's 3.4 is committed on main (Wave 5 intro; it needs neither 5.1b nor Gate 3). Owns namespace `sub`. The "Dnevno poročanje" button is Task 2.5's: keep its href and its gate exactly as 2.5 left them.

**What the data layer already exposes (read 2026-10-05):** `getCrewHome` gives status, country, progress, today's posts (lib/data/reports.ts:16-28). `getPoPageData` loads the latest PO with dates but needs a person actor and signs a PDF URL (too heavy here). `listSheets` and `listChangeOrders` load full rows with names and signed photo URLs (too heavy). `getAcceptance` signs defect photos. The portfolio loader counts only open sheets. None gives the four cards cheaply, so this task adds ONE loader with six small parallel queries and a PURE shaping function that holds every rule.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/sub-home-shared.ts`, `lib/data/sub-home.ts`, `tests/sub-home-shared.test.ts`.
- Modify: `components/sub/SubHome.tsx` (whole file), `app/[locale]/app/[projectId]/page.tsx:52-79` (sub office branch), `messages/{sl,de,en}.json` (`sub`), `app/globals.css` (append 5.8 block). Create: `tests/translation-debt/5.8-sub.json` (the ledger, Step 6).

**Interfaces:**
- `summarizeSubWaiting(input: SubWaitingInput, now: Date): SubWaiting` (pure). Types below.
- `getSubWaiting(project: ProjectActor, home: CrewHomeData, isOffice: boolean): Promise<SubWaiting>` (server; throws on a query error so the error boundary of Task 1.4 shows it, instead of a false "nothing is waiting").
- `SubHome` props become `{ locale, projectId, data, material, crewToken, crewLinkUrl: string | null, waiting: SubWaiting }` plus whatever Task 2.5 added for the report button.
- Tables read: `purchase_orders (number, status, sent_at, accepted_at, rejected_at)`, `hour_sheets (number, status, deadline_at, hour_sheet_lines (hours))`, `change_orders (number, status, amount)`, `activity (created_at) where kind = 'finalization_requested'`, `acceptances (kind, status, conducted_at)`, `invoices (number, issue_date)`.
- Deep links: PO `/{locale}/app/{projectId}/po`, hours `/hours`, dodatna dela `/hours?tab=co` (already handled at hours/page.tsx:25), zaključek `/final`.

**Card rules (the tone decides the gold "Vaš korak" state):**

| Card | State | Tone |
|---|---|---|
| Naročilnica | none or draft (the EPC is still writing it) | idle |
| | sent | action for an office person (admin, owner), waiting for others |
| | accepted | ok |
| | rejected (EPC must revise) | waiting |
| | cancelled | idle |
| Režijske ure (deemed approval applied through `effectiveStatus`) | at least one draft | action |
| | else at least one submitted, with the nearest countdown (`workingDaysLeft`) | waiting |
| | else approved or deemed hours exist | ok |
| | else | idle |
| Dodatna dela | at least one submitted | waiting |
| | else at least one approved (with the approved total in EUR and the count without an amount) | ok |
| | else | idle |
| Zaključek | project finished | ok |
| | invoice exists | ok |
| | final acceptance signed, no invoice | action for office, waiting otherwise |
| | final acceptance in draft | waiting |
| | handover requested | waiting |
| | progress at 100 and status active | action for office, waiting otherwise |
| | else | idle |

  ```ts
  // What is waiting on the subcontractor's office, and whose move it is. Pure,
  // so every state the "Čaka na vas" cards can be in is pinned by a test
  // rather than discovered on stage.
  import { effectiveStatus, workingDaysLeft, type Country, type SheetStatus } from "@/lib/hours-shared";
  import type { ProjectStatus } from "@/lib/project-status";

  export type CardTone = "action" | "waiting" | "ok" | "idle";

  export interface SubWaitingInput {
    po: { number: number; status: string; sentAt: string | null; acceptedAt: string | null; rejectedAt: string | null } | null;
    sheets: { number: number; status: SheetStatus; deadlineAt: string | null; hours: number }[];
    orders: { number: number; status: string; amount: number | null }[];
    projectStatus: ProjectStatus;
    progressPercent: number;
    finalizationRequestedAt: string | null;
    acceptance: { kind: "final" | "partial"; status: "draft" | "signed"; conductedAt: string | null } | null;
    invoice: { number: string; issueDate: string } | null;
    /** Admin or owner: the people who may accept a naročilnica and issue the invoice. */
    isOffice: boolean;
    country: Country;
  }

  export type PoState = "none" | "sent" | "accepted" | "rejected" | "cancelled";
  export interface PoCard { tone: CardTone; state: PoState; number: number | null; date: string | null }
  export interface HoursCard {
    tone: CardTone;
    drafts: number;
    awaiting: number;
    rejected: number;
    approvedHours: number;
    nearestDaysLeft: number | null;
  }
  export interface CoCard { tone: CardTone; submitted: number; approved: number; rejected: number; approvedAmount: number; unpriced: number }
  export type FinalState = "running" | "ready" | "requested" | "acceptanceOpen" | "accepted" | "invoiced" | "finished";
  export interface FinalCard { tone: CardTone; state: FinalState; date: string | null; invoiceNumber: string | null }
  export interface SubWaiting { po: PoCard; hours: HoursCard; co: CoCard; final: FinalCard; actionCount: number }

  export function summarizeSubWaiting(input: SubWaitingInput, now: Date): SubWaiting {
    const po = poCard(input);
    const hours = hoursCard(input, now);
    const co = coCard(input);
    const final = finalCard(input);
    const actionCount = [po, hours, co, final].filter((card) => card.tone === "action").length;
    return { po, hours, co, final, actionCount };
  }

  function poCard({ po, isOffice }: SubWaitingInput): PoCard {
    if (!po || po.status === "draft") return { tone: "idle", state: "none", number: null, date: null };
    if (po.status === "sent") return { tone: isOffice ? "action" : "waiting", state: "sent", number: po.number, date: po.sentAt };
    if (po.status === "accepted") return { tone: "ok", state: "accepted", number: po.number, date: po.acceptedAt };
    if (po.status === "rejected") return { tone: "waiting", state: "rejected", number: po.number, date: po.rejectedAt };
    return { tone: "idle", state: "cancelled", number: po.number, date: null };
  }

  function hoursCard({ sheets, country }: SubWaitingInput, now: Date): HoursCard {
    let drafts = 0;
    let awaiting = 0;
    let rejected = 0;
    let approvedHours = 0;
    let nearestDaysLeft: number | null = null;
    for (const sheet of sheets) {
      const status = effectiveStatus({ status: sheet.status, deadline_at: sheet.deadlineAt }, now);
      if (status === "draft") drafts++;
      else if (status === "submitted") {
        awaiting++;
        if (sheet.deadlineAt) {
          const left = workingDaysLeft(sheet.deadlineAt.slice(0, 10), now, country);
          nearestDaysLeft = nearestDaysLeft === null ? left : Math.min(nearestDaysLeft, left);
        }
      } else if (status === "rejected") rejected++;
      else approvedHours += sheet.hours;
    }
    const tone: CardTone = drafts > 0 ? "action" : awaiting > 0 ? "waiting" : approvedHours > 0 ? "ok" : "idle";
    return { tone, drafts, awaiting, rejected, approvedHours, nearestDaysLeft };
  }

  function coCard({ orders }: SubWaitingInput): CoCard {
    let submitted = 0;
    let approved = 0;
    let rejected = 0;
    let approvedAmount = 0;
    let unpriced = 0;
    for (const order of orders) {
      if (order.status === "submitted") submitted++;
      else if (order.status === "approved") {
        approved++;
        if (order.amount === null) unpriced++;
        else approvedAmount += order.amount;
      } else if (order.status === "rejected") rejected++;
    }
    const tone: CardTone = submitted > 0 ? "waiting" : approved > 0 ? "ok" : "idle";
    return { tone, submitted, approved, rejected, approvedAmount, unpriced };
  }

  function finalCard(input: SubWaitingInput): FinalCard {
    const none = { date: null, invoiceNumber: null };
    if (input.projectStatus === "finished") return { tone: "ok", state: "finished", ...none, invoiceNumber: input.invoice?.number ?? null };
    if (input.invoice) return { tone: "ok", state: "invoiced", date: input.invoice.issueDate, invoiceNumber: input.invoice.number };
    const final = input.acceptance?.kind === "final" ? input.acceptance : null;
    if (final?.status === "signed") return { tone: input.isOffice ? "action" : "waiting", state: "accepted", date: final.conductedAt, invoiceNumber: null };
    if (final?.status === "draft") return { tone: "waiting", state: "acceptanceOpen", ...none };
    if (input.finalizationRequestedAt) return { tone: "waiting", state: "requested", date: input.finalizationRequestedAt, invoiceNumber: null };
    if (input.progressPercent >= 100 && input.projectStatus === "active") {
      return { tone: input.isOffice ? "action" : "waiting", state: "ready", ...none };
    }
    return { tone: "idle", state: "running", ...none };
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import type { ProjectActor } from "@/lib/actor";
  import type { CrewHomeData } from "@/lib/data/reports";
  import type { Country, SheetStatus } from "@/lib/hours-shared";
  import { summarizeSubWaiting, type SubWaiting } from "@/lib/sub-home-shared";

  // Six small reads in parallel, shaped by the pure rules in sub-home-shared.
  // A failed read THROWS: a card that says "nothing is waiting" because the
  // database hiccuped is the exact lie this screen used to tell.
  export async function getSubWaiting(project: ProjectActor, home: CrewHomeData, isOffice: boolean): Promise<SubWaiting> {
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const id = project.projectId;
    const [poRes, sheetRes, coRes, requestedRes, acceptanceRes, invoiceRes] = await Promise.all([
      db.from("purchase_orders").select("number, status, sent_at, accepted_at, rejected_at").eq("project_id", id)
        .order("number", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("hour_sheets").select("number, status, deadline_at, hour_sheet_lines (hours)").eq("project_id", id),
      db.from("change_orders").select("number, status, amount").eq("project_id", id),
      db.from("activity").select("created_at").eq("project_id", id).eq("kind", "finalization_requested")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("acceptances").select("kind, status, conducted_at").eq("project_id", id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("invoices").select("number, issue_date").eq("project_id", id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
    ]);
    for (const res of [poRes, sheetRes, coRes, requestedRes, acceptanceRes, invoiceRes]) {
      if (res.error) throw new Error(`sub-home: ${res.error.message}`);
    }

    const country: Country = home.country === "de" || home.country === "at" ? home.country : "si";
    return summarizeSubWaiting(
      {
        po: poRes.data
          ? {
              number: poRes.data.number,
              status: poRes.data.status,
              sentAt: poRes.data.sent_at,
              acceptedAt: poRes.data.accepted_at,
              rejectedAt: poRes.data.rejected_at,
            }
          : null,
        sheets: (sheetRes.data ?? []).map((sheet) => ({
          number: sheet.number,
          status: sheet.status as SheetStatus,
          deadlineAt: sheet.deadline_at,
          hours: (sheet.hour_sheet_lines ?? []).reduce((sum, line) => sum + Number(line.hours), 0),
        })),
        orders: (coRes.data ?? []).map((order) => ({
          number: order.number,
          status: order.status,
          amount: order.amount === null ? null : Number(order.amount),
        })),
        projectStatus: home.status,
        progressPercent: home.progressPercent,
        finalizationRequestedAt: requestedRes.data?.created_at ?? null,
        acceptance: acceptanceRes.data
          ? {
              kind: acceptanceRes.data.kind === "partial" ? "partial" : "final",
              status: acceptanceRes.data.status === "signed" ? "signed" : "draft",
              conductedAt: acceptanceRes.data.conducted_at,
            }
          : null,
        invoice: invoiceRes.data ? { number: invoiceRes.data.number, issueDate: invoiceRes.data.issue_date } : null,
        isOffice,
        country,
      },
      new Date(),
    );
  }
  ```
