```tsx
// The naročilnica: the document that turns a project into a priced job.
//
// It is the first thing in Belin that carries money and the first that either
// side would ever put in front of a lawyer. The sha256 of the SENT bytes is what
// the acceptance binds to (Task 3.7). The sent document cannot print its own
// hash; the accepted copy prints it in its acceptance certificate. The accepted
// copy is rendered again from the rows at acceptance, so it is a faithful
// record, not the binding document: the certificate says so, and names the
// fingerprint of the sent version a reader can check.
//
// THE ORDER TERMS (D9, DECISIONS 2026-10-06): the six-day deemed approval of
// hour sheets has no statute behind it in Slovenia, so it is printed here as a
// contract term the subcontractor accepts, together with one line naming the
// rules that fill every gap, chosen by the SITE's country.
//
// Strings arrive as a plain object rather than through next-intl, because
// @react-pdf components render outside React's normal tree and cannot call
// hooks. The caller resolves them in the PROJECT's language, not the reader's.

import { Document, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import {
  C,
  FlexTable,
  Footer,
  Header,
  LabelValue,
  RunningHeader,
  styles,
  type DocIssuer,
} from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/po-shared";
import { docNumber } from "@/lib/pdf/doc-format";

export interface NarocilnicaParty {
  name: string;
  address: string | null;
  vatId: string | null;
}

export interface NarocilnicaLine {
  description: string;
  qty: number | null;
  unit: string | null;
  unitPrice: number | null;
  total: number;
}

export interface NarocilnicaStrings {
  title: string;
  docNo: string;
  orderer: string;
  contractor: string;
  vatId: string;
  site: string;
  date: string;
  deadline: string;
  paymentTerms: string;
  regieRate: string;
  colDescription: string;
  colQty: string;
  colUnitPrice: string;
  colTotal: string;
  totalNet: string;
  acceptanceTitle: string;
  acceptanceBody: string;
  acceptedBy: string;
  acceptedAt: string;
  hashLabel: string;
  generated: string;
  perHour: string;
  termsTitle: string;
  regieClause: string;
  /** The contract-basis line for the SITE's country, already chosen. */
  basis: string;
  acceptedTitle: string;
  acceptedBody: string;
  acceptedHash: string;
  page: string;
}

export interface NarocilnicaInput {
  number: number;
  locale: "sl" | "de" | "en";
  projectName: string;
  siteAddress: string | null;
  issuedOn: string;
  deadline: string | null;
  paymentTerms: string | null;
  regieHourlyRate: number | null;
  totalNet: number;
  lines: NarocilnicaLine[];
  epcOrg: NarocilnicaParty;
  subOrg: NarocilnicaParty;
  /**
   * Present only on the ACCEPTED COPY (Task 3.7's contract, unchanged): who
   * accepted and when, already formatted in the site's zone. The version sent
   * for review has none, and that difference is deliberate: the hash the
   * acceptance binds to is the hash of the UNACCEPTED document.
   */
  acceptance?: { name: string; at: string } | null;
  /** purchase_orders.pdf_sha256: the hash of the SENT file (Task 3.7's meaning, unchanged). */
  sha256?: string | null;
  /** The EPC: the orderer issues the naročilnica. */
  issuer: DocIssuer;
  s: NarocilnicaStrings;
}

export function NarocilnicaDocument(input: NarocilnicaInput) {
  const { s, locale } = input;
  const money = (n: number) => formatMoney(n, locale);
  const docNo = `${s.docNo} ${input.number}`;

  return (
    <Document title={`${s.title} ${input.number}, ${input.projectName}`}>
      <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
        <RunningHeader title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} />
        <Header title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} issuer={input.issuer} />

        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <View style={{ width: "48%" }}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.orderer}</Text>
            <Text>{input.epcOrg.name}</Text>
            {input.epcOrg.address ? <Text style={{ color: C.inkSoft }}>{input.epcOrg.address}</Text> : null}
            {input.epcOrg.vatId ? (
              <Text style={{ color: C.inkSoft }}>{`${s.vatId}: ${input.epcOrg.vatId}`}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
          <View style={{ width: "48%" }}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.contractor}</Text>
            <Text>{input.subOrg.name}</Text>
            {input.subOrg.address ? <Text style={{ color: C.inkSoft }}>{input.subOrg.address}</Text> : null}
            {input.subOrg.vatId ? (
              <Text style={{ color: C.inkSoft }}>{`${s.vatId}: ${input.subOrg.vatId}`}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <LabelValue label={s.site} value={input.siteAddress ?? ""} />
          <LabelValue label={s.date} value={input.issuedOn} />
          {input.deadline ? <LabelValue label={s.deadline} value={input.deadline} /> : null}
          {input.paymentTerms ? <LabelValue label={s.paymentTerms} value={input.paymentTerms} /> : null}
          {input.regieHourlyRate !== null ? (
            <LabelValue label={s.regieRate} value={`${money(input.regieHourlyRate)} ${s.perHour}`} />
          ) : null}
        </View>

        <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <FlexTable
            columns={[
              { label: s.colDescription, widthPct: 52 },
              { label: s.colQty, widthPct: 16, align: "right" },
              { label: s.colUnitPrice, widthPct: 16, align: "right" },
              { label: s.colTotal, widthPct: 16, align: "right" },
            ]}
            rows={input.lines.map((line) => [
              line.description,
              line.qty === null ? "" : `${docNumber(line.qty, locale)}${line.unit ? ` ${line.unit}` : ""}`,
              line.unitPrice === null ? "" : money(line.unitPrice),
              money(line.total),
            ])}
          />
        </View>

        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
            marginTop: 10,
            paddingTop: 8,
            borderTopWidth: 1,
            borderTopColor: C.ink,
          }}
          wrap={false}
        >
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{`${s.totalNet}: ${money(input.totalNet)}`}</Text>
        </View>

        {/* The order terms: what the subcontractor accepts besides the price. */}
        <View style={{ marginTop: 18 }} wrap={false}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.termsTitle}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.body}>{s.regieClause}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.body, { marginTop: 4 }]}>{s.basis}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={{ marginTop: 18 }} wrap={false}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.acceptanceTitle}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.body, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{s.acceptanceBody}</Text>

          {/* The certificate needs both: who and when, AND the bound hash. */}
          {input.acceptance && input.sha256 ? (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 10, padding: 10, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: C.ink }}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4 }}>{s.acceptedTitle}</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.body, { marginBottom: 6 }]}>{s.acceptedBody}</Text>
              <LabelValue label={s.acceptedBy} value={input.acceptance.name} />
              <LabelValue label={s.acceptedAt} value={input.acceptance.at} />
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 7, color: C.muted, marginTop: 4 }}>
                {`${s.acceptedHash}: ${input.sha256}`}
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        <Footer generatedLabel={s.generated} pageLabel={s.page} />
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}
```

```js
// Task 6.4 anchor edits: the certificate's labels and the acceptance moment in the document words.
const fs = require("fs");
function edit(file, pairs) {
  let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  for (const [a, b] of pairs) {
    // Idempotent: a pair already applied (its replacement is present) is skipped,
    // so a rerun after a hand fix never duplicates an import.
    if (s.includes(b)) continue;
    if (!s.includes(a)) throw new Error(`${file}: miss ${a.slice(0, 90)}`);
    s = s.split(a).join(b);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, s);
  console.log("edited", file);
}
```

- [ ] `lib/pdf/regiebericht.tsx`, three-way (base `git show e89f2de:lib/pdf/regiebericht.tsx`, new = the version below, `git merge-file`), keeping Task 3.6's `rejectionReason` string and input field (this version carries them too, so they merge):
```tsx
// The Poročilo o režijskih urah: one hour sheet as a document.
//
// This is what gets attached to an email when somebody disputes an invoice
// line months later, so it prints the things a dispute turns on: which days,
// how many hours, what the work was, what it costs at the agreed rate, when it
// was submitted, by when the client had to answer, and HOW it was decided.
// That last one matters most. A sheet approved by silence carries a different
// sentence from one somebody actually approved, and pretending they are the
// same would misrepresent the record.
//
// The rate comes from the ACCEPTED naročilnica only. A draft or a sent order
// is an offer, not an agreed price, so without an accepted one the amount
// column is left out rather than filled with a number nobody agreed to.

import { Document, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import {
  C,
  FlexTable,
  Footer,
  Header,
  LabelValue,
  RunningHeader,
  styles,
  type DocIssuer,
} from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

export interface RegieberichtStrings {
  title: string;
  docNo: string;
  project: string;
  contractor: string;
  submitted: string;
  status: string;
  decidedBy: string;
  colDate: string;
  colPerson: string;
  colHours: string;
  colDescription: string;
  totalHours: string;
  deemedNote: string;
  generated: string;
  hoursUnit: string;
  rate: string;
  noRate: string;
  colAmount: string;
  totalAmount: string;
  confirmTitle: string;
  approvedBy: string;
  rejectedBy: string;
  deemedAt: string;
  pending: string;
  /** Task 3.6's label, "Razlog zavrnitve". */
  rejectionReason: string;
  /** Printed instead of deemedNote when no accepted naročilnica carries the clause. */
  deemedNoPo: string;
  page: string;
}

export interface RegieberichtInput {
  number: number;
  projectName: string;
  contractorName: string | null;
  submittedOn: string | null;
  statusLabel: string;
  status: "draft" | "submitted" | "approved" | "rejected" | "deemed_approved";
  /** "Potrdil: Matej Kovač, 24. 08. 2026 ob 10:14", already composed, or null. */
  decisionLine: string | null;
  /** hour_sheets.rejection_reason (Task 3.6), printed for a rejected sheet; null otherwise. */
  rejectionReason?: string | null;
  /** True when an accepted naročilnica exists: the deemed note may then cite its terms. */
  hasAcceptedPo: boolean;
  /** "40,00 EUR na uro, po naročilnici št. 1", or null without an accepted order. */
  rateLine: string | null;
  /** The D9 rule with this sheet's deadline filled in, plus the order reference. */
  ruleLines: string[];
  totalHoursLabel: string;
  totalAmountLabel: string | null;
  lines: { date: string; person: string | null; hours: string; description: string; amount: string | null }[];
  /** The subcontractor. */
  issuer: DocIssuer;
  s: RegieberichtStrings;
}

export function RegieberichtDocument(input: RegieberichtInput) {
  const { s } = input;
  const docNo = `${s.docNo} ${input.number}`;
  const priced = input.rateLine !== null;

  const columns = priced
    ? [
        { label: s.colDate, widthPct: 14 },
        { label: s.colPerson, widthPct: 19 },
        { label: s.colDescription, widthPct: 39 },
        { label: s.colHours, widthPct: 10, align: "right" as const },
        { label: s.colAmount, widthPct: 18, align: "right" as const },
      ]
    : [
        { label: s.colDate, widthPct: 14 },
        { label: s.colPerson, widthPct: 22 },
        { label: s.colDescription, widthPct: 50 },
        { label: s.colHours, widthPct: 14, align: "right" as const },
      ];

  return (
    <Document title={`${s.title} ${input.number}, ${input.projectName}`}>
      <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
        <RunningHeader title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} />
        <Header title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} issuer={input.issuer} />

        <View style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
          <LabelValue label={s.project} value={input.projectName} />
          <LabelValue label={s.contractor} value={input.contractorName ?? ""} />
          {input.submittedOn ? <LabelValue label={s.submitted} value={input.submittedOn} /> : null}
          <LabelValue label={s.status} value={input.statusLabel} />
          <LabelValue label={s.rate} value={input.rateLine ?? s.noRate} />
        </View>

        <FlexTable
          columns={columns}
          rows={input.lines.map((line) =>
            priced
              ? [line.date, line.person ?? "", line.description, line.hours, line.amount ?? ""]
              : [line.date, line.person ?? "", line.description, line.hours],
          )}
        />

        <View
          style={{ alignItems: "flex-end", marginTop: 10, paddingTop: 8, borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: C.ink }}
          wrap={false}
        >
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{`${s.totalHours}: ${input.totalHoursLabel}`}</Text>
          {input.totalAmountLabel ? (
            <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 3 }}>{`${s.totalAmount}: ${input.totalAmountLabel}`}</Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* The decision block: who decided, when, or that the clock did. */}
        <View style={{ marginTop: 18, padding: 10, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: C.line }} wrap={false}>
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4 }}>{s.confirmTitle}</Text>
          {input.decisionLine ? <Text style={styles.body}>{input.decisionLine}</Text> : null}
          {input.status === "submitted" ? <Text style={styles.body}>{s.pending}</Text> : null}
          {input.rejectionReason ? (
            <Text style={[styles.body, { marginTop: 3 }]}>{`${s.rejectionReason}: ${input.rejectionReason}`}</Text>
          ) : null}
          {/* Printed only when silence is what approved it, and only citing the
              order terms when an accepted order carries them (D9). */}
          {input.status === "deemed_approved" ? (
            <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft, marginTop: 4 }]}>
              {input.hasAcceptedPo ? s.deemedNote : s.deemedNoPo}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          {input.ruleLines.map((line, i) => (
            <Text key={i} style={[styles.small, { color: C.muted, marginTop: 4 }]}>
              {line}
            </Text>
          ))}
        </View>

        <Footer generatedLabel={s.generated} pageLabel={s.page} />
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { resolveActorFromSession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { requireProjectActor } from "@/lib/actor";
import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";
import { effectiveStatus, type SheetStatus } from "@/lib/hours-shared";
import { formatMoney, round2 } from "@/lib/po-shared";
import { RegieberichtDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/regiebericht";
import { docLocaleOf, docString, docText, regieStrings, sheetStatusLabel } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
import { docDate, docDateTime, docNumber } from "@/lib/pdf/doc-format";
import { contentDisposition } from "@/lib/pdf/filename";
import { loadIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/issuer";
import { persistDeemed } from "@/lib/data/hours";
import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

// The Regiebericht is rendered ON DEMAND and never stored.
//
// Unlike the naročilnica, nothing binds to these bytes: there is no acceptance
// hashed against them, so a stored copy would only be a second version of the
// truth waiting to drift from the rows. The rows are the record; this is a view
// of them.

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ sheetId: string }> }) {
  const { sheetId } = await params;
  if (!isUuid(sheetId)) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });

  const actor = await resolveActorFromSession();
  if (!actor || actor.kind !== "person" || actor.role === "crew") {
    return new NextResponse("Forbidden", { status: 403 });
  }

  const db = createAdminClient();
  const { data: sheet } = await db
    .from("hour_sheets")
    .select(
      "id, number, status, submitted_at, deadline_at, decided_at, rejection_reason, project_id, people:decided_by_person (full_name), hour_sheet_lines (work_date, hours, description, people (full_name))",
    )
    .eq("id", sheetId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!sheet) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });

  try {
    await requireProjectActor(actor, sheet.project_id);
  } catch {
    return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });
  }

  // A deadline that has passed since the last page load decides the sheet
  // before it is printed, so the document can never claim a sheet is still
  // pending when the clock already approved it.
  await persistDeemed(sheet.project_id);

  const [{ data: project }, { data: po }] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .from("projects")
      .select("name, language, country, sub_org_id, organizations:sub_org_id (name)")
      .eq("id", sheet.project_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    // The rate counts only once it was AGREED: the accepted order, never a draft.
    db
      .from("purchase_orders")
      .select("number, regie_hourly_rate")
      .eq("project_id", sheet.project_id)
      .eq("status", "accepted")
      .order("number", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  const locale = docLocaleOf(project?.language);
  const country = project?.country ?? "si";
  const s = regieStrings(locale);

  const status = effectiveStatus(
    { status: sheet.status as SheetStatus, deadline_at: sheet.deadline_at },
    new Date(),
  );

  const rate = po?.regie_hourly_rate === null || po?.regie_hourly_rate === undefined ? null : Number(po.regie_hourly_rate);

  const lines = (sheet.hour_sheet_lines ?? [])
    .map((line) => ({
      dateIso: line.work_date,
      person: line.people?.full_name ?? null,
      hours: Number(line.hours),
      description: line.description,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.dateIso.localeCompare(b.dateIso));

  const totalHours = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.hours, 0);

  // Who decided, and when; or that the clock did, and when it ran out.
  const decider = sheet.people?.full_name ?? null;
  const decisionLine =
    status === "approved" && decider && sheet.decided_at
      ? `${s.approvedBy}: ${decider}, ${docDateTime(sheet.decided_at, locale, country)}`
      : status === "rejected" && decider && sheet.decided_at
        ? `${s.rejectedBy}: ${decider}, ${docDateTime(sheet.decided_at, locale, country)}`
        : status === "deemed_approved" && sheet.deadline_at
          ? `${s.deemedAt}: ${docDateTime(sheet.deadline_at, locale, country)}`
          : null;

  // The D9 rule with this sheet's own deadline. A deemed sheet already says the
  // rule in its deemed note, so it gets only the order reference.
  const site = country === "de" || country === "at" ? country : "si";
  const ruleLines =
    status === "draft" || !sheet.deadline_at
      ? []
      : [
          ...(status === "deemed_approved"
            ? []
            : [
                docText(locale, "doc.regie.rule", {
                  deadline: docDate(sheet.deadline_at, locale, country),
                  holidays: docString(locale, `doc.holidays.${site}`),
                }),
              ]),
          ...(po ? [docText(locale, "doc.regie.rulePo", { number: po.number })] : []),
        ];

  const buffer = await renderDocument(
    RegieberichtDocument({
      number: sheet.number,
      projectName: project?.name ?? "",
      contractorName: project?.organizations?.name ?? null,
      submittedOn: sheet.submitted_at ? docDateTime(sheet.submitted_at, locale, country) : null,
      statusLabel: sheetStatusLabel(locale, status),
      status,
      decisionLine,
      // Task 3.6 stores the reason in hour_sheets.rejection_reason (3.1a's column).
      rejectionReason: status === "rejected" ? (sheet.rejection_reason ?? null) : null,
      hasAcceptedPo: Boolean(po),
      rateLine:
        rate === null || !po
          ? null
          : docText(locale, "doc.regie.rateValue", { rate: formatMoney(rate, locale), number: po.number }),
      ruleLines,
      totalHoursLabel: `${docNumber(totalHours, locale)} ${s.hoursUnit}`,
      totalAmountLabel: rate === null ? null : formatMoney(round2(totalHours * rate), locale),
      lines: lines.map((line) => ({
        date: docDate(line.dateIso, locale, country),
        person: line.person,
        hours: docNumber(line.hours, locale),
        description: line.description,
        amount: rate === null ? null : formatMoney(round2(line.hours * rate), locale),
      })),
      issuer: await loadIssuer(db, project?.sub_org_id),
      s,
    }),
  );

  return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
      "Content-Disposition": contentDisposition([
        docString(locale, "hours.doc.title"),
        sheet.number,
        project?.name,
      ]),
      "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=0, must-revalidate",
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
// The Zahtevek za dodatno delo: one change order as a document.
//
// Change orders carry money but produced no paper until now. This prints what
// a dispute about extra work turns on: what the work was, the photos taken
// when it was found, the amount claimed, and who decided, when, in Belin.
// Rendered on demand from the rows, like the Regiebericht: nothing binds to
// these bytes, so a stored copy would only be a second truth to drift.

import { Document, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { C, Footer, Header, LabelValue, RunningHeader, styles, type DocIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
import { photoRows, type DocPhoto } from "@/lib/pdf/photos";
import { docString, type DocLocale } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";

export interface DodatnoDeloStrings {
  title: string;
  docNo: string;
  project: string;
  client: string;
  contractor: string;
  site: string;
  submitted: string;
  submittedBy: string;
  status: string;
  decided: string;
  description: string;
  amount: string;
  noAmount: string;
  photos: string;
  basisSi: string;
  approvedNote: string;
  rejectedNote: string;
  rejectedReason: string;
  pendingNote: string;
  generated: string;
  page: string;
}

export function dodatnoDeloStrings(locale: DocLocale): DodatnoDeloStrings {
  const t = (key: string) => docString(locale, `doc.co.${key}`);
  return {
    title: t("title"),
    docNo: docString(locale, "po.doc.docNo"),
    project: t("project"),
    client: t("client"),
    contractor: t("contractor"),
    site: t("site"),
    submitted: t("submitted"),
    submittedBy: t("submittedBy"),
    status: t("status"),
    decided: t("decided"),
    description: t("description"),
    amount: t("amount"),
    noAmount: t("noAmount"),
    photos: t("photos"),
    basisSi: t("basisSi"),
    approvedNote: t("approvedNote"),
    rejectedNote: t("rejectedNote"),
    rejectedReason: t("rejectedReason"),
    pendingNote: t("pendingNote"),
    generated: docString(locale, "final.doc.generated"),
    page: docString(locale, "doc.page"),
  };
}

export interface DodatnoDeloInput {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  /** formatMoney output, or null when no amount was given. */
  amount: string | null;
  status: "submitted" | "approved" | "rejected";
  statusLabel: string;
  /** change_orders.rejection_reason (Task 3.6), printed for a rejected claim; null otherwise. */
  rejectionReason: string | null;
  submittedOn: string;
  submittedBy: string | null;
  /** "Matej Kovač, 24. 09. 2026 ob 10:14", or null while undecided. */
  decidedLine: string | null;
  projectName: string;
  country: string;
  clientName: string;
  contractorName: string | null;
  siteAddress: string | null;
  photos: DocPhoto[];
  /** The subcontractor: the claimant issues the claim. */
  issuer: DocIssuer;
  s: DodatnoDeloStrings;
}

export function DodatnoDeloDocument(input: DodatnoDeloInput) {
  const { s } = input;
  const docNo = `${s.docNo} ${input.number}`;
  const statusNote =
    input.status === "approved" ? s.approvedNote : input.status === "rejected" ? s.rejectedNote : s.pendingNote;
  const rows = photoRows(input.photos, { keyPrefix: "co" });

  return (
    <Document title={`${s.title} ${input.number}, ${input.projectName}`}>
      <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
        <RunningHeader title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} />
        <Header title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} issuer={input.issuer} />

        <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <LabelValue label={s.project} value={input.projectName} />
          <LabelValue label={s.client} value={input.clientName} />
          <LabelValue label={s.contractor} value={input.contractorName ?? ""} />
          {input.siteAddress ? <LabelValue label={s.site} value={input.siteAddress} /> : null}
          <LabelValue label={s.submitted} value={input.submittedOn} />
          {input.submittedBy ? <LabelValue label={s.submittedBy} value={input.submittedBy} /> : null}
          <LabelValue label={s.status} value={input.statusLabel} />
          {input.decidedLine ? <LabelValue label={s.decided} value={input.decidedLine} /> : null}
        </View>

        <View wrap={false}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.description}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.body, { fontWeight: 700 }]}>{input.title}</Text>
          {input.description ? <Text style={[styles.body, { marginTop: 3 }]}>{input.description}</Text> : null}
        </View>

        <View
          style={{ marginTop: 14, paddingTop: 8, borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: C.ink, alignItems: "flex-end" }}
          wrap={false}
        >
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{`${s.amount}: ${input.amount ?? "-"}`}</Text>
          {input.amount === null ? <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.muted }]}>{s.noAmount}</Text> : null}
        </View>

        <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }} wrap={false}>
          <Text style={styles.body}>{statusNote}</Text>
          {input.status === "rejected" && input.rejectionReason ? (
            <Text style={[styles.body, { marginTop: 3 }]}>{`${s.rejectedReason}: ${input.rejectionReason}`}</Text>
          ) : null}
          {input.country === "si" ? (
            <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.muted, marginTop: 4 }]}>{s.basisSi}</Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {rows.length > 0 ? (
          <View wrap={false}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.photos}</Text>
            {rows[0]}
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {rows.slice(1)}

        <Footer generatedLabel={s.generated} pageLabel={s.page} />
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";
import { documentReader, notFound, pdfResponse } from "@/lib/data/doc-access";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/po-shared";
import { DodatnoDeloDocument, dodatnoDeloStrings } from "@/lib/pdf/dodatno-delo";
import { docLocaleOf, docString, docText } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
import { docDateTime } from "@/lib/pdf/doc-format";
import { contentDisposition } from "@/lib/pdf/filename";
import { downloadDocPhotos } from "@/lib/pdf/photo-data";
import { loadIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/issuer";
import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

// One change order as a PDF, rendered on demand from the rows.
// Office people of both parties; never crew (the amount is money, D11), never
// a project link.

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const MAX_PHOTOS = 6;

export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ changeOrderId: string }> }) {
  const { changeOrderId } = await params;
  if (!isUuid(changeOrderId)) return notFound();

  const db = createAdminClient();
  const { data: order } = await db
    .from("change_orders")
    .select(
      "id, project_id, number, title, description, amount, status, rejection_reason, created_at, decided_at, author:created_by_person (full_name), decider:decided_by_person (full_name), change_order_photos (storage_path, sort_order)",
    )
    .eq("id", changeOrderId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!order) return notFound();

  const reader = await documentReader(order.project_id);
  if (!reader.ok) return reader.response;

  const { data: project } = await db
    .from("projects")
    .select(
      "name, language, country, sub_org_id, address_street, address_zip, address_city, epc:epc_org_id (name), sub:sub_org_id (name)",
    )
    .eq("id", order.project_id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!project) return notFound();

  const locale = docLocaleOf(project.language);
  const country = project.country ?? "si";
  const status = order.status as "submitted" | "approved" | "rejected";

  const photos = await downloadDocPhotos(
    db,
    (order.change_order_photos ?? [])
      .sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
      .slice(0, MAX_PHOTOS)
      .map((photo, i) => ({
        path: photo.storage_path,
        caption: docText(locale, "doc.co.photoCaption", { n: i + 1 }),
      })),
  );

  const siteAddress = [project.address_street, [project.address_zip, project.address_city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")]
    .filter((part) => part && part.trim())
    .join(", ");

  const buffer = await renderDocument(
    DodatnoDeloDocument({
      number: order.number,
      title: order.title,
      description: order.description,
      amount: order.amount === null ? null : formatMoney(Number(order.amount), locale),
      status,
      statusLabel: docString(locale, `co.status.${status}`),
      rejectionReason: status === "rejected" ? (order.rejection_reason ?? null) : null,
      submittedOn: docDateTime(order.created_at, locale, country),
      submittedBy: order.author?.full_name ?? null,
      decidedLine:
        order.decider?.full_name && order.decided_at
          ? `${order.decider.full_name}, ${docDateTime(order.decided_at, locale, country)}`
          : null,
      projectName: project.name,
      country,
      clientName: project.epc?.name ?? "",
      contractorName: project.sub?.name ?? null,
      siteAddress: siteAddress || null,
      photos,
      issuer: await loadIssuer(db, project.sub_org_id),
      s: dodatnoDeloStrings(locale),
    }),
  );

  return pdfResponse(buffer, contentDisposition([docString(locale, "doc.co.title"), order.number, project.name]));
}
```

```js
const fs = require("fs");
function edit(file, pairs) {
  let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  for (const [a, b] of pairs) {
    // Idempotent: a pair already applied (its replacement is present) is skipped,
    // so a rerun after a hand fix never duplicates an import.
    if (s.includes(b)) continue;
    if (!s.includes(a)) throw new Error(`${file}: miss ${a.slice(0, 90)}`);
    s = s.split(a).join(b);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, s);
  console.log("edited", file);
}
```

### Task 6.7a: NEW site poster "Prijava na gradbišče" with the crew QR (P1, after the meeting, lane B, 0.75 h)

**Why:** crew-walk H11 and the poster idea: the runbook's "show the crew link as a QR" beat cannot be performed (no QR anywhere), and a printed poster on the site container makes joining a site need no explanation.

**Package decision (D7), checked tonight:** `qrcode` 1.5.4, MIT (`npm view qrcode version license`: 1.5.4, MIT; last published 2025-11-13), dependencies pngjs, dijkstrajs, yargs (the CLI); `@types/qrcode` 1.5.6, MIT. Rendering choice: **SVG path, not PNG.** `qrSvg()` turns the module matrix into one path in module units; react-pdf draws it with `<Svg><Path/></Svg>` and the screen draws the same path in an inline `<svg>`. Reasons: sharp at any print size, a few kilobytes instead of an image, no canvas on the server, renders inside a server component with zero client JavaScript, and paper and screen are the same shape. Proven tonight: a poster rendered this way, rasterized by pdf.js and read back by jsQR, returned the exact URL. Task 2.3b (P0, merged at Gate 1+2) already installed `qrcode` ^1.5.4 and `@types/qrcode` ^1.5.6 for the presenter panel's guest QR, with its own inline `QRCode.toString` helper (margin 1: a one-module quiet zone on a dark panel, which some phones fail to read). This task does NOT install anything; it makes `lib/qr.ts` the one encoder and points the presenter panel at it, so every code Belin draws has the 4-module quiet zone.

- Create: `lib/qr-shared.ts`, `lib/qr.ts`, `components/share/QrCode.tsx` (moved here from 6.7b: the presenter panel uses it too), `tests/qr.test.ts`, `lib/pdf/poster.tsx`, `app/api/pdf/poster/[projectId]/route.ts`.

```ts
import { create } from "qrcode";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { qrSvg } from "@/lib/qr";
import { qrViewBox } from "@/lib/qr-shared";

// The one QR encoder for paper and screen draws exactly what the encoder decided.

describe("qrSvg", () => {
  const url = "https://getbelin.com/sl/p/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789abcdefg";

  it("draws exactly the modules the encoder set", () => {
    const qr = qrSvg(url, "Q");
    const { modules } = create(url, { errorCorrectionLevel: "Q" });
    let dark = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < modules.size; r++) for (let c = 0; c < modules.size; c++) dark += modules.get(r, c) ? 1 : 0;
    // Every run is "M<col> <row>h<run>v1h-<run>z": the runs add up to the dark modules.
    const drawn = [...qr.path.matchAll(/h(\d+)v1/g)].reduce((sum, m) => sum + Number(m[1]), 0);
    expect(qr.size).toBe(modules.size);
    expect(drawn).toBe(dark);
  });

  it("starts with the top-left finder pattern and leaves a 4 module quiet zone", () => {
    const qr = qrSvg(url);
    expect(qr.path.startsWith("M0 0h7v1h-7z")).toBe(true);
    expect(qrViewBox(qr)).toBe(`-4 -4 ${qr.size + 8} ${qr.size + 8}`);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The parts of a QR code a screen needs, WITHOUT the encoder: the shape of an
// encoded code and its viewBox. Client components import only this file, so the
// qrcode package never ships to the browser (lib/qr.ts encodes, on the server).

export interface QrSvg {
  /** Modules per side, without the quiet zone. */
  size: number;
  /** Every dark module, as one SVG path in module units (0..size). */
  path: string;
}

/** The white margin a scanner needs around the code, in modules (ISO/IEC 18004). */
export const QR_QUIET_ZONE = 4;

/** The viewBox that includes the quiet zone: "-4 -4 45 45" for a 37 module code. */
export function qrViewBox(qr: QrSvg): string {
  const q = QR_QUIET_ZONE;
  return `${-q} ${-q} ${qr.size + 2 * q} ${qr.size + 2 * q}`;
}
```

```ts
// One QR encoder for paper and for screen.
//
// The `qrcode` package (MIT, installed by Task 2.3b) builds the module matrix;
// this file turns it into ONE SVG path in module units. The same path is drawn
// by @react-pdf's <Path> on the poster and by a plain <svg><path> on screen
// (components/share/QrCode.tsx), so the code a crew scans on paper and on a
// screen is the same shape, always with a 4-module quiet zone.
//
// Why a vector path and not a PNG: it stays sharp at any print size, adds a
// few kilobytes instead of an image, needs no canvas on the server, and renders
// inside a server component with no client JavaScript at all.
//
// Server use only (it imports the encoder). A client component imports the
// shape and the viewBox from lib/qr-shared.ts instead.

import { create } from "qrcode";
import type { QrSvg } from "@/lib/qr-shared";

export { QR_QUIET_ZONE, qrViewBox, type QrSvg } from "@/lib/qr-shared";

/**
 * "M" (15 % recovery) for screens and small marks; "Q" (25 %) for a poster that
 * will be taped to a site container and get dirty.
 */
export function qrSvg(text: string, level: "M" | "Q" = "M"): QrSvg {
  const { modules } = create(text, { errorCorrectionLevel: level });
  const size = modules.size;
  let path = "";
  for (let row = 0; row < size; row++) {
    let col = 0;
    while (col < size) {
      if (!modules.get(row, col)) {
        col++;
        continue;
      }
      // One rectangle per horizontal run keeps the path short.
      let run = 1;
      while (col + run < size && modules.get(row, col + run)) run++;
      path += `M${col} ${row}h${run}v1h-${run}z`;
      col += run;
    }
  }
  return { size, path };
}
```

```tsx
import { qrViewBox, type QrSvg } from "@/lib/qr-shared";

// A QR code as inline SVG. No "use client" and no hooks, so it renders from a
// server component or inside a client one alike; the path itself is computed
// on the server (lib/qr.ts) and arrives as plain data, and this file imports
// only lib/qr-shared.ts, so the encoder never ships to the browser. Dark
// modules on white always, whatever the theme: a scanner needs the contrast,
// and an inverted code fails on many phones.

export function QrCode({ qr, label, className = "qr-svg" }: { qr: QrSvg; label: string; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg className={className} viewBox={qrViewBox(qr)} role="img" aria-label={label} shapeRendering="crispEdges">
      <rect x={-4} y={-4} width={qr.size + 8} height={qr.size + 8} fill="#ffffff" />
      <path d={qr.path} fill="#0a1628" />
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```tsx
      <Rect x={13} y={14} width={3} height={3} fill={C.ink} />
      <Rect x={18} y={16} width={3} height={3} fill={C.ink} />
      <Rect x={15} y={27} width={4} height={1.5} fill={C.ink} />

}

function MailIcon() {
  return (
    <Svg width={ICON} height={ICON} viewBox="0 0 34 34">
      <Rect x={3} y={8} width={28} height={19} rx={2} stroke={C.ink} strokeWidth={2} fill="none" />

}

function Step({ n, icon, text }: { n: number; icon: ReactNode; text: string }) {

export function PosterDocument(input: PosterInput) {
  const { s, qr } = input;

        <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.inkSoft, marginTop: 6 }}>{parties}</Text>

        <View style={{ alignItems: "center", marginTop: 22 }}>

        <Footer generatedLabel={s.generated} />
      </Page>
```

```ts
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { documentReader, notFound, pdfResponse } from "@/lib/data/doc-access";
import { ensureCrewLink } from "@/lib/data/invites";
import { canIssueCrewLink } from "@/lib/invites-shared";
import { appBaseUrl } from "@/lib/app-url";
import { PosterDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/poster";
import { docLocaleOf, docString } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
import { contentDisposition } from "@/lib/pdf/filename";
import { loadIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/issuer";
import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
import { qrSvg } from "@/lib/qr";

// The A4 site poster with the crew QR, in the PROJECT's language.
//
// The code is the real crew link, a shared secret, so this route admits exactly
// the people who may copy that link in Settings: the subcontractor's office
// (canIssueCrewLink), on its own project. Not the EPC, not a Bauleiter, not crew.

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string }> }) {
  const { projectId } = await params;

  const reader = await documentReader(projectId);
  if (!reader.ok) return reader.response;
  if (reader.project.role !== "sub" || !canIssueCrewLink(reader.actor.orgType, reader.actor.role)) {
    return notFound();
  }

  const db = createAdminClient();
  const { data: project } = await db
    .from("projects")
    .select("name, language, sub_org_id, address_street, address_zip, address_city, epc:epc_org_id (name), sub:sub_org_id (name)")
    .eq("id", projectId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!project) return notFound();

  const locale = docLocaleOf(project.language);
  const token = await ensureCrewLink(projectId);
  // Same fallback as the invoice mail: a printed poster must never carry a
  // localhost address, and production is what a phone on site can reach.
  const url = `${appBaseUrl() ?? "https://getbelin.com"}/${locale}/p/${token}`;
  const t = (key: string) => docString(locale, `doc.poster.${key}`);

  const siteAddress = [project.address_street, [project.address_zip, project.address_city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")]
    .filter((part) => part && part.trim())
    .join(", ");

  const buffer = await renderDocument(
    PosterDocument({
      projectName: project.name,
      siteAddress: siteAddress || null,
      clientName: project.epc?.name ?? "",
      contractorName: project.sub?.name ?? null,
      url,
      qr: qrSvg(url, "Q"),
      issuer: await loadIssuer(db, project.sub_org_id),
      s: {
        title: t("title"),
        client: t("client"),
        contractor: t("contractor"),
        scan: t("scan"),
        step1: t("step1"),
        step2: t("step2"),
        step3: t("step3"),
        noApp: t("noApp"),
        generated: docString(locale, "final.doc.generated"),
      },
    }),
  );

  return pdfResponse(buffer, contentDisposition([t("title"), project.name]));
}
```

```js
// Task 6.7b anchor edits: the crew QR in Settings, behind a tap, never for a demo organization.
const fs = require("fs");
function edit(file, pairs) {
  let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  for (const [a, b] of pairs) {
    // Idempotent: a pair already applied (its replacement is present) is skipped,
    // so a rerun after a hand fix never duplicates an import.
    if (s.includes(b)) continue;
    if (!s.includes(a)) throw new Error(`${file}: miss ${a.slice(0, 90)}`);
    s = s.split(a).join(b);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, s);
  console.log("edited", file);
}
```

### Task 6.8: NEW Začasna situacija from logged progress (P2, after the meeting; ships only with the stored-statement design below, else cut; lane B, 3.5 h)

**Why:** the progress principle (DECISIONS 2026-07-17: progress "later powers Abschlagsrechnung documentation") and the Slovenian buyer: monthly interim statements are how Slovenian construction is paid, and Belin already holds the evidence.

**Slovenian convention, researched tonight** (PGU 2020, OZS published text, read 2026-10-05; and FURS-practice articles on 76.a ZDDV-1):
- FACT, uzanca 57: work is paid on interim statements (začasne situacije) and a final statement (končna situacija).
- FACT, uzanca 60: statements are issued on executed quantities at contract prices "oziroma v skladu s stopnjo dokončanosti del" (or by degree of completion); interim statements value the work done during construction.
- FACT, uzanca 61: an interim statement covers ONE MONTH and is sent in a reasonable time after the month; it carries quantities and prices or the degree of completion, the total value of work done, the amounts previously paid, and the amount now due. The final statement follows acceptance and handover.
- FACT, uzanca 62: payment within 8 days of receipt of an interim statement (15 for the final); the undisputed part is paid even when part is disputed. Uzanca 63: the client may dispute price, quantity and kind within 15 days, otherwise the statement counts as confirmed. Uzanca 64: confirmation is not a condition of payment.
- FACT (racun123.si, minimax.si, racunovodja.com articles on 76.a, read 2026-10-05): construction services between Slovenian VAT payers fall under reverse charge, 76.a člen ZDDV-1, and the document must state it; the app already prints `reverseChargeNote("si")` on the invoice.
- J: Belin prints "prej obračunano" (previously BILLED by earlier statements) where uzanca 61 says "prej izplačanih" (previously PAID): Belin does not record payments, and printing a paid amount it does not know would be false.
- J: the statement says "Situacija je obračun izvedenih del za potrditev in ni račun." In Slovenian practice a situacija is often issued AS the invoice; doing that here would need a second invoice numbering series beside Task 3.3's one-invoice-per-project rule. Founder question 1.
- J: extras and režijske ure are excluded and billed separately (uzanca 117 puts them in the final statement).

**The arithmetic (kept):** value to date = `total_net x weighted completion` using `projectProgress` (lib/progress.ts, rounded to 0.1 %, exactly the dashboard's figure), this period = value to date minus value before the month; month N counts only quantities dated up to the end of month N (pinned by a test). `lib/situacija-shared.ts`, its test and `lib/pdf/situacija.tsx` below stay as written.

**The on-demand design is REJECTED (data-legal review). Required before 6.8 ships; if the clock does not allow it, cut 6.8 rather than ship a statement that changes after it was sent.** A začasna situacija is a document the client receives, and uzance 62 and 63 run the 8-day payment and the 15-day dispute periods FROM ITS RECEIPT; it must therefore be the same document every time anybody opens it. The prototype below re-renders on every GET, so: the current, unfinished month was offered (on 6. 10. a statement "Št. 2, oktober 2026" printed a completion figure "do 31. 10. 2026", a date in the future); a late or backdated report changed an earlier statement's numbers; a revised naročilnica rewrote every earlier statement's contract value and its "Prej obračunano" line; it carried no issue date; and the EPC could generate it in the subcontractor's name ("Izdal (izvajalec)"). The design that ships:
1. **Closed months only.** `loadSituacijaSource(db, projectId, today)` keeps only months whose `end < today` (`today = projectToday(country)` from `lib/project-time.ts`). The issue action refuses any other month.
2. **Issued once, by the subcontractor's office only.** A new table `public.interim_statements (id uuid pk, project_id uuid fk projects, number int, month text check yyyy-mm, issued_at timestamptz default now(), issued_by_person uuid fk people, po_id uuid fk purchase_orders, contract_net numeric, percent_before numeric, percent_to_date numeric, value_before numeric, value_to_date numeric, value_this_period numeric, rows jsonb, storage_path text not null, sha256 text not null, unique (project_id, month), unique (project_id, number))`, RLS on with no policies, written ONLY by a server action `issueSituacija(actor, projectId, month)`: documentReader plus `reader.project.role === "sub"` and the role that may issue the crew link (`canIssueCrewLink(actor.orgType, actor.role)`); the month must be closed and not yet issued; the next number is `max(number) + 1`; it renders, stores at a NEW path `<projectId>/situacija/<uuid>.pdf` (`upsert: false`) and inserts the row once, with every figure it printed. Migration file in `supabase/migrations/`, applied by the orchestrator (shared-file rule 3), types regenerated.
3. **Figures frozen at issue.** "Prej obračunano" is the SUM of `value_this_period` of the earlier stored statements of the project (never recomputed), the contract value is the one stored with the statement, and the PDF prints "Datum izdaje" (`doc.situacija.issuedOn`) = `issued_at` in the site zone.
4. **Reading.** The route `GET /api/pdf/situacija/<statementId>` streams the STORED file (documentReader: office of both parties, never crew). The page lists issued statements for both parties, and for the subcontractor office an "Izdaj situacijo za <mesec>" button for the oldest closed month not yet issued; the EPC sees only issued statements.
5. **Not for public samples** until this design is live (Task 6.11 and 7.2a).
The code blocks below are the planning night's prototype: reuse `situacija-shared.ts`, `situacija.tsx` (add the "Datum izdaje" row) and the totals logic of the route inside `issueSituacija`; rewrite `situacija-data.ts` (closed months), the route (stream the stored file) and `SituacijaLinks` (issued list plus the issue button) to the design above.

```ts
// The arithmetic of a začasna situacija: month by month, from the crew's reported quantities.

describe("začasna situacija", () => {

    const [september] = situacijaMonths(quantities.map((q) => q.entryDate));
    const later = [...quantities, { item: 1, entryDate: "2026-12-01", qty: 228 }];
```

```ts
// The arithmetic of a začasna situacija (interim progress statement).
//
// Posebne gradbene uzance 2020 (PGU, GZS, verified 2026-10-05 from the OZS
// published text): interim statements are issued for one month at a time
// (uzanca 61), on executed quantities at contract prices OR by the degree of
// completion (uzanca 60), and carry the value of work executed, the amounts
// previously covered and the amount now due (uzanca 61, second paragraph).
//
// Belin already computes the degree of completion from the crew's daily
// quantities (lib/progress.ts, the founding principle), so a month's statement
// is: contract value x completion at the month's end, minus the same at the
// previous month's end. Pure and deterministic: the same reports always give
// the same statement, so it is rendered on demand and never stored.

import { projectProgress } from "@/lib/progress";
import { round2 } from "@/lib/po-shared";

export interface SituacijaItemInput {
  name: string;
  unit: string;
  targetQty: number;
  weight: number;
}

export interface SituacijaQuantity {
  /** Index into the items array. */
  item: number;
  entryDate: string;
  qty: number;
}

export interface SituacijaMonth {
  /** yyyy-mm */
  month: string;
  /** 1 for the first month with any report, counting only months with reports. */
  number: number;
  /** First and last calendar day of the month, yyyy-mm-dd. */
  start: string;
  end: string;
}

export interface SituacijaRow {
  name: string;
  unit: string;
  targetQty: number;
  qtyBefore: number;
  qtyPeriod: number;
  qtyToDate: number;
  /** 0..100, capped at 100 like projectProgress. */
  percentToDate: number;
}

export interface SituacijaFigures {
  rows: SituacijaRow[];
  contractNet: number;
  /** Weighted completion, rounded to 0.1, exactly as the dashboard shows it. */
  percentBefore: number;
  percentToDate: number;
  valueBefore: number;
  valueToDate: number;
  valueThisPeriod: number;
}

function lastDayOfMonth(month: string): string {
  const [year, m] = month.split("-").map(Number);
  const last = new Date(Date.UTC(year, m, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return `${month}-${String(last).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

/** The months that carry at least one report, oldest first, numbered from 1. */
export function situacijaMonths(entryDates: string[]): SituacijaMonth[] {
  const months = [...new Set(entryDates.map((date) => date.slice(0, 7)))].sort();
  return months.map((month, index) => ({
    month,
    number: index + 1,
    start: `${month}-01`,
    end: lastDayOfMonth(month),
  }));
}

/**
 * The statement for one month. Quantities dated after `month.end` do not
 * exist yet as far as this statement is concerned, which is what makes an
 * earlier month's statement reproducible after later reports arrive.
 */
export function situacijaFigures(
  contractNet: number,
  items: SituacijaItemInput[],
  quantities: SituacijaQuantity[],
  month: SituacijaMonth,
): SituacijaFigures {
  const before = items.map(() => 0);
  const period = items.map(() => 0);
  for (const q of quantities) {
    if (q.entryDate < month.start) before[q.item] += q.qty;
    else if (q.entryDate <= month.end) period[q.item] += q.qty;
  }

  const rows: SituacijaRow[] = items.map((item, i) => {
    const toDate = before[i] + period[i];
    return {
      name: item.name,
      unit: item.unit,
      targetQty: item.targetQty,
      qtyBefore: before[i],
      qtyPeriod: period[i],
      qtyToDate: toDate,
      percentToDate: item.targetQty > 0 ? Math.round(Math.min(1, toDate / item.targetQty) * 1000) / 10 : 0,
    };
  });

  const percentBefore = projectProgress(
    items.map((item, i) => ({ targetQty: item.targetQty, weight: item.weight, installedQty: before[i] })),
  );
  const percentToDate = projectProgress(
    items.map((item, i) => ({ targetQty: item.targetQty, weight: item.weight, installedQty: before[i] + period[i] })),
  );

  const valueBefore = round2((contractNet * percentBefore) / 100);
  const valueToDate = round2((contractNet * percentToDate) / 100);

  return {
    rows,
    contractNet,
    percentBefore,
    percentToDate,
    valueBefore,
    valueToDate,
    valueThisPeriod: round2(valueToDate - valueBefore),
  };
}
```

```ts
// Reading what a začasna situacija is computed from: the accepted naročilnica's
// net value, the project's scope items, and every reported quantity with its
// date. Not "server-only" (the client is a parameter), like render-po.tsx.

import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import {
  situacijaMonths,
  type SituacijaItemInput,
  type SituacijaMonth,
  type SituacijaQuantity,
} from "@/lib/situacija-shared";

type Db = SupabaseClient<any, any, any>;

export interface SituacijaSource {
  po: { number: number; totalNet: number; paymentTerms: string | null; issuedAt: string } | null;
  items: SituacijaItemInput[];
  quantities: SituacijaQuantity[];
  months: SituacijaMonth[];
}

interface ScopeRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  unit: string;
  target_qty: number | string;
  weight: number | string;
  sort_order: number;
}

interface EntryRow {
  entry_date: string;
  entry_quantities: { scope_item_id: string; qty: number | string }[] | null;
}

export async function loadSituacijaSource(db: Db, projectId: string): Promise<SituacijaSource> {
  const [poRes, scopeRes, entriesRes] = await Promise.all([
    // Only an ACCEPTED order is an agreed contract value.
    db
      .from("purchase_orders")
      .select("number, total_net, payment_terms, sent_at, created_at")
      .eq("project_id", projectId)
      .eq("status", "accepted")
      .order("number", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle(),
    db
      .from("scope_items")
      .select("id, name, unit, target_qty, weight, sort_order")
      .eq("project_id", projectId)
      .order("sort_order"),
    db
      .from("daily_entries")
      .select("entry_date, entry_quantities (scope_item_id, qty)")
      .eq("project_id", projectId)
      .order("entry_date"),
  ]);

  const scope = (scopeRes.data ?? []) as unknown as ScopeRow[];
  const entries = (entriesRes.data ?? []) as unknown as EntryRow[];
  const index = new Map(scope.map((row, i) => [row.id, i]));

  const quantities: SituacijaQuantity[] = entries.flatMap((entry) =>
    (entry.entry_quantities ?? []).flatMap((q) => {
      const item = index.get(q.scope_item_id);
      return item === undefined || Number(q.qty) <= 0
        ? []
        : [{ item, entryDate: entry.entry_date, qty: Number(q.qty) }];
    }),
  );

  const po = poRes.data
    ? {
        number: poRes.data.number as number,
        totalNet: Number(poRes.data.total_net),
        paymentTerms: (poRes.data.payment_terms as string | null) ?? null,
        issuedAt: (poRes.data.sent_at as string | null) ?? (poRes.data.created_at as string),
      }
    : null;

  return {
    po,
    items: scope.map((row) => ({
      name: row.name,
      unit: row.unit,
      targetQty: Number(row.target_qty),
      weight: Number(row.weight),
    })),
    quantities,
    // A month counts when it carries quantities, not merely a note: a month of
    // rain reports is not a month of billable progress.
    months: situacijaMonths(quantities.map((q) => q.entryDate)),
  };
}
```

```tsx
// The Začasna situacija: one month of work, valued by its degree of completion.
//
// What it is NOT: a tax invoice. It is the record of work done for the client
// to confirm, and says so on its face; the invoice is a separate document with
// its own numbering (Task 3.3). That keeps one numbering series per company and
// keeps this document free of the statutory invoice duties it could not meet
// on the night it was built (J, founder to confirm, see Wave 6 questions).

import { Document, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import {
  C,
  FlexTable,
  Footer,
  Header,
  LabelValue,
  RunningHeader,
  SignatureBox,
  styles,
  type DocIssuer,
} from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
import { docString, type DocLocale } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";

export interface SituacijaStrings {
  title: string;
  docNo: string;
  period: string;
  po: string;
  project: string;
  client: string;
  contractor: string;
  site: string;
  colItem: string;
  colUnit: string;
  colContract: string;
  colBefore: string;
  colPeriod: string;
  colToDate: string;
  colPercent: string;
  contractValue: string;
  thisPeriod: string;
  toPay: string;
  reverseChargeTitle: string;
  method: string;
  methodSi: string;
  paymentSi: string;
  disputeSi: string;
  extrasExcluded: string;
  notInvoice: string;
  signContractor: string;
  signClient: string;
  generated: string;
  page: string;
}

export function situacijaStrings(locale: DocLocale): SituacijaStrings {
  const t = (key: string) => docString(locale, `doc.situacija.${key}`);
  return {
    title: t("title"),
    docNo: docString(locale, "po.doc.docNo"),
    period: t("period"),
    po: t("po"),
    project: t("project"),
    client: t("client"),
    contractor: t("contractor"),
    site: t("site"),
    colItem: t("colItem"),
    colUnit: t("colUnit"),
    colContract: t("colContract"),
    colBefore: t("colBefore"),
    colPeriod: t("colPeriod"),
    colToDate: t("colToDate"),
    colPercent: t("colPercent"),
    contractValue: t("contractValue"),
    thisPeriod: t("thisPeriod"),
    toPay: t("toPay"),
    reverseChargeTitle: t("reverseChargeTitle"),
    method: t("method"),
    methodSi: t("methodSi"),
    paymentSi: t("paymentSi"),
    disputeSi: t("disputeSi"),
    extrasExcluded: t("extrasExcluded"),
    notInvoice: t("notInvoice"),
    signContractor: t("signContractor"),
    signClient: t("signClient"),
    generated: docString(locale, "final.doc.generated"),
    page: docString(locale, "doc.page"),
  };
}

export interface SituacijaInput {
  number: number;
  /** "september 2026 (01. 09. 2026 - 30. 09. 2026)" */
  periodLabel: string;
  poRef: string | null;
  projectName: string;
  country: string;
  clientName: string;
  contractorName: string | null;
  siteAddress: string | null;
  /** Already formatted rows: name, unit, contract, before, period, to date, percent. */
  rows: string[][];
  /** Label and value pairs of the totals block, in order. */
  totals: { label: string; value: string; strong?: boolean }[];
  reverseChargeNote: string | null;
  /** "Plačilni pogoji po naročilnici: ..." when the order sets terms, else null. */
  paymentPoLine: string | null;
  /** The subcontractor issues the statement. */
  issuer: DocIssuer;
  s: SituacijaStrings;
}

export function SituacijaDocument(input: SituacijaInput) {
  const { s } = input;
  const docNo = `${s.docNo} ${input.number}`;
  const si = input.country === "si";

  return (
    <Document title={`${s.title} ${input.number}, ${input.projectName}`}>
      <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
        <RunningHeader title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} />
        <Header title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} issuer={input.issuer} />

        <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <LabelValue label={s.project} value={input.projectName} />
          <LabelValue label={s.client} value={input.clientName} />
          <LabelValue label={s.contractor} value={input.contractorName ?? ""} />
          {input.siteAddress ? <LabelValue label={s.site} value={input.siteAddress} /> : null}
          {input.poRef ? <LabelValue label={s.po} value={input.poRef} /> : null}
          <LabelValue label={s.period} value={input.periodLabel} />
        </View>

        <FlexTable
          columns={[
            { label: s.colItem, widthPct: 28 },
            { label: s.colUnit, widthPct: 8 },
            { label: s.colContract, widthPct: 13, align: "right" },
            { label: s.colBefore, widthPct: 13, align: "right" },
            { label: s.colPeriod, widthPct: 13, align: "right" },
            { label: s.colToDate, widthPct: 13, align: "right" },
            { label: s.colPercent, widthPct: 12, align: "right" },
          ]}
          rows={input.rows}
        />

        <View style={{ marginTop: 12, alignItems: "flex-end" }} wrap={false}>
          <View style={{ width: "62%" }}>
            {input.totals.map((row, i) => (
              <View
                key={i}
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  paddingVertical: 3,
                  ...(row.strong ? { borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: C.ink, paddingTop: 6, marginTop: 3 } : {}),
                }}
              >
                <Text style={row.strong ? { fontWeight: 700 } : {}}>{row.label}</Text>
                <Text style={row.strong ? { fontWeight: 700 } : {}}>{row.value}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>

        {input.reverseChargeNote ? (
          <View style={{ marginTop: 10 }} wrap={false}>
            <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 2 }}>{s.reverseChargeTitle}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.body}>{input.reverseChargeNote}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }} wrap={false}>
          <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{`${s.method}${si ? ` ${s.methodSi}` : ""}`}</Text>
          {input.paymentPoLine ? (
            <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{input.paymentPoLine}</Text>
          ) : si ? (
            <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{s.paymentSi}</Text>
          ) : null}
          {si ? <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{s.disputeSi}</Text> : null}
          <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{s.extrasExcluded}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.inkSoft }]}>{s.notInvoice}</Text>
        </View>

        <View wrap={false} style={[styles.signatureRow, { marginTop: 26 }]}>
          <SignatureBox name={input.contractorName ?? ""} caption={s.signContractor} />
          <SignatureBox name={input.clientName} caption={s.signClient} />
        </View>

        <Footer generatedLabel={s.generated} pageLabel={s.page} />
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { documentReader, notFound, pdfResponse } from "@/lib/data/doc-access";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/po-shared";
import {
  computeTotals,
  defaultVatMode,
  reverseChargeNote,
  standardVatRate,
  type Country,
  type VatMode,
} from "@/lib/invoice-shared";
import { situacijaFigures } from "@/lib/situacija-shared";
import { loadSituacijaSource } from "@/lib/pdf/situacija-data";
import { SituacijaDocument, situacijaStrings } from "@/lib/pdf/situacija";
import { docLocaleOf, docString, docText } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
import { docDate, docMonth, docNumber } from "@/lib/pdf/doc-format";
import { contentDisposition } from "@/lib/pdf/filename";
import { loadIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/issuer";
import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

// One month's začasna situacija, computed on demand from the reports and the
// accepted naročilnica (lib/situacija-shared.ts). Office people of both
// parties: it is money, so never crew and never a project link.

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const COUNTRIES: Country[] = ["si", "de", "at"];

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; month: string }> },
) {
  const { projectId, month } = await params;
  if (!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month)) return notFound();

  const reader = await documentReader(projectId);
  if (!reader.ok) return reader.response;

  const db = createAdminClient();
  const { data: project } = await db
    .from("projects")
    .select(
      "name, language, country, vat_mode, sub_org_id, address_street, address_zip, address_city, epc:epc_org_id (name), sub:sub_org_id (name)",
    )
    .eq("id", projectId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!project) return notFound();

  const source = await loadSituacijaSource(db, projectId);
  const target = source.months.find((m) => m.month === month);
  // No accepted order means no agreed value; no quantities that month means
  // nothing to bill. Either way there is no statement to print.
  if (!source.po || !target) return notFound();

  const locale = docLocaleOf(project.language);
  const country = COUNTRIES.includes(project.country as Country) ? (project.country as Country) : "si";
  const s = situacijaStrings(locale);
  const money = (n: number) => formatMoney(n, locale);
  const num = (n: number) => docNumber(n, locale);

  const f = situacijaFigures(source.po.totalNet, source.items, source.quantities, target);

  const vatMode = (project.vat_mode as VatMode | null) ?? defaultVatMode(country);
  const rate = vatMode === "standard" ? standardVatRate(country) : null;
  const totals = computeTotals(f.valueThisPeriod, vatMode, rate);
  const endLabel = docDate(target.end, locale, country);

  const totalRows: { label: string; value: string; strong?: boolean }[] = [
    { label: s.contractValue, value: money(f.contractNet) },
    { label: docText(locale, "doc.situacija.percentToDate", { date: endLabel }), value: `${num(f.percentToDate)} %` },
    { label: docText(locale, "doc.situacija.valueToDate", { date: endLabel }), value: money(f.valueToDate) },
    {
      label:
        target.number > 2
          ? docText(locale, "doc.situacija.previouslyBilled", { last: target.number - 1 })
          : target.number === 2
            ? docString(locale, "doc.situacija.previouslyOne")
            : docString(locale, "doc.situacija.previouslyNone"),
      value: money(f.valueBefore),
    },
    { label: s.thisPeriod, value: money(f.valueThisPeriod) },
    ...(vatMode === "standard" && totals.totalVat !== null
      ? [{ label: docText(locale, "doc.situacija.vat", { rate: `${rate} %` }), value: money(totals.totalVat) }]
      : []),
    { label: s.toPay, value: money(totals.totalGross), strong: true },
  ];

  const siteAddress = [project.address_street, [project.address_zip, project.address_city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")]
    .filter((part) => part && part.trim())
    .join(", ");

  const buffer = await renderDocument(
    SituacijaDocument({
      number: target.number,
      periodLabel: `${docMonth(month, locale)} (${docDate(target.start, locale, country)} - ${endLabel})`,
      poRef: docText(locale, "doc.abnahme.poRefValue", {
        number: source.po.number,
        date: docDate(source.po.issuedAt, locale, country),
      }),
      projectName: project.name,
      country,
      clientName: project.epc?.name ?? "",
      contractorName: project.sub?.name ?? null,
      siteAddress: siteAddress || null,
      rows: f.rows.map((row) => [
        row.name,
        row.unit,
        num(row.targetQty),
        num(row.qtyBefore),
        num(row.qtyPeriod),
        num(row.qtyToDate),
        `${num(row.percentToDate)} %`,
      ]),
      totals: totalRows,
      reverseChargeNote: vatMode === "reverse_charge" ? reverseChargeNote(country) : null,
      paymentPoLine: source.po.paymentTerms
        ? docText(locale, "doc.situacija.paymentPo", { terms: source.po.paymentTerms })
        : null,
      issuer: await loadIssuer(db, project.sub_org_id),
      s,
    }),
  );

  return pdfResponse(buffer, contentDisposition([s.title, target.number, project.name, month]));
}
```

### Task 6.10: NEW Obvestilo o oviri from an obstruction incident, sent by the subcontractor (P2, after the meeting, lane B, 2.0 h)

**Why:** documents idea "Behinderungsanzeige": the crew records an obstruction on the roof with a server timestamp and photos, but no written notice exists, and a contractor who wants more time needs one.

**Slovenian practice, researched tonight** (PGU 2020, OZS published text, read 2026-10-05):
- FACT, uzanca 8: each party must inform the other in time about facts that affect performance, "such as obstacles"; notice is given in writing, which includes electronic correspondence where the parties do business that way, or by an entry in the gradbeni dnevnik; notices not given in writing or in the diary have no legal effect.
- FACT, uzanca 41: the contractor may request an extension of the deadline when it could not work because of changed circumstances or because the client did not meet its obligations; the extension covers the obstacle's duration plus the time to restart; listed causes include "druge fizične ovire, na katere izvajalec naleti na gradbišču", a change of work organization caused by the client, and a late handover of the site.
- FACT, uzanca 43: the substantiated request must reach the client in a reasonable time after the contractor learns of the cause; the client answers in writing in a reasonable time. (An earlier search summary claimed a 7-day limit; the 2020 text says "v primernem roku", so no number is printed.)
- J: the German line cites § 6 Abs. 1 VOB/B (Behinderungsanzeige) and the Austrian line ÖNORM B 2110 without a clause number; not checked tonight.
- Offered only for kind `obstruction`: rain normal for the season is not an obstacle the client answers for, and "Zaplet" is not a notice.

**It is the subcontractor's act, and it must actually be given (data-legal review).** The notice is the SUBCONTRACTOR's written notice (uzanca 8) and request for more time (uzance 41 and 43). Under uzanca 8 a notice has effect only once it is actually given in writing; a PDF that sits on the recipient's dashboard, made from a crew note by whoever opened it, is not a notice given. So:
- Only the subcontractor's office prepares and sends it: the route admits `reader.project.role === "sub"` with the role that may issue the crew link (`canIssueCrewLink(reader.actor.orgType, reader.actor.role)`); everyone else gets 404, except the EPC office for a notice that WAS sent (below).
- "Pošlji naročniku" (`doc.ovira.send`): a server action `sendObstructionNotice(actor, projectId, incidentId)` (same gate) renders the PDF, emails it as an attachment to the EPC's office addresses through `lib/email.ts` (one email; Resend's 100 per day budget, R14), and writes ONE activity row (kind `obstruction_notice_sent`, payload `{ incidentId, number }`, server time). A second send of the same incident is refused.
- The PDF prints "Datum obvestila" (`doc.ovira.notifiedAt`) from that activity row's time; before it is sent, the route serves the sub office a draft that carries no "Datum obvestila" line.
- The EPC dashboard's incident panel links the PDF only for an obstruction whose notice was sent (the activity row exists); the subcontractor's link lives on the subcontractor's own incident list (SubHome's incident card after Task 5.8, or the project page the sub office sees).
- The basis line says "Obvestilo se daje pisno (8. uzanca) ..." (6.1a), a rule, not a claim that this paper already was given.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/pdf/ovira.tsx`, `app/api/pdf/ovira/[incidentId]/route.ts`, the server action `sendObstructionNotice` (in the project's incident actions file, wrapped with Task 1.5's `toResult`), and `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_obstruction_notice_activity.sql`: `activity.kind` has a CHECK constraint (`activity_kind_check`, last widened in 20260812100000_incidents_notifications.sql). Read the LIVE definition first (Supabase connector: `select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) from pg_constraint where conname = 'activity_kind_check';`, other tasks may have widened it since), then drop and re-add it with that exact list plus `'obstruction_notice_sent'`. Only the orchestrator applies it (shared-file rule 3); no type change.

**Interfaces:**
- Produces `OviraDocument(input: OviraInput)` (`OviraInput.notifiedAt: string | null`, printed as "Datum obvestila" when present), `oviraStrings(locale, country)`.
- Produces `GET /api/pdf/ovira/<incidentId>`: 404 unless `incidents.kind = 'obstruction'`; documentReader, then the sub office, or the EPC office only when the notice was sent; issuer = the subcontractor; number = the obstruction's position among the project's obstructions; "Zabeleženo v Belinu" = `incidents.created_at` (server time) in the site zone; "Datum obvestila" = the `obstruction_notice_sent` activity row's time; up to 6 photos from `incident_photos`, shrunk for print; the accepted naročilnica's number and date when one exists. File name `Obvestilo-o-oviri-<n>-<project>.pdf`.
