```tsx
// The Obvestilo o oviri: an obstruction incident as a written notice.
//
// Under the Posebne gradbene uzance 2020, a notice about an obstacle has legal
// effect only when it is given in writing or entered in the site diary (uzanca
// 8), and a contractor who wants more time must ask for the extension within a
// reasonable time of learning of the cause (uzanca 43), the causes including
// physical obstacles on site and the client's own failures (uzanca 41). The
// crew already records the obstruction on the roof, with a server timestamp
// and photos; this turns that record into the written notice, so the request
// for more time exists the day the obstacle did, not weeks later.
//
// Rendered on demand from the incident row. The record of WHEN is the incident's
// created_at, a server timestamp nobody can edit, printed on the page.

import { Document, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { C, Footer, Header, LabelValue, RunningHeader, SignatureBox, styles, type DocIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
import { photoRows, type DocPhoto } from "@/lib/pdf/photos";
import { docString, type DocLocale } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";

export interface OviraStrings {
  title: string;
  docNo: string;
  recipient: string;
  sender: string;
  project: string;
  site: string;
  po: string;
  recordedAt: string;
  recordedBy: string;
  notifiedAt: string;
  intro: string;
  request: string;
  /** Already chosen for the SITE's country. */
  basis: string;
  noNote: string;
  photos: string;
  sign: string;
  generated: string;
  page: string;
}

export function oviraStrings(locale: DocLocale, country: string): OviraStrings {
  const t = (key: string) => docString(locale, `doc.ovira.${key}`);
  return {
    title: t("title"),
    docNo: docString(locale, "po.doc.docNo"),
    recipient: t("recipient"),
    sender: t("sender"),
    project: t("project"),
    site: t("site"),
    po: t("po"),
    recordedAt: t("recordedAt"),
    recordedBy: t("recordedBy"),
    notifiedAt: t("notifiedAt"),
    intro: t("intro"),
    request: t("request"),
    basis: t(`basis.${country === "de" || country === "at" ? country : "si"}`),
    noNote: t("noNote"),
    photos: t("photos"),
    sign: t("sign"),
    generated: docString(locale, "final.doc.generated"),
    page: docString(locale, "doc.page"),
  };
}

export interface OviraInput {
  /** Position of this obstruction among the project's obstructions, from 1. */
  number: number;
  projectName: string;
  siteAddress: string | null;
  clientName: string;
  contractorName: string | null;
  /** "št. 1 z dne 15. 09. 2026", or null without an accepted naročilnica. */
  poRef: string | null;
  /** "01. 10. 2026 ob 10:14", the incident's server timestamp in the site zone. */
  recordedAt: string;
  recordedBy: string | null;
  /** When the notice was sent to the client (the activity row's time), or null on a draft. */
  notifiedAt: string | null;
  note: string;
  photos: DocPhoto[];
  /** The subcontractor: it gives notice. */
  issuer: DocIssuer;
  s: OviraStrings;
}

export function OviraDocument(input: OviraInput) {
  const { s } = input;
  const docNo = `${s.docNo} ${input.number}`;
  const rows = photoRows(input.photos, { keyPrefix: "ovira" });

  return (
    <Document title={`${s.title} ${input.number}, ${input.projectName}`}>
      <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
        <RunningHeader title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} />
        <Header title={s.title} docNo={docNo} projectName={input.projectName} issuer={input.issuer} />

        <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <LabelValue label={s.recipient} value={input.clientName} />
          <LabelValue label={s.sender} value={input.contractorName ?? ""} />
          <LabelValue label={s.project} value={input.projectName} />
          {input.siteAddress ? <LabelValue label={s.site} value={input.siteAddress} /> : null}
          {input.poRef ? <LabelValue label={s.po} value={input.poRef} /> : null}
          <LabelValue label={s.recordedAt} value={input.recordedAt} />
          {input.recordedBy ? <LabelValue label={s.recordedBy} value={input.recordedBy} /> : null}
          {input.notifiedAt ? <LabelValue label={s.notifiedAt} value={input.notifiedAt} /> : null}
        </View>

        <View wrap={false}>
          <Text style={styles.body}>{s.intro}</Text>
          <View style={{ marginTop: 6, marginBottom: 8, paddingLeft: 10, borderLeftWidth: 2, borderLeftColor: C.ink }}>
            <Text style={styles.body}>{input.note.trim() ? input.note : s.noNote}</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.body}>{s.request}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.small, { color: C.muted, marginTop: 6 }]}>{s.basis}</Text>
        </View>

        {rows.length > 0 ? (
          <View wrap={false}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>{s.photos}</Text>
            {rows[0]}
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {rows.slice(1)}

        <View wrap={false} style={{ marginTop: 24, flexDirection: "row" }}>
          <SignatureBox name={input.contractorName ?? ""} caption={s.sign} />
        </View>

        <Footer generatedLabel={s.generated} pageLabel={s.page} />
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
}
```
- [ ] Create `app/api/pdf/ovira/[incidentId]/route.ts`:
```ts
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";
import { documentReader, notFound, pdfResponse } from "@/lib/data/doc-access";
import { canIssueCrewLink } from "@/lib/invites-shared";
import { OviraDocument, oviraStrings } from "@/lib/pdf/ovira";
import { docLocaleOf, docText } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
import { docDate, docDateTime } from "@/lib/pdf/doc-format";
import { contentDisposition } from "@/lib/pdf/filename";
import { downloadDocPhotos } from "@/lib/pdf/photo-data";
import { loadIssuer } from "@/lib/pdf/issuer";
import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

// The written notice of an obstruction, from one incident of kind obstruction.
// Rain and ordinary incidents get no notice: weather normal for the season is
// not an obstacle the client answers for.

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ incidentId: string }> }) {
  const { incidentId } = await params;
  if (!isUuid(incidentId)) return notFound();

  const db = createAdminClient();
  const { data: incident } = await db
    .from("incidents")
    .select("id, project_id, kind, note, created_at, people (full_name), incident_photos (storage_path, sort_order)")
    .eq("id", incidentId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!incident || incident.kind !== "obstruction") return notFound();

  const reader = await documentReader(incident.project_id);
  if (!reader.ok) return reader.response;

  // The notice is the subcontractor's act (uzanca 8). The sub office may open it
  // at any time; the EPC office only once it was actually sent.
  const { data: sent } = await db
    .from("activity")
    .select("created_at")
    .eq("project_id", incident.project_id)
    .eq("kind", "obstruction_notice_sent")
    .contains("payload", { incidentId: incident.id })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  const isSubOffice = reader.project.role === "sub" && canIssueCrewLink(reader.actor.orgType, reader.actor.role);
  if (!isSubOffice && !(reader.project.role === "epc" && sent)) return notFound();

  const [{ data: project }, { data: earlier }, { data: po }] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .from("projects")
      .select("name, language, country, sub_org_id, address_street, address_zip, address_city, epc:epc_org_id (name), sub:sub_org_id (name)")
      .eq("id", incident.project_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    // The notice number: this obstruction's position among the project's.
    db
      .from("incidents")
      .select("id")
      .eq("project_id", incident.project_id)
      .eq("kind", "obstruction")
      .lte("created_at", incident.created_at),
    db
      .from("purchase_orders")
      .select("number, sent_at, created_at")
      .eq("project_id", incident.project_id)
      .eq("status", "accepted")
      .order("number", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);
  if (!project) return notFound();

  const locale = docLocaleOf(project.language);
  const country = project.country ?? "si";
  const s = oviraStrings(locale, country);
  const number = Math.max(1, (earlier ?? []).length);

  const photos = await downloadDocPhotos(
    db,
    (incident.incident_photos ?? [])
      .sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
      .slice(0, 6)
      .map((photo, i) => ({ path: photo.storage_path, caption: docText(locale, "doc.co.photoCaption", { n: i + 1 }) })),
  );

  const siteAddress = [project.address_street, [project.address_zip, project.address_city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")]
    .filter((part) => part && part.trim())
    .join(", ");

  const buffer = await renderDocument(
    OviraDocument({
      number,
      projectName: project.name,
      siteAddress: siteAddress || null,
      clientName: project.epc?.name ?? "",
      contractorName: project.sub?.name ?? null,
      poRef: po
        ? docText(locale, "doc.abnahme.poRefValue", {
            number: po.number,
            date: docDate(po.sent_at ?? po.created_at, locale, country),
          })
        : null,
      recordedAt: docDateTime(incident.created_at, locale, country),
      recordedBy: incident.people?.full_name ?? null,
      notifiedAt: sent ? docDateTime(sent.created_at, locale, country) : null,
      note: incident.note,
      photos,
      issuer: await loadIssuer(db, project.sub_org_id),
      s,
    }),
  );

  return pdfResponse(buffer, contentDisposition([s.title, number, project.name]));
}
```

```js
// Task 6.10 anchor edits (planning night's shape; 6.0 rewrites canOpenPdf to sentNoticeIds).
const fs = require("fs");
function edit(file, pairs) {
  let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  for (const [a, b] of pairs) {
    // Idempotent: a pair already applied (its replacement is present) is skipped,
    // so a rerun after a hand fix never duplicates an import.
    if (s.includes(b)) continue;
    if (!s.includes(a)) throw new Error(`${file}: miss ${a.slice(0, 90)}`);
    s = s.split(a).join(b);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, s);
  console.log("edited", file);
}
```

### Task 6.9: NEW authenticity QR on stored documents and the public /v page (P2, after the meeting, lane B, 3.0 h)

**Why:** flows-correctness idea "verify-this-document QR" and documents idea "authenticity QR": the hash machinery exists but nobody can see it. A QR on the printed Zapisnik that opens "Podpisan, 5. 10. 2026, prstni odtis ..." is trust no paper process offers.

**Scope:** the four STORED documents (naročilnica at send, Zapisnik o prevzemu at signing, račun at generation, zaključno poročilo at generation) and the accepted naročilnica copy Task 3.7 stores. On-demand documents (day, Regiebericht, change order, notice, poster) get no QR: their bytes are not kept, so a hash would prove nothing. (A stored začasna situacija, Task 6.8's design, may join later.) Never shipped or run while a personalized demo exists (Task 9.4 to 9.7): a record snapshots the issuer's name, and the buyer's company name must not stay public.

**Rules from the data-legal review (they change the prototype below):**
1. **Records are append-only and outlive their sources.** A printed QR must keep answering after a reseed: Task 9.4 reseeds after 9.3b collected and 9.5 printed the documents, and 9.7 reseeds again. So the seed never deletes records, and the table refuses DELETE of a sealed row (a trigger), except inside a transaction that sets `belin.allow_record_purge` to `on` (an orchestrator-only escape, used only to remove records that must not stay public).
2. **The record stores the state it was sealed with:** `sealed_state` (`sent` for a naročilnica, `acceptedCopy` for its accepted copy, `signed`, `issued`, `generated`) and `sealed_state_at` (sent_at, the acceptance time, conducted_at, issue_date, created_at). The public page shows ONLY that sealed state with its date, never the document's LATER commercial outcome: a naročilnica forwarded to a bank must not reveal that the deal was later rejected or cancelled, or when. For a naročilnica whose order was since rejected, cancelled or replaced by a revision, the page adds at most the neutral line `doc.verify.superseded` ("Ta različica ni več veljavna."), without a date. When the source row is gone, the page still shows the sealed state.
3. **Seal only what really happened, and keep Wave 3's write order.** Task 3.4 writes the completion report's `generated_documents` row ONCE, after the bytes exist, with an id chosen before the render; this task keeps that: the record is opened with `sourceId` = 3.4's pre-chosen `documentId`, the report renders with the mark, the file is stored, 3.4's single insert runs, then the record is sealed. Nothing ever writes `storage_path = 'pending'` again (flows M10). Task 3.2 renders the Zapisnik BEFORE the conditional signing update: `renderAndStoreProtocol` returns `{ path, sha256, recordId }`, and `signAcceptance` seals the record only after the `.eq("status", "draft")` update returned a row (a lost race leaves an unsealed record, which the page shows as "not finished"). `sendPo` already seals after its conditional update; `acceptPo` (3.7) does the same for the accepted copy.

```sql
-- Task 6.9: public authenticity records for stored documents.
--
-- Every STORED document (naročilnica, its accepted copy, Zapisnik o prevzemu,
-- račun, zaključno poročilo) gets one row here BEFORE it is rendered, so the
-- PDF can print a QR to /<locale>/v/<id>. After the bytes are stored, the row
-- is sealed with their sha256 and storage path, once.
--
-- The public page shows ONLY: kind, issuer name, date, status, sha256. No
-- project, no amounts, no people. RLS on with no policies, like every table
-- here: the server reads it with the service role behind its own checks.
--
-- source_id is polymorphic (purchase_orders, acceptances, invoices or
-- generated_documents), so it carries no foreign key; a deleted source still
-- shows its sealed state, because the record keeps it.

create table public.document_records (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  -- set null, not cascade: deleting a project must not delete the proof of a
  -- document that was already handed to somebody.
  project_id uuid references public.projects (id) on delete set null,
  kind text not null check (kind in (
    'narocilnica', 'narocilnica_sprejem', 'zapisnik_prevzem', 'racun', 'zakljucno_porocilo'
  )),
  source_id uuid not null,
  issuer_org_id uuid references public.organizations (id) on delete set null,
  -- A snapshot: the record keeps saying who issued it if the company is renamed.
  issuer_name text not null,
  language text not null check (language in ('sl', 'de', 'en')),
  -- Snapshots, so the public page answers even when the project is gone.
  country text,
  sha256 text check (sha256 is null or sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  storage_path text,
  -- The state the document had when it was sealed, and when: the page shows
  -- this, never the source's later commercial outcome.
  sealed_state text check (sealed_state is null or sealed_state in ('sent', 'acceptedCopy', 'signed', 'issued', 'generated')),
  sealed_state_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  sealed_at timestamptz
);

create index idx_document_records_source on public.document_records (source_id);
create index idx_document_records_project on public.document_records (project_id);

alter table public.document_records enable row level security;
revoke all on public.document_records from anon, authenticated;

-- Write once: a sealed record can never change its hash, its path or its state.
create or replace function public.document_records_seal_once()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if old.sha256 is not null
     and (new.sha256 is distinct from old.sha256
          or new.storage_path is distinct from old.storage_path
          or new.sealed_state is distinct from old.sealed_state
          or new.sealed_state_at is distinct from old.sealed_state_at) then
    raise exception 'document record % is sealed', old.id;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger trg_document_records_seal_once
  before update on public.document_records
  for each row execute function public.document_records_seal_once();

-- Append-only: a sealed record is never deleted, so a printed QR keeps
-- answering after any reseed. The one escape is explicit and per transaction:
--   begin; set local belin.allow_record_purge = 'on'; delete ...; commit;
-- used by the orchestrator only, to remove records that must not stay public.
create or replace function public.document_records_keep_sealed()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if old.sha256 is not null and coalesce(current_setting('belin.allow_record_purge', true), '') <> 'on' then
    raise exception 'document record % is sealed and cannot be deleted', old.id;
  end if;
  return old;
end;
$$;

create trigger trg_document_records_keep_sealed
  before delete on public.document_records
  for each row execute function public.document_records_keep_sealed();

revoke execute on function public.document_records_seal_once() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on function public.document_records_keep_sealed() from public, anon, authenticated;
```

```ts
// Authenticity records: one row per stored document, opened before it is
// rendered (so the PDF can print its own verify QR) and sealed once with the
// sha256 of the stored bytes. See supabase/migrations/20261006006900.
//
// Not "server-only": the database client is a parameter, so the demo seed's
// naročilnica rendering (scripts/seed-documents.ts) opens records too.
//
// THE VERIFY URL ALWAYS POINTS AT PRODUCTION. Local development and production
// share one database (memory: one-database-for-local-and-production), so a
// record opened on a laptop is a production record, and a QR printed with
// localhost in it would be wrong forever. VERIFY_BASE_URL overrides it only if
// the canonical domain ever changes.

import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { docString, docText, type DocLocale } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";

type Db = SupabaseClient<any, any, any>;

export type DocumentRecordKind =
  | "narocilnica"
  | "narocilnica_sprejem"
  | "zapisnik_prevzem"
  | "racun"
  | "zakljucno_porocilo";

export function verifyBaseUrl(): string {
  return (process.env.VERIFY_BASE_URL?.trim() || "https://getbelin.com").replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

export function verifyUrl(locale: DocLocale, id: string): string {
  return `${verifyBaseUrl()}/${locale}/v/${id}`;
}

/** The short form printed beside the QR: "getbelin.com/v/<id>". The middleware adds the locale. */
export function verifyShortUrl(id: string): string {
  return `${verifyBaseUrl().replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")}/v/${id}`;
}

export type SealedState = "sent" | "acceptedCopy" | "signed" | "issued" | "generated";

export async function openDocumentRecord(
  db: Db,
  input: {
    projectId: string;
    kind: DocumentRecordKind;
    sourceId: string;
    issuerOrgId: string | null;
    language: DocLocale;
    /** The site's country, snapshotted so the page formats dates without the project. */
    country: string;
  },
): Promise<{ id: string; url: string; shortUrl: string }> {
  let issuerName = "";
  if (input.issuerOrgId) {
    const { data: org } = await db.from("organizations").select("name").eq("id", input.issuerOrgId).maybeSingle();
    issuerName = org?.name ?? "";
  }

  const { data, error } = await db
    .from("document_records")
    .insert({
      project_id: input.projectId,
      kind: input.kind,
      source_id: input.sourceId,
      issuer_org_id: input.issuerOrgId,
      issuer_name: issuerName,
      language: input.language,
      country: input.country,
    })
    .select("id")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error || !data) throw new Error(`Could not open the document record: ${error?.message ?? "no row"}`);

  return { id: data.id, url: verifyUrl(input.language, data.id), shortUrl: verifyShortUrl(data.id) };
}

/**
 * Seals the record with the stored bytes' hash and the state the document had
 * at that moment (shown publicly instead of the source's later outcome). Only an
 * unsealed row is updated. Call it only AFTER the act really happened (the
 * conditional update of sending, accepting or signing returned a row).
 */
export async function sealDocumentRecord(
  db: Db,
  id: string,
  seal: { sha256: string; storagePath: string; state: SealedState; stateAt: string },
): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await db
    .from("document_records")
    .update({
      sha256: seal.sha256,
      storage_path: seal.storagePath,
      sealed_state: seal.state,
      sealed_state_at: seal.stateAt,
      sealed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", id)
    .is("sha256", null);
  if (error) throw new Error(`Could not seal the document record: ${error.message}`);
}

/** The strings and URL of the verify mark (lib/pdf/verify-mark.tsx) for one record. */
export function verifyMarkFor(locale: DocLocale, id: string): { url: string; label: string; hint: string } {
  return {
    url: verifyUrl(locale, id),
    label: docText(locale, "doc.verify.mark", { url: verifyShortUrl(id) }),
    hint: docString(locale, "doc.verify.markHint"),
  };
}
```

```tsx
// The authenticity mark printed on stored documents: a small QR to the public
// verify page and the short link beside it. It is placed at the END of the
// document's content, unbreakable, so it never splits from its own text.

import { Path, Rect, Svg, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { C } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
import { qrSvg, qrViewBox } from "@/lib/qr";

export interface VerifyMarkInput {
  /** The full verify URL the QR encodes. */
  url: string;
  /** doc.verify.mark filled with the short URL: "Preverite pristnost: getbelin.com/v/...". */
  label: string;
  /** doc.verify.markHint. */
  hint: string;
}

export function VerifyMark({ url, label, hint }: VerifyMarkInput) {
  const qr = qrSvg(url, "M");
  return (
    <View wrap={false} style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", marginTop: 18 }}>
      <Svg width={58} height={58} viewBox={qrViewBox(qr)}>
        <Rect x={-4} y={-4} width={qr.size + 8} height={qr.size + 8} fill="#ffffff" />
        <Path d={qr.path} fill="#000000" />
      </Svg>
      <View style={{ marginLeft: 8, flexShrink: 1 }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, color: C.inkSoft }}>{label}</Text>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 7, color: C.muted, marginTop: 2 }}>{hint}</Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";

// What the PUBLIC verify page may know about a document: its kind, who issued
// it, when, the state it was SEALED with, and its sha256. Nothing else leaves
// this function: no project, no amounts, no names of people, no storage path,
// and never the document's later commercial outcome (a naročilnica forwarded to
// a bank must not reveal that the deal was later rejected, or when). The page
// is reachable by anyone holding the paper, which is the point, so it must say
// nothing the paper does not already say.

export type VerifyState = "sent" | "acceptedCopy" | "signed" | "issued" | "generated" | "pending";

export interface VerifyView {
  kind: "narocilnica" | "narocilnica_sprejem" | "zapisnik_prevzem" | "racun" | "zakljucno_porocilo";
  issuerName: string;
  issuedAt: string;
  country: string;
  /** The state SEALED with the document ("pending" before it is sealed). Never the source's later outcome. */
  state: VerifyState;
  /** When the sealed state happened (sent_at, the acceptance, conducted_at, issue_date), or null. */
  stateAt: string | null;
  /** True for a naročilnica whose order was since rejected, cancelled or revised: the page adds one neutral line, no date. */
  superseded: boolean;
  /** Null until the record is sealed. */
  sha256: string | null;
}

export async function getVerifyView(id: string): Promise<VerifyView | null> {
  if (!isUuid(id)) return null;
  const db = createAdminClient();

  const { data: record } = await db
    .from("document_records")
    .select("kind, source_id, issuer_name, country, created_at, sha256, sealed_state, sealed_state_at")
    .eq("id", id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!record) return null;

  const kind = record.kind as VerifyView["kind"];

  // Only a naročilnica can be superseded, and the page says so without a date
  // or a reason. A missing source row changes nothing: the record keeps its state.
  let superseded = false;
  if (kind === "narocilnica" && record.sha256) {
    const { data: po } = await db
      .from("purchase_orders")
      .select("status, project_id, number")
      .eq("id", record.source_id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (po && (po.status === "rejected" || po.status === "cancelled")) superseded = true;
    if (po && !superseded) {
      const { count } = await db
        .from("purchase_orders")
        .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
        .eq("project_id", po.project_id)
        .gt("number", po.number);
      superseded = (count ?? 0) > 0;
    }
  }

  return {
    kind,
    issuerName: record.issuer_name,
    issuedAt: record.created_at,
    country: record.country ?? "si",
    state: record.sha256 ? ((record.sealed_state as VerifyState | null) ?? "generated") : "pending",
    stateAt: record.sealed_state_at,
    superseded,
    sha256: record.sha256,
  };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

// Compares a PDF the visitor holds against the sealed hash, IN THE BROWSER.
// The file is never uploaded: crypto.subtle hashes it locally, which is what
// lets a public page offer this without receiving anybody's documents.

export function HashCheck({
  expected,
  labels,
}: {
  expected: string;
  labels: { title: string; hint: string; pick: string; match: string; mismatch: string };
}) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<"match" | "mismatch" | null>(null);

  async function onPick(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", await file.arrayBuffer());
    const hex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest))
      .map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join("");
    setResult(hex === expected ? "match" : "mismatch");
  }

  return (
    <div className="vf-check">
      <h2 className="vf-h2">{labels.title}</h2>
      <p className="vf-note">{labels.hint}</p>
      <label className="vf-pick">
        <input type="file" accept="application/pdf" onChange={onPick} />
        <span>{labels.pick}</span>
      </label>
      {result ? (
        <p className={`vf-result ${result === "match" ? "ok" : "bad"}`} role="status">
          {result === "match" ? labels.match : labels.mismatch}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { getTranslations, setRequestLocale } from "next-intl/server";
import { getVerifyView } from "@/lib/data/verify";
import { docDate } from "@/lib/pdf/doc-format";
import { HashCheck } from "@/components/docs/HashCheck";
import { BelinMark } from "@/components/BelinMark";

// The public authenticity page a document's QR opens. No sign-in: whoever holds
// the paper may check it. It shows exactly five facts (getVerifyView) and a
// local file check, and it is never indexed.

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  robots: { index: false, follow: false },
};

export default async function VerifyPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ locale: string; id: string }> }) {
  const { locale, id } = await params;
  setRequestLocale(locale);
  const t = await getTranslations("doc.verify");
  const view = await getVerifyView(id);
  const ui = locale === "de" || locale === "en" ? locale : "sl";

  return (
    <main className="belin-dark vf-wrap">
      <div className="e-grain" aria-hidden />
      <div className="vf-card">
        <div className="vf-brand">
          <BelinMark />
          <span className="e-wm">BELIN</span>
        </div>
        <h1 className="vf-title">{t("title")}</h1>

        {!view ? (
          <p className="vf-note">{t("notFound")}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <dl className="vf-facts">
              <dt>{t("kind")}</dt>
              <dd>{t(`kinds.${view.kind}`)}</dd>
              <dt>{t("issuer")}</dt>
              <dd>{view.issuerName}</dd>
              <dt>{t("date")}</dt>
              <dd>{docDate(view.issuedAt, ui, view.country)}</dd>
              <dt>{t("status")}</dt>
              <dd>
                {view.state === "pending" ? t("pending") : t(`states.${view.state}`)}
                {view.stateAt ? `, ${docDate(view.stateAt, ui, view.country)}` : ""}
                {view.superseded ? <span className="vf-superseded">{` ${t("superseded")}`}</span> : null}
              </dd>
              <dt>{t("hash")}</dt>
              <dd className="vf-hash">{view.sha256 ?? t("pending")}</dd>
            </dl>
            <p className="vf-note">{t("privacy")}</p>
            {view.sha256 ? (
              <HashCheck
                expected={view.sha256}
                labels={{
                  title: t("checkTitle"),
                  hint: t("checkHint"),
                  pick: t("pick"),
                  match: t("match"),
                  mismatch: t("mismatch"),
                }}
              />
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```js
// Task 6.9 anchor edits: authenticity records and the verify mark on the four stored documents.
const fs = require("fs");
function edit(file, pairs) {
  let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  for (const [a, b] of pairs) {
    // Idempotent: a pair already applied (its replacement is present) is skipped,
    // so a rerun after a hand fix never duplicates an import.
    if (s.includes(b)) continue;
    if (!s.includes(a)) throw new Error(`${file}: miss ${a.slice(0, 90)}`);
    s = s.split(a).join(b);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, s);
  console.log("edited", file);
}
```

```js
// The document gate: every Belin document type, fetched through the REAL routes
// with real sessions from the reseeded demo, checked, and written to a folder
// OUTSIDE the repo for looking at. Nothing it writes is committed and nothing
// goes under public/: public sample PDFs belong to Task 7.2a, which adopts these
// guards in its assertClean.
//
// It refuses to run unless every party on the project is a demo organization
// (organizations.is_demo, Task 2.1) and the client carries exactly the invented
// name passed as --expect-epc, so a personalized demo (the buyer's own name, D2)
// is never fetched.
//
// Checks on every document's text layer:
//   - no AVESOL real price or rate (D3), no forbidden real company, no en or em dash;
//   - no localhost, no /p/<token> path and no live token of this project (a crew
//     or project link is a write surface, index rule 8);
//   - "Stran 1 od" (page numbers) and no zero-padded Slovenian date (lib/format.ts);
//   - with --public (Task 7.2a's mode): no AVESOL register data unless
//     --allow-avesol (founder question 7), no digits of DEMO_SUB_IBAN, and the
//     invoice only with --with-invoice, which is refused while DEMO_SUB_IBAN is set
//     (it is AVESOL's real account, founder question 4).
// The RFC 5987 file name is checked on streamed routes only: the completion report
// answers 302 to a signed storage URL (Task 3.4), which carries its own name.
// The site poster is never fetched: its route encodes the project's real crew link.
//
// Usage, orchestrator only, dev server running on --base, demo lock held:
//   node scripts/qa/doc-gate.mjs --project <uuid> --epc-email <email> --sub-email <email> \
//     --expect-epc "<invented client name>" --out <folder outside the repo> \
//     [--base http://localhost:3000] [--png] [--public] [--allow-avesol] [--with-invoice]
//
// It writes one login_tokens row per persona (the same as marketing:shoot), nothing else.

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from "node:path";
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { extractText, getDocumentProxy } from "unpdf";

const args = Object.fromEntries(
  process.argv.slice(2).reduce((pairs, arg, i, all) => {
    if (arg.startsWith("--")) pairs.push([arg.slice(2), all[i + 1] && !all[i + 1].startsWith("--") ? all[i + 1] : true]);
    return pairs;
  }, []),
);
for (const required of ["project", "epc-email", "sub-email", "expect-epc", "out"]) {
  if (!args[required] || args[required] === true) {
    console.error(`Missing --${required}`);
    process.exit(2);
  }
}
const BASE = typeof args.base === "string" ? args.base : "http://localhost:3000";
const OUT = resolve(String(args.out));
const fromRepo = relative(process.cwd(), OUT);
if (!fromRepo.startsWith("..") && !isAbsolute(fromRepo)) {
  throw new Error("--out must be OUTSIDE the repo: nothing this gate writes is committed");
}

const env = Object.fromEntries(
  readFileSync(".env.local", "utf8")
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith("#") && l.includes("="))
    .map((l) => {
      const i = l.indexOf("=");
      return [l.slice(0, i).trim(), l.slice(i + 1).trim()];
    }),
);
const db = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, { auth: { persistSession: false } });

// ---- 1. Whose documents are these? --------------------------------------------
const { data: project, error: projectError } = await db
  .from("projects")
  .select("id, name, language, epc_org_id, sub_org_id")
  .eq("id", args.project)
  .maybeSingle();
if (projectError || !project) throw new Error(`No project ${args.project}: ${projectError?.message ?? "not found"}`);
if (project.language !== "sl") throw new Error(`Project language is ${project.language}; this gate reads Slovenian documents`);

const { data: orgs, error: orgError } = await db
  .from("organizations")
  .select("id, name, is_demo")
  .in("id", [project.epc_org_id, project.sub_org_id].filter(Boolean));
if (orgError) throw new Error(`Could not read organizations (is Task 2.1's is_demo column there?): ${orgError.message}`);
const epc = orgs.find((o) => o.id === project.epc_org_id);
if (orgs.some((o) => o.is_demo !== true)) throw new Error("A party on this project is not a demo organization. Refusing.");
if (epc?.name !== args["expect-epc"]) {
  throw new Error(`The client is "${epc?.name}", not the invented "${args["expect-epc"]}". Personalized demo? Refusing.`);
}

// Every live link token of the project: none may ever appear in a document.
const { data: tokenRows } = await db.from("project_tokens").select("token").eq("project_id", project.id);
const liveTokens = (tokenRows ?? []).map((row) => row.token).filter((token) => typeof token === "string" && token.length >= 6);

const iban = String(env.DEMO_SUB_IBAN ?? process.env.DEMO_SUB_IBAN ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, "");
if (args.public && args["with-invoice"] && iban) {
  throw new Error("DEMO_SUB_IBAN is set: the invoice would print AVESOL's real account. Refusing --with-invoice.");
}

// ---- 2. Sessions, exactly as a person gets one --------------------------------
async function session(browser, email) {
  const raw = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  const { data: person } = await db.from("people").select("id").ilike("email", email).maybeSingle();
  if (!person) throw new Error(`No person ${email}`);
  const { error } = await db.from("login_tokens").insert({
    person_id: person.id,
    token_hash: createHash("sha256").update(raw, "utf8").digest("hex"),
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60_000).toISOString(),
  });
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
  const context = await browser.newContext({ locale: "sl-SI" });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/sl/auth/verify/${raw}`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 120_000 });
  await page.getByRole("button").first().click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => !url.pathname.includes("/auth/verify"), { timeout: 90_000 });
  await page.close();
  return context;
}

// ---- 3. What to fetch ----------------------------------------------------------
const pid = project.id;
const latest = async (table, select, filters = (q) => q, order = "created_at") => {
  const { data } = await filters(db.from(table).select(select).eq("project_id", pid))
    .order(order, { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  return data;
};

const po = await latest("purchase_orders", "id, status", (q) => q.in("status", ["sent", "accepted"]), "number");
const day = await latest("daily_entries", "entry_date", (q) => q, "entry_date");
const sheet = await latest("hour_sheets", "id", (q) => q.neq("status", "draft"), "number");
const co = await latest("change_orders", "id", (q) => q, "number");
const acceptance = await latest("acceptances", "id", (q) => q.eq("status", "signed"));
const report = await latest("generated_documents", "id", (q) => q.eq("kind", "completion_report"));
const invoice = await latest("invoices", "id");
// Only when 6.10 and 6.8 shipped: a notice that was SENT, a statement that was ISSUED.
const notice = await latest("activity", "payload", (q) => q.eq("kind", "obstruction_notice_sent"));
const statement = await latest("interim_statements", "id").catch(() => null);

// [file name, route, who, required for the gate]
const targets = [
  ["narocilnica", po && `/api/pdf/po/${po.id}?copy=sent`, "sub", true],
  ["narocilnica-sprejeta", po?.status === "accepted" && `/api/pdf/po/${po.id}`, "sub", true],
  ["dnevno-porocilo", day && `/api/pdf/day/${pid}/${day.entry_date}`, "epc", true],
  ["porocilo-o-rezijskih-urah", sheet && `/api/pdf/regie/${sheet.id}`, "epc", true],
  ["zahtevek-za-dodatno-delo", co && `/api/pdf/co/${co.id}`, "epc", true],
  ["zapisnik-o-prevzemu", acceptance && `/api/pdf/abnahme/${acceptance.id}`, "epc", true],
  ["zakljucno-porocilo", report && `/api/pdf/report/${report.id}`, "epc", true],
  ["racun", invoice && (!args.public || args["with-invoice"]) && `/api/pdf/invoice/${invoice.id}`, "sub", !args.public],
  ["zacasna-situacija", statement && `/api/pdf/situacija/${statement.id}`, "sub", false],
  ["obvestilo-o-oviri", notice?.payload?.incidentId && `/api/pdf/ovira/${notice.payload.incidentId}`, "epc", false],
  // No poster: its route encodes this project's real crew link.
];

// ---- 4. Fetch, check, write ----------------------------------------------------
// The dash pattern is the en dash and the em dash, written as escapes.
const FORBIDDEN = [
  [/118\.500/, "AVESOL's real price"],
  [/48,00 EUR/, "AVESOL's real rate"],
  [/Sonce Energija/i, "a forbidden real company"],
  [/[\u2013\u2014]/, "an en or em dash"],
  [/localhost/i, "a localhost address"],
  [/\/p\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}/, "a /p/ link path"],
  [/\b0\d\. \d{1,2}\. 20\d\d\b|\b\d{1,2}\. 0\d\. 20\d\d\b/, "a zero-padded Slovenian date (lib/format.ts writes 6. 10. 2026)"],
];
if (args.public && !args["allow-avesol"]) {
  FORBIDDEN.push([/SI26459973/, "AVESOL's VAT id"], [/AVESOL/i, "AVESOL's name"]);
}

const browser = await chromium.launch();
const contexts = { epc: await session(browser, args["epc-email"]), sub: await session(browser, args["sub-email"]) };
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

const problems = [];
const written = [];
const note = (required, message) => (required ? problems.push(message) : console.log(message));
for (const [name, route, who, required] of targets) {
  if (!route) {
    note(required, `MANJKA ${name}: no source row on this project`);
    continue;
  }
  const requested = `${BASE}${route}`;
  const response = await contexts[who].request.get(requested);
  if (response.status() !== 200) {
    note(required, `${name}: HTTP ${response.status()} for ${route}`);
    continue;
  }
  const found = [];
  const redirected = response.url() !== requested;
  const disposition = response.headers()["content-disposition"] ?? "";
  if (!redirected && !disposition.includes("filename*=UTF-8''")) found.push(`${name}: no RFC 5987 filename (${disposition})`);
  const bytes = Buffer.from(await response.body());
  const pdf = await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(bytes));
  const { text } = await extractText(pdf, { mergePages: true });
  const flat = String(text).replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  const compact = flat.replace(/\s+/g, "");
  for (const [pattern, what] of FORBIDDEN) if (pattern.test(flat)) found.push(`${name}: carries ${what}`);
  for (const token of liveTokens) if (flat.includes(token) || compact.includes(token)) found.push(`${name}: carries a live project token`);
  if (args.public && iban && compact.includes(iban)) found.push(`${name}: carries the digits of DEMO_SUB_IBAN`);
  if (!flat.includes("Stran 1 od")) found.push(`${name}: no page number`);
  problems.push(...found);
  writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${name}.pdf`, bytes);
  written.push([name, bytes]);
  console.log(`${name}.pdf ${bytes.length} bytes, ${pdf.numPages} pages${found.length ? `, ${found.length} problem(s)` : ""}`);
}

// ---- 5. Optional: rasterize every page for LOOKING at -------------------------
if (args.png && written.length > 0) {
  const page = await (await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1400, height: 2000 } })).newPage();
  await page.route("http://raster.local/**", (route) => {
    const url = route.request().url();
    if (url.includes("/pdfjs/")) {
      return route.fulfill({ body: readFileSync(resolve("node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build", url.split("/pdfjs/")[1])), contentType: "text/javascript" });
    }
    const hit = written.find(([n]) => url.endsWith(`/${n}.pdf`));
    if (hit) return route.fulfill({ body: hit[1], contentType: "application/pdf" });
    return route.fulfill({ body: '<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><canvas id="c"></canvas>', contentType: "text/html" });
  });
  await page.goto("http://raster.local/index.html");
  for (const [name] of written) {
    const count = await page.evaluate(async (n) => {
      const pdfjs = await import("/pdfjs/pdf.mjs");
      pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "/pdfjs/pdf.worker.mjs";
      window.__doc = await pdfjs.getDocument({ url: `/${n}.pdf` }).promise;
      return window.__doc.numPages;
    }, name);
    for (let p = 1; p <= count; p++) {
      await page.evaluate(async (n) => {
        const pg = await window.__doc.getPage(n);
        const vp = pg.getViewport({ scale: 1.4 });
        const c = document.getElementById("c");
        c.width = Math.ceil(vp.width);
        c.height = Math.ceil(vp.height);
        await pg.render({ canvasContext: c.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise;
      }, p);
      writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${name}-p${p}.png`, await page.locator("#c").screenshot({ type: "png" }));
    }
  }
}

await browser.close();
if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`\nNOT CLEAN:\n- ${problems.join("\n- ")}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log(`\n${written.length} documents checked in ${OUT}`);
```

A new path has no cache entry.

```js
// Interim redaction for the public landing (Task 7.1, 2026-10-06).
//
// The landing published a private customer's name and home address (the K2
// review screenshot) and a real company plus AVESOL's rate (the three document
// pictures). This cuts those regions out until the fictional demo is reshot
// (Task 7.2a), and writes NEW file names so no cached copy of the old pictures
// can be served from the old URLs.
//
// Boxes were measured from the committed files on 2026-10-05 by scanning ink
// rows (luminance under 150 on the paper). Each box carries 5 to 6 px of
// padding. The text is 11 to 12 px tall and the mosaic cell is 8 px, so no
// glyph survives.
//
//   node scripts/marketing/redact-landing.mjs
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import sharp from "sharp";

const DIR = "public/landing/";
const BLOCK = 8;

const DOCS = {
  "doc-invoice": [
    { left: 434, top: 206, width: 140, height: 33 }, // Prejemnik: company name and ID za DDV
    { left: 572, top: 341, width: 196, height: 82 }, // Cena na enoto and Skupaj, rows 1 to 3
    { left: 672, top: 450, width: 104, height: 22 }, // Za plačilo total
  ],
  "doc-abnahme": [{ left: 314, top: 184, width: 126, height: 19 }], // Naročnik
  "doc-report": [{ left: 323, top: 206, width: 126, height: 19 }], // Naročnik
};

async function mosaic(src, box) {
  const region = await sharp(src).extract(box).toBuffer();
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(box.width / BLOCK));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(box.height / BLOCK));
  const small = await sharp(region).resize(w, h, { fit: "fill" }).toBuffer();
  return sharp(small).resize(box.width, box.height, { fit: "fill", kernel: "nearest" }).toBuffer();
}

for (const [name, boxes] of Object.entries(DOCS)) {
  const src = readFileSync(`${DIR}${name}.webp`);
  const layers = [];
  for (const box of boxes) layers.push({ input: await mosaic(src, box), left: box.left, top: box.top });
  const out = await sharp(src).composite(layers).webp({ quality: 84, alphaQuality: 92 }).toBuffer();
  writeFileSync(`${DIR}${name}-r1.webp`, out);
  console.log(`redacted ${name}-r1.webp (${boxes.length} boxes)`);
}

// The K2 review: rows y 231 to 420 hold Naziv projekta, Ulica, Poštna
// številka, Kraj, and Država "SI" for a Vienna address (the bug fixed on
// 2026-08-13). Remove those rows and join the header band (y 0 to 221) to the
// rest (y 430 on). Both seams sit on flat navy, so the join is invisible.
{
  const src = readFileSync(`${DIR}wizard-review.webp`);
  const top = await sharp(src).extract({ left: 0, top: 0, width: 1500, height: 222 }).toBuffer();
  const rest = await sharp(src).extract({ left: 0, top: 430, width: 1500, height: 924 }).toBuffer();
  const out = await sharp({ create: { width: 1500, height: 1146, channels: 3, background: "#0b1524" } })
    .composite([
      { input: top, left: 0, top: 0 },
      { input: rest, left: 0, top: 222 },
    ])
    .webp({ quality: 84 })
    .toBuffer();
  writeFileSync(`${DIR}wizard-review-r1.webp`, out);
  console.log("cut wizard-review-r1.webp to 1500x1146");
}
```

```js
// Shared plumbing for the landing asset scripts (Task 7.2a, 7.2b, 7.6).
//
// Signs in exactly like scripts/marketing/shoot.mjs: a login token minted with
// the service role and walked through the real verify page. If Gate 2.6 or
// Task 1.7 changed how shoot.mjs mints tokens, copy that version here.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const env = Object.fromEntries(
  readFileSync(".env.local", "utf8")
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith("#") && l.includes("="))
    .map((l) => {
      const i = l.indexOf("=");
      return [l.slice(0, i).trim(), l.slice(i + 1).trim()];
    }),
);

export const db = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

export const BASE = (process.env.BASE ?? "http://localhost:3000").replace(/\/+$/, "");

/** The Demo Door personas (Task 2.3), by their fixed seed ids. */
export const PERSONA = {
  epc: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666605",
  bauleiter: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666601",
  sub: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666603",
  crew: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666602",
};
export const DEMO_EPC_ORG = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
export const MAIN_PROJECT = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333";
/** Montaža Kos's project: the AVESOL office must never see it. */
export const OTHER_SUB_PROJECT = "3333333a-0000-4000-8000-000000000004";

export async function magicLink(personId, locale = "sl") {
  const raw = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  const { error } = await db.from("login_tokens").insert({
    person_id: personId,
    token_hash: createHash("sha256").update(raw, "utf8").digest("hex"),
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600_000).toISOString(),
  });
  if (error) throw new Error(`login token for ${personId}: ${error.message}`);
  return `${BASE}/${locale}/auth/verify/${raw}`;
}

/**
 * A browser context signed in as one persona, with every piece of presenter
 * or dev chrome hidden: the splash, the Demo Door persona bar, Next's dev
 * indicator. Hidden by an init script, never by the app (DECISIONS 2026-08-13).
 */
export async function signedInContext(browser, personId, options = {}) {
  const { viewport, deviceScaleFactor = 1, recordVideo } = options;
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport, deviceScaleFactor, locale: "sl-SI", recordVideo });
  await context.addCookies([{ name: "belin-shot", value: "1", url: BASE }]);
  await context.addInitScript(() => {
    const style = document.createElement("style");
    style.textContent = "[data-splash],[data-demo-bar],.dm-switch,nextjs-portal{display:none !important}";
    const attach = () => document.head?.appendChild(style);
    if (document.head) attach();
    else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", attach, { once: true });
  });
  if (personId) {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    await page.goto(await magicLink(personId), { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
    await page.getByRole("button").first().click();
    await page.waitForURL((url) => !url.pathname.includes("/auth/verify"), { timeout: 20000 });
    await page.close();
  }
  return context;
}

/** Words that must never appear in a public asset (D2, D3, L3, L4). */
export function denylist() {
  const words = ["Sonce Energija", "sonce-demo", "Engelmeier", "Oberlaaer", "118.500", "48,00 EUR", "Lidl", "Trimo", "Gorenje"];
  if (process.env.BUYER_NAME) words.push(process.env.BUYER_NAME);
  return words;
}

export function assertClean(label, text) {
  const hits = denylist().filter((w) => text.includes(w));
  if (hits.length) throw new Error(`${label} contains ${hits.join(", ")}: not shooting a public asset with it`);
}
```

```js
import sharp from "sharp";
import { framePhone } from "./frames.mjs";
import { BASE, db, PERSONA, MAIN_PROJECT, signedInContext, assertClean } from "./session.mjs";

const OUT = "public/landing/v2";
const RAW = ".tmp-qa/landing-raw";
const PHONE = { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, deviceScaleFactor: 3 };
const DESK = { viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 };

async function settle(page) {
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle").catch(() => {});
  await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll(".e-reveal").forEach((el) => el.classList.add("in")));
  await page.waitForTimeout(900);
}

async function save(buffer, name, { alpha = false } = {}) {
  writeFileSync(`${RAW}/${name}.png`, buffer);
  const info = await sharp(buffer)
    .webp({ quality: 82, effort: 6, ...(alpha ? { alphaQuality: 90 } : {}) })
    .toFile(`${OUT}/${name}.webp`);
  console.log(`shot ${name.padEnd(14)} ${info.width}x${info.height} ${(info.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`);
  return { src: `/landing/v2/${name}.webp`, width: info.width, height: info.height };
}

async function phone(browser, who, path, name, prepare, { framed = false } = {}) {
  const context = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA[who], PHONE);
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(BASE + path, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
  if (prepare) await prepare(page);
  await settle(page);
  assertClean(name, await page.innerText("body"));
  const png = await page.screenshot({ type: "png" });
  await context.close();
  return save(framed ? await framePhone(png) : png, name, { alpha: framed });
}

async function setField(page, label, value) {
  const field = page.getByLabel(label, { exact: true }).first();
  const tag = await field.evaluate((el) => el.tagName);
  if (tag === "SELECT") await field.selectOption(value);
  else await field.fill(value);
}

/** The K2 review, read from a plan that names nobody, dressed in the demo's own fictional identity. */
async function reviewFromPlan(page) {
  const { data: p, error } = await db
    .from("projects")
    .select("name, address_street, address_zip, address_city")
    .eq("id", MAIN_PROJECT)
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  await page.locator('input[type="file"]').first().setInputFiles("tests/fixtures/k2/forum1.pdf");
  await page.getByText("Prepoznan K2 načrt").waitFor({ timeout: 60000 });
  await setField(page, "Naziv projekta", p.name);
  await setField(page, "Ulica in hišna številka", p.address_street);
  await setField(page, "Poštna številka", p.address_zip);
  await setField(page, "Kraj", p.address_city);
  await setField(page, "Država", "si");
  await page.getByText("Prepoznan K2 načrt").scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollBy(0, -16));
  // Deliberately never presses "Ustvari projekt": the upload belongs to the
  // demo EPC, and the next reseed purges its plan_imports row and storage
  // object (Task 2.1, late finding LF9).
}

function openTab(name) {
  return async (page) => {
    await page.getByText(name, { exact: true }).first().click();
    await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  };
}

/** The live proof: the EPC dashboard is already open when the crew sends. */
async function liveProof(browser) {
  const office = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA.epc, DESK);
  const board = await office.newPage();
  await board.goto(`${BASE}/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}`, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
  await settle(board);

  const crew = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA.crew, PHONE);
  const roof = await crew.newPage();
  await roof.goto(`${BASE}/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}`, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
  await settle(roof);

  // Quantities: typed if Task 5.9 shipped numeric entry, stepped otherwise.
  const typed = roof.locator('input[inputmode="decimal"], input[inputmode="numeric"], input[type="number"]');
  if (await typed.count()) {
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(2, await typed.count()); i++) await typed.nth(i).fill("4");
  } else {
    const plus = roof.getByRole("button", { name: "Povečaj" });
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(2, await plus.count()); i++) {
      for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) await plus.nth(i).click();
    }
  }
  const file = roof.locator('input[type="file"]').first();
  if (await file.count()) {
    await sharp("assets/marketing/site/crew-module.jpg").resize({ width: 1600 }).jpeg({ quality: 80 }).toFile(`${RAW}/proof-photo.jpg`);
    await file.setInputFiles(`${RAW}/proof-photo.jpg`);
    await roof.waitForTimeout(1500);
  }
  await roof.getByRole("button", { name: "Pošlji poročilo" }).click();
  await roof.waitForTimeout(3500);
  assertClean("proof-crew", await roof.innerText("body"));
  const crewShot = await save(await roof.screenshot({ type: "png" }), "proof-crew");

  // No reload: what the camera sees is the realtime update itself.
  await board.waitForTimeout(5000);
  assertClean("proof-epc", await board.innerText("body"));
  const epcShot = await save(await board.screenshot({ type: "png", clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1440, height: 760 } }), "proof-epc");

  await crew.close();
  await office.close();
  return { crew: crewShot, epc: epcShot };
}

async function main() {
  mkdirSync("components/landing/v2", { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(RAW, { recursive: true });
  const browser = await chromium.launch();

  const heroCrew = await phone(browser, "crew", `/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}`, "hero-crew", openTab("Pregled"), { framed: true });
  const plan = await phone(browser, "epc", "/sl/app/new", "step-plan", reviewFromPlan);
  const report = await phone(browser, "crew", `/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}`, "step-report", openTab("Poročaj"));
  const hours = await phone(browser, "epc", `/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}/hours`, "step-hours");
  const close = await phone(browser, "epc", `/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}/final`, "step-close");
  // Last, because it changes the project's numbers.
  const proof = await liveProof(browser);
  await browser.close();

  // The legacy page (/de, /en) gets the same fictional review, cropped to the
  // part its half column can hold.
  const legacy = await sharp(`${RAW}/step-plan.png`).extract({ left: 0, top: 0, width: 1170, height: 1300 }).webp({ quality: 84 }).toFile("public/landing/wizard-review-r2.webp");
  console.log(`legacy wizard-review-r2 ${legacy.width}x${legacy.height}`);

  const img = (i) => `{ src: "${i.src}", width: ${i.width}, height: ${i.height} }`;
  writeFileSync(
    "components/landing/v2/shots.ts",
    `// GENERATED by scripts/marketing/landing-shots.mjs (Task 7.2a). Edit the script, not this file.
import type { V2Image } from "./types";

export const HERO_CREW: V2Image | null = ${img(heroCrew)};

export const STEPS: Record<"plan" | "report" | "hours" | "close", V2Image | null> = {
  plan: ${img(plan)},
  report: ${img(report)},
  hours: ${img(hours)},
  close: ${img(close)},
};

export const PROOF: { crew: V2Image | null; epc: V2Image | null } = {
  crew: ${img(proof.crew)},
  epc: ${img(proof.epc)},
};
`,
  );
  console.log("\nwrote components/landing/v2/shots.ts");
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```js
// The sample documents a visitor can download (Task 7.2a).
//
// Real bytes from the product's own PDF routes, fetched by a signed-in EPC
// office session from the fictional demo, checked for forbidden words, then
// thumbnailed from page 1. What Gate 6 looked at is what ships.
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import sharp from "sharp";
import { extractText, getDocumentProxy } from "unpdf";
import { BASE, db, PERSONA, MAIN_PROJECT, DEMO_EPC_ORG, signedInContext, assertClean } from "./session.mjs";

const PDF_DIR = "public/samples/sl";
const THUMB_DIR = "public/landing/v2";

// Routes added by Wave 6. Read app/api/pdf/ after Gate 6 merged and set these
// two from what is there: the one-day report route Task 6.2 added (its id is a
// daily entry id) and the change-order route Task 6.6 added (a change order
// id). Left null, the script skips that document and says so; the landing
// shows only what exists.
const DAY_ROUTE = null; // e.g. (id) => `/api/pdf/<folder from 6.2>/${id}`
const CHANGE_ROUTE = null; // e.g. (id) => `/api/pdf/<folder from 6.6>/${id}`

async function one(query, what) {
  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw new Error(`${what}: ${error.message}`);
  return data;
}

async function documents() {
  const p = MAIN_PROJECT;
  const po = await one(db.from("purchase_orders").select("id").eq("project_id", p).not("pdf_path", "is", null).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(), "po");
  const entry = await one(db.from("daily_entries").select("id").eq("project_id", p).order("entry_date", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(), "entry");
  const sheet = await one(db.from("hour_sheets").select("id").eq("project_id", p).eq("status", "approved").order("number").limit(1).maybeSingle(), "sheet");
  const change = await one(db.from("change_orders").select("id").eq("project_id", p).eq("status", "approved").order("number").limit(1).maybeSingle(), "change");
  const report = await one(db.from("generated_documents").select("id").eq("project_id", p).eq("kind", "completion_report").neq("storage_path", "pending").order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(), "report");
  const acceptance = await one(db.from("acceptances").select("id").eq("project_id", p).not("report_pdf_path", "is", null).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(), "acceptance");
  const invoice = await one(db.from("invoices").select("id").eq("project_id", p).not("pdf_path", "is", null).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(), "invoice");
  return [
    { key: "narocilnica", file: "belin-vzorec-narocilnica.pdf", route: po && `/api/pdf/po/${po.id}` },
    { key: "dnevno", file: "belin-vzorec-dnevno-porocilo.pdf", route: entry && DAY_ROUTE && DAY_ROUTE(entry.id) },
    { key: "rezija", file: "belin-vzorec-rezijske-ure.pdf", route: sheet && `/api/pdf/regie/${sheet.id}` },
    { key: "dodatno", file: "belin-vzorec-dodatno-delo.pdf", route: change && CHANGE_ROUTE && CHANGE_ROUTE(change.id) },
    { key: "zakljucno", file: "belin-vzorec-zakljucno-porocilo.pdf", route: report && `/api/pdf/report/${report.id}` },
    { key: "prevzem", file: "belin-vzorec-zapisnik-o-prevzemu.pdf", route: acceptance && `/api/pdf/abnahme/${acceptance.id}` },
    { key: "racun", file: "belin-vzorec-racun.pdf", route: invoice && `/api/pdf/invoice/${invoice.id}` },
  ];
}

async function main() {
  mkdirSync("components/landing/v2", { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(PDF_DIR, { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(THUMB_DIR, { recursive: true });
  const { data: epcOrg } = await db.from("organizations").select("name").eq("id", DEMO_EPC_ORG).single();

  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  const office = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA.epc, { viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  const viewer = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1400, height: 1980 } });
  await viewer.route("**/pdfjs/**", (route) => {
    const file = route.request().url().split("/pdfjs/")[1];
    try {
      route.fulfill({ body: readFileSync(resolve("node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build", file)), contentType: "text/javascript" });
    } catch {
      route.abort();
    }
  });
  const view = await viewer.newPage();
  await view.goto(`file://${resolve("scripts/marketing/pdf-view.html")}`);

  const manifest = [];
  for (const doc of await documents()) {
    if (!doc.route) {
      console.log(`skip ${doc.key}: no document or no route (set DAY_ROUTE / CHANGE_ROUTE from Gate 6)`);
      continue;
    }
    const response = await office.request.get(BASE + doc.route);
    const bytes = Buffer.from(await response.body());
    if (response.status() !== 200 || bytes.subarray(0, 5).toString() !== "%PDF-") {
      throw new Error(`${doc.key}: ${response.status()} from ${doc.route}, not a PDF`);
    }
    const { text } = await extractText(await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(bytes)), { mergePages: true });
    assertClean(doc.key, text);
    // Whitespace removed on both sides: PDF text extraction may split "d.o.o.".
    const flat = (s) => s.replace(/\s+/g, "");
    if (doc.key !== "dnevno" && doc.key !== "rezija" && !flat(text).includes(flat(epcOrg.name))) {
      throw new Error(`${doc.key}: does not name the demo EPC "${epcOrg.name}"; is this the fictional demo?`);
    }
    writeFileSync(`${PDF_DIR}/${doc.file}`, bytes);

    await view.evaluate(([data]) => window.renderPdfPage(data, 1, 1.5), [Array.from(bytes)]);
    const page1 = await view.locator("#page").screenshot({ type: "png" });
    const meta = await sharp(page1).metadata();
    const thumb = await sharp(page1)
      .extract({ left: 0, top: 0, width: meta.width, height: Math.round(meta.width * 0.75) })
      .resize({ width: 640 })
      .webp({ quality: 80 })
      .toFile(`${THUMB_DIR}/doc-${doc.key}.webp`);
    manifest.push({ key: doc.key, href: `/samples/sl/${doc.file}`, bytes: bytes.length, thumb: `/landing/v2/doc-${doc.key}.webp`, thumbWidth: thumb.width, thumbHeight: thumb.height });
    console.log(`sample ${doc.key.padEnd(12)} ${(bytes.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`);
  }
  await browser.close();

  writeFileSync(
    "components/landing/v2/samples.ts",
    `// GENERATED by scripts/marketing/samples.mjs (Task 7.2a). Edit the script, not this file.
export type SampleKey = "narocilnica" | "dnevno" | "rezija" | "dodatno" | "zakljucno" | "prevzem" | "racun";

export interface Sample {
  key: SampleKey;
  href: string;
  bytes: number;
  thumb: string;
  thumbWidth: number;
  thumbHeight: number;
}

export const SAMPLES: readonly Sample[] = ${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)};
`,
  );
  console.log(`\n${manifest.length} samples, wrote components/landing/v2/samples.ts`);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```js
// Ten seconds, no sound: a report leaves a phone and lands on the office
// dashboard, recorded at the same time in two windows (Task 7.2b).
// It submits a report, so it runs only between two reseeds.
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import ffmpeg from "ffmpeg-static";
import sharp from "sharp";
import { BASE, PERSONA, MAIN_PROJECT, signedInContext } from "./session.mjs";

const WORK = ".tmp-qa/loop";
const OUT = "public/landing/v2";

async function main() {
  mkdirSync(WORK, { recursive: true });
  const browser = await chromium.launch();

  const office = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA.epc, { viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, recordVideo: { dir: `${WORK}/epc`, size: { width: 1440, height: 900 } } });
  const board = await office.newPage();
  const t0Board = Date.now();
  await board.goto(`${BASE}/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}`, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });

  const crew = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA.crew, { viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, recordVideo: { dir: `${WORK}/crew`, size: { width: 390, height: 844 } } });
  const roof = await crew.newPage();
  const t0Roof = Date.now();
  await roof.goto(`${BASE}/sl/app/${MAIN_PROJECT}`, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
  await roof.waitForTimeout(1500);

  const typed = roof.locator('input[inputmode="decimal"], input[inputmode="numeric"], input[type="number"]');
  if (await typed.count()) await typed.first().fill("6");
  else for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) await roof.getByRole("button", { name: "Povečaj" }).first().click();
  await roof.waitForTimeout(700);
  const tSend = Date.now();
  await roof.getByRole("button", { name: "Pošlji poročilo" }).click();
  await roof.waitForTimeout(7000);

  const roofVideo = roof.video();
  const boardVideo = board.video();
  await crew.close();
  await office.close();
  await browser.close();
  const crewFile = await roofVideo.path();
  const boardFile = await boardVideo.path();

  // Both windows start three seconds before the tap, then run ten seconds.
  const fromRoof = Math.max(0, (tSend - t0Roof) / 1000 - 3).toFixed(2);
  const fromBoard = Math.max(0, (tSend - t0Board) / 1000 - 3).toFixed(2);
  execFileSync(ffmpeg, [
    "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
    "-ss", fromRoof, "-t", "10", "-i", crewFile,
    "-ss", fromBoard, "-t", "10", "-i", boardFile,
    "-filter_complex", "[0:v]scale=-2:720,setsar=1[c];[1:v]scale=-2:720,setsar=1[e];[c][e]hstack=inputs=2,scale=1280:-2,fps=30,format=yuv420p[v]",
    "-map", "[v]", "-an", "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "slow", "-crf", "30", "-movflags", "+faststart",
    `${OUT}/loop.mp4`,
  ]);
  execFileSync(ffmpeg, ["-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-sseof", "-0.5", "-i", `${OUT}/loop.mp4`, "-frames:v", "1", `${WORK}/poster.png`]);
  const poster = await sharp(`${WORK}/poster.png`).webp({ quality: 80 }).toFile(`${OUT}/loop-poster.webp`);

  writeFileSync(
    "components/landing/v2/loop.ts",
    `// GENERATED by scripts/marketing/loop.mjs (Task 7.2b). Edit the script, not this file.
import type { V2Image } from "./types";

export const LOOP: (V2Image & { poster: string }) | null = { src: "/landing/v2/loop.mp4", poster: "/landing/v2/loop-poster.webp", width: ${poster.width}, height: ${poster.height} };
`,
  );
  console.log(`loop ${poster.width}x${poster.height}`);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```ts
import type { Operator } from "@/lib/legal";

/**
 * "Dogovorite predstavitev" opens the visitor's mail app with the subject and a
 * short form already written. encodeURIComponent, not URLSearchParams: mail
 * clients read "+" literally, so spaces must travel as %20.
 */
export function demoMailto(email: string, subject: string, body: string): string {
  return `mailto:${email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
}

/** A dialable tel: link from a number written for people ("+386 30 252 069"). */
export function telHref(phone: string): string {
  return `tel:${phone.replace(/[^\d+]/g, "")}`;
}

/** The operator's name exactly as components/legal/LegalPage.tsx composes it. */
export function operatorName(op: Operator): string {
  return [op.legalName, op.legalForm].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

export function operatorAddress(op: Operator): string {
  return [op.street, [op.zip, op.city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
}

/** "1,2 MB" or "342 KB", in Slovenian number format. */
export function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`;
  const mb = new Intl.NumberFormat("sl-SI", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(bytes / (1024 * 1024));
  return `${mb} MB`;
}
```

```tsx
import { setRequestLocale } from "next-intl/server";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { resolveActorFromSession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { safeNext } from "@/lib/auth-core";
import { personaForPersonId } from "@/lib/demo/personas";
import { LandingV1 } from "@/components/landing/LandingV1";
import { LandingV2 } from "@/components/landing/v2/LandingV2";
import { usesLandingV2 } from "@/components/landing/v2/locales";

export default async function Home({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ locale: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string }>;
}) {
  const { locale } = await params;
  setRequestLocale(locale);

  // Already signed in: skip the landing page entirely. This RESOLVES the
  // session rather than just reading the cookie. A cookie that no longer
  // resolves (expired, revoked, or a session from a rebuilt database) would
  // otherwise bounce here, get sent to /app, fail to resolve there, and be sent
  // straight back: an infinite redirect. A signed-out visitor has no cookie at
  // all and still costs no database round trip.
  const actor = await resolveActorFromSession();
  // A Demo Door guest from a meeting is not this visitor's account.
  const demoGuest = actor?.kind === "person" && personaForPersonId(actor.personId) === "guest";
  if (actor && !demoGuest) redirect(`/${locale}/app`);

  // A guarded route now sends signed-out visitors to /login directly, so `next`
  // reaching the landing page is an older link or a hand-typed URL. It is still
  // carried through the sign-in link rather than dropped, because losing it
  // means signing in and landing somewhere you did not ask for.
  const { next } = await searchParams;
  const safe = safeNext(next) ?? "";
  const signInHref = safe
    ? `/${locale}/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(safe)}`
    : `/${locale}/login`;

  // Two pages until the translation pass: v2 is written in Slovenian first, so
  // building it for /de and /en now would put Slovenian on the German page.
  return usesLandingV2(locale) ? (
    <LandingV2 locale={locale} signInHref={signInHref} />
  ) : (
    <LandingV1 locale={locale} signInHref={signInHref} />
  );
}
```

  Copy provenance, for the reviewer: `money.lead`, `money.b1t`, `b1b`, `b2b`, `b3t`, `b3b`, `pilot.i2` to `i5` and `pilot.ask` are COPY_SL verbatim (lib/pdf/brochure-copy.ts:71-84, 140-147). `hero.title1`/`title2` is COPY_SL `problem.h2` (line 70). `hero.under` keeps the founder's line "Vaš projekt na enem mestu" (D15) and ends "od naročilnice do prevzema in računa", because "predaja" means the end-of-job handover everywhere else in the product. `hero.offer` is the Task 0.6 g default (replace with the founder's answer if he gave one, in all three catalogs, and the same string must appear in the signup screen of Task 4.3). `pilot.after` and `faq.a9` carry the Task 0.6 h default. Deliberate departures from COPY_SL: "tudi na slabi povezavi" is dropped (D12), "brez računa" became "brez gesla" (SG-11), "šestih delovnih dni" is not printed (D9), "To niso vzorci" became "Vsak vzorec je pravi dokument" because the page offers them as samples, `pilot.i1` became "Vse funkcije Belina, brez omejitev" (pilot.i1 departs from COPY_SL: "pet modulov" reads as solar panels on this page, and a visitor cannot know what the five are), and `money.b2t` became "Zapisnik o prevzemu, napisan teden dni pozneje" because "Prevzem, ki nastane teden dni po prevzemu" says nothing. `abroad.l1` names the Freistellungsbescheinigung for German sites only (§ 48b EStG is German law; the 9.3a brochure fix does the same). `faq.a2`, `a2servers` and `privacyLink` name the page by its real title, "Varstvo osebnih podatkov" (lib/legal-copy.ts:94). `faq.a9` promises an export before the end of use, not downloads after it, because the Pogoji uporabe export and then delete. `faq.a3avesol` and `faq.a3plain` are the canonical operator-access wording, used word for word in Task 8.1a and the run of show (Task 9.2): the operator has technical access, uses it only for operation, security and support, never for AVESOL's offers, and the DPA is signed before the pilot starts (Task 0.6 l: none exists tonight); the founder approves them with the 0.6 n drafts. `about.body` is J copy for the founder to confirm at the gate.
