```
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('messages/sl.json','utf8'));const flat=(o,p)=>Object.entries(o).flatMap(([k,v])=>v&&typeof v==='object'?flat(v,p+k+'.'):[p+k]);const dir='tests/translation-debt';const [file,...prefixes]=process.argv.slice(1);const taken=new Set(fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')&&f!==file).flatMap(f=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dir+'/'+f,'utf8'))));const keys=flat(m,'').filter(k=>prefixes.some(p=>k===p||k.startsWith(p+'.'))).filter(k=>!taken.has(k));fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/'+file,JSON.stringify(keys,null,2)+'\n');console.log(file,keys.length,'keys')" 7.3a-landing2.json landing2
```

  It prints `7.3a-landing2.json <n> keys` and writes `tests/translation-debt/7.3a-landing2.json`. If `tests/translation-debt/` does not exist, Gate 1 shipped without Task 1.4a: stop and tell the orchestrator. `npm test` must then pass the parity test without any other change.
- [ ] Create `components/landing/v2/LandingV2.tsx` with the header and hero (7.3b adds the sections between the hero and the footer, at the marked line):

```tsx
import Image, { getImageProps } from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { routing } from "@/i18n/routing";
import { OPERATOR, legalPublished } from "@/lib/legal";
import { signupOpen } from "@/lib/data/signups";
import { Wordmark } from "@/components/landing/Wordmark";
import { LegalLinks } from "@/components/landing/LegalLinks";
import type { V2Image } from "./types";
import { HERO_PHONE_CROP, HERO_WIDE } from "./photos";
import { HERO_CREW } from "./shots";
import { FLAGS } from "./content";
import { demoMailto, operatorAddress, operatorName, telHref } from "./contact";

type T = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getTranslations>>;

/**
 * The Slovenian landing page (v2).
 *
 * Built from the founder-approved brochure copy in the visual language of the
 * Salzburg deck: a real roof first, then the problem, then the product shown on
 * a phone at a size where it can be read. Every claim on it is either true
 * today or switched off in content.ts until a task proves it.
 */
export async function LandingV2({ locale, signInHref }: { locale: string; signInHref: string }) {
  const [t, tLanding] = await Promise.all([getTranslations("landing2"), getTranslations("landing")]);

  // The self-serve door exists only while signup is open: Task 4.3's signupOpen()
  // (the SIGNUP_OPEN kill switch of Task 0.4 AND the legal pages published), the
  // same check the login page uses (Task 4.9), so the landing never links a closed door.
  const startHref = signupOpen() ? `/${locale}/registracija` : null;
  const mailto = OPERATOR.email ? demoMailto(OPERATOR.email, t("mail.subject"), t("mail.body")) : null;
  const published = legalPublished();

  const ctas = (
    <div className="lp2-ctas">
      {startHref && (
        <Link href={startHref} className="lp2-btn lp2-btn--gold">
          {t("hero.start")}
        </Link>
      )}
      {mailto && (
        <a href={mailto} className={`lp2-btn ${startHref ? "lp2-btn--ghost" : "lp2-btn--gold"}`}>
          {t("hero.demo")}
        </a>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <main className="belin-dark lp lp2">
      <div className="e-grain" aria-hidden />

      <header className="lp2-top">
        <div className="lp2-in lp2-top-in">
          <Wordmark />
          <nav className="lp2-nav" aria-label={t("nav.label")}>
            <a href="#kako-deluje">{t("nav.how")}</a>
            <a href="#dokumenti">{t("nav.docs")}</a>
            <a href="#pilot">{t("nav.pilot")}</a>
            <a href="#vprasanja">{t("nav.faq")}</a>
          </nav>
          <div className="lp2-top-r">
            <Locales locale={locale} label={tLanding("languageLabel")} />
            <Link href={signInHref} className="lp2-signin">
              {t("nav.signIn")}
            </Link>
            {startHref ? (
              <Link href={startHref} className="lp2-btn lp2-btn--gold lp2-btn--sm lp2-top-start">
                {t("hero.start")}
              </Link>
            ) : (
              mailto && (
                <a href={mailto} className="lp2-btn lp2-btn--gold lp2-btn--sm lp2-top-start">
                  {t("hero.demo")}
                </a>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="lp2-hero" id="top" aria-labelledby="lp2-h1">
        <div className="lp2-hero-photo">
          <HeroPhoto alt={t("hero.photoAlt")} />
          {HERO_CREW && (
            <Image
              className="lp2-hero-phone"
              src={HERO_CREW.src}
              width={HERO_CREW.width}
              height={HERO_CREW.height}
              alt={t("hero.phoneAlt")}
              sizes="(max-width: 899px) 40vw, 290px"
            />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="lp2-in lp2-hero-grid">
          <div className="lp2-hero-copy">
            <p className="lp2-eyebrow">{t("hero.eyebrow")}</p>
            <h1 id="lp2-h1" className="lp2-h1">
              {t("hero.title1")}{" "}
              <span className="soft">{t("hero.title2")}</span>
            </h1>
            <p className="lp2-under">{t("hero.under")}</p>
            {ctas}
            <p className="lp2-offer">{t("hero.offer")}</p>
            <ul className="lp2-trust" aria-label={t("trust.label")}>
              <li>{FLAGS.functionsInFrankfurt ? t("trust.dataAndServers") : t("trust.data")}</li>
              <li>{t("trust.separation")}</li>
              <li>{t("trust.cookies")}</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* === 7.3b sections go here, in page order === */}

      <footer className="lp2-foot">
        <div className="lp2-in lp2-foot-grid">
          <div className="lp2-foot-id">
            <Wordmark />
            {published && (
              <p>{t("footer.operator", { name: operatorName(OPERATOR), address: operatorAddress(OPERATOR) })}</p>
            )}
            <p>{t("footer.data")}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="lp2-foot-links">
            {OPERATOR.email && <a href={`mailto:${OPERATOR.email}`}>{OPERATOR.email}</a>}
            {OPERATOR.phone && <a href={telHref(OPERATOR.phone)}>{OPERATOR.phone}</a>}
            <LegalLinks locale={locale} />
            <Locales locale={locale} label={tLanding("languageLabel")} />
          </div>
        </div>
        {published && (
          <p className="lp2-in lp2-copy">
            {t("footer.copyright", { year: String(new Date().getFullYear()), name: operatorName(OPERATOR) })}
          </p>
        )}
      </footer>
    </main>
  );
}

function Locales({ locale, label }: { locale: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <nav className="lp-locales" aria-label={label}>
      {routing.locales.map((l) => (
        <Link key={l} href={`/${l}`} aria-current={l === locale ? "page" : undefined}>
          {l}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
}

/**
 * The roof, art-directed: the wide photograph behind the words on a desk, a
 * 16:10 crop around the crew under the words on a phone. <picture> picks ONE
 * source, so a phone never downloads the 2000 px desktop photograph.
 * getImageProps is Next's documented way to do this; priority keeps it eager.
 */
function HeroPhoto({ alt }: { alt: string }) {
  const common = { alt, priority: true, fetchPriority: "high" as const };
  const {
    props: { srcSet: wide },
  } = getImageProps({ ...common, src: HERO_WIDE.src, width: HERO_WIDE.width, height: HERO_WIDE.height, sizes: "100vw" });
  const {
    props: { srcSet: narrow, ...img },
  } = getImageProps({
    ...common,
    src: HERO_PHONE_CROP.src,
    width: HERO_PHONE_CROP.width,
    height: HERO_PHONE_CROP.height,
    sizes: "calc(100vw - 32px)",
  });
  return (
    <picture>
      <source media="(min-width: 900px)" srcSet={wide} sizes="100vw" />
      <source media="(max-width: 899px)" srcSet={narrow} sizes="calc(100vw - 32px)" />
      <img {...img} alt={alt} />
    </picture>
  );
}

/** A picture, or until Task 7.2a has shot it, a marked empty slot that Gate 7 refuses. */
function Shot({
  img,
  alt,
  sizes,
  cssWidth,
  className,
}: {
  img: V2Image | null;
  alt: string;
  sizes: string;
  cssWidth?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  if (!img) return <div className={`lp2-slot ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} />;
  return (
    <Image
      src={img.src}
      width={img.width}
      height={img.height}
      alt={alt}
      sizes={sizes}
      className={className}
      data-css-width={cssWidth}
    />
  );
}
```

```css
/* === 7.3: Landing v2 (sl) === */
/* Everything is scoped under .lp2, which only the Slovenian v2 page carries.
   The page also carries .belin-dark and .lp, so it inherits the tokens, the
   ground, the grain and the existing .lp-three, .lp-card3 and .lp-strip rules. */
.lp2 { --lp2-max: 1180px; --lp2-gut: 26px; --lp2-head: 64px; }
.lp2 > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.lp2 [id] { scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--lp2-head) + 12px); }
html:has(.lp2) { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
.lp2-in { width: 100%; max-width: var(--lp2-max); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--lp2-gut); }

/* header: sticky, blurred, lockup visible at every width */
.lp2-top {
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
  background: rgba(8,14,22,.74); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--e-line);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2);
}
.lp2-top-in { height: var(--lp2-head); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
.lp2 .lp-wm { display: inline; }
.lp2-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-left: 14px; }
.lp2-nav a {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--e-ink2); text-decoration: none;
}
.lp2-nav a:hover { color: var(--e-ink); background: var(--e-surface); }
.lp2-top-r { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.lp2-signin {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px;
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--e-ink2); text-decoration: none;
}
.lp2-signin:hover { color: var(--e-ink); text-decoration: underline; }

/* buttons */
.lp2-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px;
  border-radius: 14px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: transform .16s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow .16s, background .16s;
}
.lp2-btn--gold { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--e-gold-2), var(--e-gold)); color: #0b1524; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -14px var(--e-glow); }
.lp2-btn--gold:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -12px var(--e-glow); }
.lp2-btn--ghost { color: var(--e-ink); background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); }
.lp2-btn--ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.11); }
.lp2-btn--sm { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13.5px; border-radius: 999px; }
.lp2 a:focus-visible, .lp2 button:focus-visible, .lp2 summary:focus-visible, .lp2 input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--e-gold); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 10px;
}

/* hero: the roof behind the words on a desk */
.lp2-hero { position: relative; isolation: isolate; min-height: min(86vh, 820px); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; overflow: hidden; }
.lp2-hero-photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; }
.lp2-hero-photo picture, .lp2-hero-photo picture img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 62% 40%; }
.lp2-hero::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5,9,15,.94) 0%, rgba(5,9,15,.80) 36%, rgba(5,9,15,.28) 64%, rgba(5,9,15,.08) 100%),
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(5,9,15,.96) 0%, rgba(5,9,15,0) 40%);
}
.lp2-hero-phone {
  position: absolute; z-index: 1; height: auto; width: clamp(220px, 20vw, 290px);
  right: max(var(--lp2-gut), calc((100% - var(--lp2-max)) / 2 + var(--lp2-gut))); bottom: 28px;
}
.lp2-hero-grid { padding-top: 120px; padding-bottom: 72px; }
.lp2-hero-copy { max-width: 620px; }
.lp2-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--e-gold); }
.lp2-h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(36px, 5.4vw, 64px); line-height: 1.03; letter-spacing: -.03em; font-weight: 800; text-wrap: balance; color: var(--e-ink); }
.lp2-h1 .soft, .lp2-h2 .soft { display: block; color: var(--e-ink2); font-weight: 700; }
.lp2-under { margin: 18px 0 0; max-width: 46ch; font-size: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 19px); line-height: 1.5; color: var(--e-ink2); }
.lp2-ctas { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 28px; }
.lp2-offer { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--e-ink2); }
.lp2-trust { list-style: none; margin: 22px 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 18px; }
.lp2-trust li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--e-ink2); }
.lp2-trust li::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--e-gold); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--e-glow); }

/* an image Task 7.2a has not shot yet: visible, and refused by Gate 7 */
.lp2-slot {
  aspect-ratio: 390 / 844; width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 12px, transparent 12px 24px);
}

/* footer */
.lp2-foot { padding: 44px 0 calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-top: 1px solid var(--e-line); font-size: 13px; color: var(--e-muted); }
.lp2-foot-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px 40px; }
.lp2-foot-id p { margin: 12px 0 0; max-width: 52ch; line-height: 1.55; }
.lp2-foot-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 18px; }
.lp2-foot a { color: var(--e-ink2); text-decoration: none; }
.lp2-foot a:hover { color: var(--e-ink); text-decoration: underline; }
.lp2-copy { margin-top: 22px; }

@media (max-width: 1079px) { .lp2-nav { display: none; } }
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .lp2 { --lp2-gut: 16px; --lp2-head: 56px; }
  .lp2-top .lp-locales { display: none; }
  .lp2-hero { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; min-height: 0; overflow: visible; }
  .lp2-hero::before { display: none; }
  .lp2-hero-grid { order: 1; padding-top: 28px; padding-bottom: 24px; }
  .lp2-hero-photo { order: 2; position: relative; inset: auto; z-index: 0; margin: 0 var(--lp2-gut); aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }
  .lp2-hero-photo picture img { border-radius: 18px; }
  .lp2-hero-phone { right: 10px; bottom: -40px; width: 40%; }
  .lp2-ctas .lp2-btn { flex: 1 1 100%; }
}
@media (max-width: 559px) { .lp2-top-start { display: none; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html:has(.lp2) { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  .lp2-btn { transition: none; }
  .lp2-btn--gold:hover { transform: none; }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import sharp from "sharp";
import { LANDING_V2_LOCALES, usesLandingV2 } from "@/components/landing/v2/locales";
import { demoMailto, formatFileSize, telHref } from "@/components/landing/v2/contact";
import { ABOUT, HERO_PHONE_CROP, HERO_WIDE } from "@/components/landing/v2/photos";
import { HERO_CREW, PROOF, STEPS } from "@/components/landing/v2/shots";
import { LOOP } from "@/components/landing/v2/loop";
import { SAMPLES } from "@/components/landing/v2/samples";
import type { V2Image } from "@/components/landing/v2/types";

const pub = (src: string) => path.resolve(__dirname, "../public", src.replace(/^\//, ""));

describe("landing v2 switch", () => {
  it("renders v2 for Slovenian only until the translation pass", () => {
    expect([...LANDING_V2_LOCALES]).toEqual(["sl"]);
    expect(usesLandingV2("sl")).toBe(true);
    expect(usesLandingV2("de")).toBe(false);
    expect(usesLandingV2("en")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("landing v2 contact helpers", () => {
  it("encodes the demo mail so spaces stay spaces in every mail app", () => {
    const href = demoMailto("info@example.com", "Belin: predstavitev", "Pozdravljeni,\nPodjetje:");
    expect(href).toBe("mailto:info@example.com?subject=Belin%3A%20predstavitev&body=Pozdravljeni%2C%0APodjetje%3A");
    expect(href).not.toContain("+");
  });

  it("dials a number written for people", () => {
    expect(telHref("+386 30 252 069")).toBe("tel:+38630252069");
  });

  it("prints file sizes the Slovenian way", () => {
    expect(formatFileSize(350_000)).toBe("342 KB");
    expect(formatFileSize(1_258_291)).toBe("1,2 MB");
  });
});

describe("landing v2 pictures and samples", () => {
  const images: [string, V2Image | null][] = [
    ["HERO_WIDE", HERO_WIDE],
    ["HERO_PHONE_CROP", HERO_PHONE_CROP],
    ...ABOUT.map((a) => [`ABOUT ${a.key}`, a] as [string, V2Image]),
    ["HERO_CREW", HERO_CREW],
    ...Object.entries(STEPS).map(([k, v]) => [`STEPS ${k}`, v] as [string, V2Image | null]),
    ["PROOF crew", PROOF.crew],
    ["PROOF epc", PROOF.epc],
  ];

  // Null means "not shot yet" and is allowed here; Gate 7 refuses it on the page.
  it.each(images.filter(([, img]) => img !== null))("%s exists with the size the manifest states", async (_, img) => {
    const file = pub(img!.src);
    expect(existsSync(file)).toBe(true);
    const meta = await sharp(file).metadata();
    expect([meta.width, meta.height]).toEqual([img!.width, img!.height]);
  });

  it("has the loop files when the loop is declared", () => {
    if (!LOOP) return;
    expect(existsSync(pub(LOOP.src))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(pub(LOOP.poster))).toBe(true);
  });

  // vitest refuses an empty it.each table, and SAMPLES is empty until Task 7.2a.
  if (SAMPLES.length === 0) {
    it("has no samples until Task 7.2a exports them", () => expect(SAMPLES).toEqual([]));
  } else {
    it.each(SAMPLES.map((s) => [s.key, s] as const))("sample %s is a real PDF under 8 MB", (_, s) => {
      const file = pub(s.href);
      expect(existsSync(file)).toBe(true);
      expect(statSync(file).size).toBe(s.bytes);
      expect(s.bytes).toBeLessThan(8 * 1024 * 1024);
      expect(readFileSync(file).subarray(0, 5).toString()).toBe("%PDF-");
      expect(existsSync(pub(s.thumb))).toBe(true);
    });
  }
});
```

```tsx
function Roles({ t }: { t: T }) {
  return (
    <section className="lp2-roles" aria-label={t("roles.label")}>

        <a className="lp2-role" href="#kako-deluje">

          <p>{t("roles.epcBody")}</p>
          <span>{t("roles.epcCta")}</span>

        <a className="lp2-role" href="#podizvajalci">
          <h2>{t("roles.subTitle")}</h2>
          <p>{t("roles.subBody")}</p>
          <span>{t("roles.subCta")}</span>
        </a>
      </div>

}

function MoneyLeaks({ t }: { t: T }) {

  return (
    <section className="lp2-sec" id="kje-se-izgubi-denar" aria-labelledby="lp2-money-t">
      <div className="lp2-in">
        <div className="lp2-head">
          <p className="lp2-eyebrow">{t("money.eyebrow")}</p>
          <h2 id="lp2-money-t" className="lp2-h2">{t("money.title")}</h2>
          <p className="lp2-lead">{t("money.lead")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="lp-three">
          {blocks.map((n) => (
            <article key={n} className="lp-card3">
              <h3 className="lp-card3-t">{t(`money.b${n}t`)}</h3>
              <p className="lp-card3-b">{t(`money.b${n}b`)}</p>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function HowItWorks({ t }: { t: T }) {
  const steps = [
    { n: "01", key: "plan", title: t("how.s1t"), body: t("how.s1b"), alt: t("how.s1alt") },
    { n: "02", key: "report", title: t("how.s2t"), body: t("how.s2b"), alt: t("how.s2alt") },
    {
      n: "03",
      key: "hours",
      title: t("how.s3t"),
      body: FLAGS.regieClauseOnPo ? t("how.s3bClause") : t("how.s3bPlain"),
      alt: t("how.s3alt"),
    },
    { n: "04", key: "close", title: t("how.s4t"), body: t("how.s4b"), alt: t("how.s4alt") },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <section className="lp2-sec" id="kako-deluje" aria-labelledby="lp2-how-t">
      <div className="lp2-in">
        <div className="lp2-head">
          <p className="lp2-eyebrow">{t("how.eyebrow")}</p>
          <h2 id="lp2-how-t" className="lp2-h2">
            {t("how.title1")} <span className="soft">{t("how.title2")}</span>
          </h2>
        </div>
        <ol className="lp2-steps">
          {steps.map((s) => (
            <li key={s.key} className="lp2-step">
              <div className="lp2-step-text">
                <p className="lp2-step-num">{s.n}</p>
                <h3>{s.title}</h3>
                <p>{s.body}</p>
              </div>
              <figure className="lp2-shot">
                {/* 390 CSS px of real UI, shown 358 to 380 px wide: legible. */}
                <Shot img={STEPS[s.key]} alt={s.alt} sizes="(max-width: 899px) calc(100vw - 32px), 380px" cssWidth={390} />
              </figure>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function LiveProof({ t }: { t: T }) {

}

function Abroad({ t }: { t: T }) {
```

- [ ] Create `components/landing/v2/LoopVideo.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

/**
 * Ten silent seconds of a report landing live. Loaded only when scrolled to
 * (preload none), started only when on screen, never started for a visitor who
 * asked for reduced motion or less data. Rural LTE is design law 4.
 */
export function LoopVideo({
  src,
  poster,
  width,
  height,
  label,
}: {
  src: string;
  poster: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  label: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
    const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const saveData = (navigator as Navigator & { connection?: { saveData?: boolean } }).connection?.saveData === true;
    if (reduce || saveData) return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) void video.play().catch(() => {});
        else video.pause();
      },
      { threshold: 0.4 },
    );
    io.observe(video);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <video
      ref={ref}
      className="lp2-video"
      src={src}
      poster={poster}
      width={width}
      height={height}
      muted
      playsInline
      loop
      preload="none"
      aria-label={label}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/**
 * On a phone the hero's buttons scroll away in a second. After the hero has
 * left the screen, one thumb-reachable bar appears; it hides again over the
 * final call so the page never shows two sets of the same buttons.
 * Server and client both render it hidden, so hydration cannot disagree
 * (DECISIONS 2026-08-13); hidden also means inert, so the keyboard skips it.
 */
export function StickyCta({
  label,
  startHref,
  startLabel,
  demoHref,
  demoLabel,
}: {
  label: string;
  startHref: string | null;
  startLabel: string;
  demoHref: string | null;
  demoLabel: string;
}) {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const hero = document.getElementById("top");
    const end = document.getElementById("zacetek");
    if (!hero || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
    let heroVisible = true;
    let endVisible = false;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (entry.target === hero) heroVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
        if (entry.target === end) endVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
      }
      setShow(!heroVisible && !endVisible);
    });
    io.observe(hero);
    if (end) io.observe(end);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);

  if (!startHref && !demoHref) return null;
  return (
    <div className="lp2-sticky" data-show={show ? "1" : "0"} role="region" aria-label={label} aria-hidden={!show} inert={!show}>
      {startHref && (
        <Link href={startHref} className="lp2-btn lp2-btn--gold">
          {startLabel}
        </Link>
      )}
      {demoHref && (
        <a href={demoHref} className={`lp2-btn ${startHref ? "lp2-btn--ghost" : "lp2-btn--gold"}`}>
          {demoLabel}
        </a>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
/** Open Graph wants language_TERRITORY (https://ogp.me/), not the bare route locale. */
const OG_LOCALE: Record<string, string> = { sl: "sl_SI", de: "de_DE", en: "en_GB" };

export function ogLocale(locale: string): string {
  return OG_LOCALE[locale] ?? "sl_SI";
}

export function ogAlternates(locale: string): string[] {
  return Object.entries(OG_LOCALE)
    .filter(([l]) => l !== locale)
    .map(([, value]) => value);
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * The Slovenian v2 page states its own title, description and share card; the
 * German and English pages keep the layout's until their translation pass.
 * openGraph is replaced whole by Next's metadata merge, so it is complete here.
 * "?v=2" because WhatsApp and Facebook cache a preview by image URL.
 */
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ locale: string }> }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { locale } = await params;
  if (!usesLandingV2(locale)) return {};
  const t = await getTranslations({ locale, namespace: "landing2" });
  const title = t("meta.title");
  const description = t("meta.description");
  const image = `/og/belin-${locale}.jpg?v=2`;
  return {
    title,
    description,
    openGraph: {
      type: "website",
      siteName: "Belin",
      locale: ogLocale(locale),
      alternateLocale: ogAlternates(locale),
      url: `/${locale}`,
      title,
      description,
      images: [{ url: image, width: 1200, height: 630, alt: t("meta.ogAlt") }],
    },
    twitter: { card: "summary_large_image", title, description, images: [image] },
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { appBaseUrl } from "@/lib/app-url";
import { OPERATOR, legalPublished } from "@/lib/legal";
import { operatorName } from "./contact";

/**
 * Who Belin is, for search engines. Facts only: no rating, no review, no price
 * (Google shows no rich result without a rating, and Belin will not invent one;
 * "free" as an offer would misstate a pilot).
 */
export function JsonLd({ description }: { description: string }) {
  const base = appBaseUrl();
  if (!base) return null;
  const published = legalPublished();
  const org: Record<string, unknown> = {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "@id": `${base}/#organization`,
    name: "Belin",
    url: base,
    logo: `${base}/icons/icon-512.png`,
    ...(OPERATOR.email ? { email: OPERATOR.email } : {}),
    ...(OPERATOR.phone ? { telephone: OPERATOR.phone } : {}),
    ...(published
      ? {
          legalName: operatorName(OPERATOR),
          address: {
            "@type": "PostalAddress",
            streetAddress: OPERATOR.street,
            postalCode: OPERATOR.zip,
            addressLocality: OPERATOR.city,
            addressCountry: OPERATOR.country,
          },
        }
      : {}),
  };
  const app = {
    "@type": "SoftwareApplication",
    name: "Belin",
    applicationCategory: "BusinessApplication",
    operatingSystem: "Web",
    inLanguage: ["sl", "de", "en"],
    url: `${base}/sl`,
    description,
    publisher: { "@id": `${base}/#organization` },
  };
  const json = JSON.stringify({ "@context": "https://schema.org", "@graph": [org, app] }).replace(/</g, "\\u003c");
  return <script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: json }} />;
}
```

```ts
import { routing } from "@/i18n/routing";
import { appBaseUrl } from "@/lib/app-url";

/** Public pages are the landing and the legal pages; everything behind a login, a token or the presenter door is not for crawlers. */
export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  const base = appBaseUrl();
  const perLocale = routing.locales.flatMap((l) => [
    `/${l}/app`,
    `/${l}/p/`,
    `/${l}/auth/`,
    `/${l}/invite/`,
    `/${l}/demo/`,
    `/${l}/registracija/potrdi`,
  ]);
  return {
    rules: [{ userAgent: "*", allow: "/", disallow: ["/api/", "/app", "/p/", ...perLocale] }],
    ...(base ? { sitemap: `${base}/sitemap.xml` } : {}),
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";
import { routing } from "@/i18n/routing";
import { appBaseUrl } from "@/lib/app-url";
import { legalPublished } from "@/lib/legal";

/** The landing in three languages, and the legal pages once an operator is named. No invented lastModified dates. */
export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  const base = appBaseUrl();
  if (!base) return [];
  const languages = Object.fromEntries(routing.locales.map((l) => [l, `${base}/${l}`]));
  const landing = routing.locales.map((l) => ({
    url: `${base}/${l}`,
    changeFrequency: "monthly" as const,
    priority: l === "sl" ? 1 : 0.8,
    alternates: { languages },
  }));
  // Add Task 4.8's terms path here if it created one (read app/[locale]/ for the folder name).
  const legalPaths = ["impressum", "zasebnost"];
  const legal = legalPublished()
    ? routing.locales.flatMap((l) =>
        legalPaths.map((p) => ({ url: `${base}/${l}/${p}`, changeFrequency: "yearly" as const, priority: 0.3 })),
      )
    : [];
  return [...landing, ...legal];
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The cost of paper, from the visitor's own three numbers and nothing else.
 * No savings percentage is computed: Belin has no measured one, and the page
 * says so (founder mandate 2026-08-13).
 */
export interface PaperCost {
  hoursPerYear: number;
  costPerYear: number;
}

export function paperCost(projectsPerYear: number, hoursPerProject: number, hourlyCost: number): PaperCost {
  const hoursPerYear = projectsPerYear * hoursPerProject;
  return { hoursPerYear, costPerYear: hoursPerYear * hourlyCost };
}

/**
 * A number as a Slovenian types it: "12", "12,5", "1.200", "1.200,50", and also
 * "12.5" from someone used to a decimal point. Null for anything else,
 * including negatives.
 */
export function parseSlNumber(raw: string): number | null {
  const s = raw.replace(/[\s ]/g, "");
  if (s === "") return null;
  let normalized: string;
  if (s.includes(",")) normalized = s.replace(/\./g, "").replace(",", ".");
  else if (/^\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+$/.test(s)) normalized = s.replace(/\./g, "");
  else normalized = s;
  if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(normalized)) return null;
  const n = Number(normalized);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { paperCost, parseSlNumber } from "@/lib/landing/paper-cost";

const NF1 = new Intl.NumberFormat("sl-SI", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
const NF0 = new Intl.NumberFormat("sl-SI", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });

export interface PaperCostCopy {
  projects: string;
  hours: string;
  hoursHint: string;
  rate: string;
  invalid: string;
  empty: string;
  /** Templates with {hours}, {amount}, {projects}, {rate}, {total}, filled here. */
  resultHours: string;
  resultMoney: string;
  formula: string;
  note: string;
  privacy: string;
}

function fill(template: string, values: Record<string, string>): string {
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, key: string) => values[key] ?? "");
}

/** Three inputs, one multiplication, the formula shown. Nothing is stored or sent. */
export function PaperCost({ copy }: { copy: PaperCostCopy }) {
  const id = useId();
  const [raw, setRaw] = useState({ projects: "", hours: "", rate: "" });
  const parsed = {
    projects: parseSlNumber(raw.projects),
    hours: parseSlNumber(raw.hours),
    rate: parseSlNumber(raw.rate),
  };
  const filled = raw.projects !== "" && raw.hours !== "" && raw.rate !== "";
  const valid = parsed.projects !== null && parsed.hours !== null && parsed.rate !== null;
  const result = valid ? paperCost(parsed.projects!, parsed.hours!, parsed.rate!) : null;

  const field = (key: "projects" | "hours" | "rate", label: string, hint?: string) => {
    const bad = raw[key] !== "" && parsed[key] === null;
    return (
      <label htmlFor={`${id}-${key}`}>
        {label}
        {hint && <span className="lp2-cost-hint">{hint}</span>}
        <input
          id={`${id}-${key}`}
          inputMode="decimal"
          autoComplete="off"
          value={raw[key]}
          aria-invalid={bad}
          aria-describedby={bad ? `${id}-${key}-err` : undefined}
          onChange={(e) => setRaw((r) => ({ ...r, [key]: e.target.value }))}
        />
        {bad && (
          <span id={`${id}-${key}-err`} className="lp2-cost-hint" role="alert">
            {copy.invalid}
          </span>
        )}
      </label>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="lp2-cost">
      <div className="lp2-cost-form">
        {field("projects", copy.projects)}
        {field("hours", copy.hours, copy.hoursHint)}
        {field("rate", copy.rate)}
        <p className="lp2-cost-note">{copy.privacy}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="lp2-cost-out" aria-live="polite">
        {result ? (
          <>
            <p className="lp2-cost-big">{fill(copy.resultMoney, { amount: NF0.format(result.costPerYear) })}</p>
            <p className="lp2-cost-sub">{fill(copy.resultHours, { hours: NF1.format(result.hoursPerYear) })}</p>
            <p className="lp2-cost-formula">
              {fill(copy.formula, {
                projects: NF1.format(parsed.projects!),
                hours: NF1.format(parsed.hours!),
                rate: NF1.format(parsed.rate!),
                total: NF0.format(result.costPerYear),
              })}
            </p>
            <p className="lp2-cost-note">{copy.note}</p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="lp2-cost-sub">{filled ? copy.invalid : copy.empty}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

  The ICU placeholders are passed through as literal templates, so in `LandingV2.tsx` read them with `t.raw("cost.resultHours")` (next-intl returns the unformatted string) and the plain ones with `t(...)`.

```js
//   BASE=https://getbelin.com OUT=.tmp-qa/landing-prod node scripts/landing/check.mjs --perf --claims

import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { extractText, getDocumentProxy } from "unpdf";

// Raw catalog keys and en or em dashes must never reach the page either.

if (process.env.BUYER_NAME) DENY.push(process.env.BUYER_NAME);

// The same throttling the recon measured with (recon/landing/perf.mjs).

  desk: { viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 },
};

const failures = [];

const ok = (m) => console.log(`ok   ${m}`);
const check = (cond, m) => (cond ? ok(m) : fail(m));
const clean = (label, text) => { const hits = DENY.filter((w) => text.includes(w)); check(hits.length === 0, `${label}: no forbidden text${hits.length ? ` (${hits.join(", ")})` : ""}`); };

async function inspect(browser, locale, kind) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ ...VIEW[kind], locale: "sl-SI" });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const errors = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (e) => errors.push(e.message));
  page.on("console", (m) => { if (m.type() === "error") errors.push(m.text()); });

  const res = await page.goto(`${BASE}/${locale}`, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
  const label = `${locale} ${kind}`;
  check(res?.status() === 200, `${label}: 200`);
  check((await page.$("[data-splash]")) === null, `${label}: no splash in a browser`);

  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    for (let y = 0; y < document.body.scrollHeight; y += 400) { window.scrollTo(0, y); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120)); }
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  });
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle").catch(() => {});

  const r = await page.evaluate(() => ({
    overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth,
    slots: document.querySelectorAll(".lp2-slot, .lp-shot-slot").length,
    v2: !!document.querySelector(".lp2"),
    h1: document.querySelector("h1")?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() ?? "",
    text: document.body.innerText,
    imgs: [...document.images].map((i) => ({ src: i.currentSrc || i.src, loaded: i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0, w: i.getBoundingClientRect().width, css: Number(i.dataset.cssWidth || 0) })),
    anchors: [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]')].map((a) => a.getAttribute("href")).filter((h) => h.length > 1 && !document.querySelector(h)),
    links: [...new Set([...document.querySelectorAll("a[href]")].map((a) => a.getAttribute("href")))],
  }));
  check(r.overflow <= 0, `${label}: no horizontal scroll (${r.overflow})`);
  check(r.slots === 0, `${label}: no empty picture slot (${r.slots})`);
  check(r.anchors.length === 0, `${label}: every in-page anchor has a target ${r.anchors.join(" ")}`);
  const broken = r.imgs.filter((i) => !i.loaded);
  check(broken.length === 0, `${label}: every image loaded ${broken.map((b) => b.src).join(" ")}`);
  for (const img of r.imgs.filter((i) => i.css > 0)) {
    const ratio = img.w / img.css;
    check(ratio >= 0.85, `${label}: legible ${img.src.split("url=")[1]?.split("&")[0] ?? img.src} at ${img.w.toFixed(0)} px (scale ${ratio.toFixed(2)})`);
  }
  clean(label, r.text);
  check(errors.length === 0, `${label}: no console errors ${errors.join(" | ")}`);

  if (locale === "sl") {
    check(r.v2, `${label}: renders v2`);
    check(r.h1 === "Delo je narejeno. Denar se zatakne pri papirju.", `${label}: headline "${r.h1}"`);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 1500));
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    check((await page.locator(".lp2-top").boundingBox())?.y === 0, `${label}: header sticks`);
    const sticky = page.locator(".lp2-sticky");
    if (kind === "phone") {
      await page.locator("#kako-deluje").scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      check((await sticky.getAttribute("data-show")) === "1", `${label}: bottom bar shows after the hero`);
      const box = await sticky.boundingBox();
      check(box && Math.round(box.y + box.height) === 844, `${label}: bottom bar sits on the bottom edge`);
    } else {
      check((await sticky.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).display)) === "none", `${label}: no bottom bar on a desk`);
    }
  } else {
    check(!r.v2, `${label}: still v1 until the translation pass`);
  }

  // Slices to LOOK at, one viewport each.
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
  const height = await page.evaluate(() => document.body.scrollHeight);
  const step = VIEW[kind].viewport.height;
  let n = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y += step, n++) {
    await page.evaluate((top) => window.scrollTo(0, top), y);
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${locale}-${kind}-s${String(n).padStart(2, "0")}.png` });
  }
  console.log(`     ${label}: ${n} slices in ${OUT}`);
  await context.close();
  return r.links;
}

async function links(all) {
  for (const href of [...new Set(all)]) {
    if (href.startsWith("#")) continue;
    if (href.startsWith("mailto:")) { check(/^mailto:[^@?]+@[^?]+\?subject=/.test(href), `mailto has an address and a subject: ${href.slice(0, 60)}`); continue; }
    if (href.startsWith("tel:")) { check(/^tel:\+?\d{6,}$/.test(href), `tel is dialable: ${href}`); continue; }
    const url = new URL(href, BASE).toString();
    const res = await fetch(url, { redirect: "follow" });
    if (url.endsWith(".pdf")) {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
      check(res.status === 200 && (res.headers.get("content-type") ?? "").includes("pdf"), `download ${href}: ${res.status} ${res.headers.get("content-type")}`);
      check(Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(0, 5)).toString() === "%PDF-", `download ${href}: is a PDF`);
      const { text } = await extractText(await getDocumentProxy(bytes), { mergePages: true });
      clean(`download ${href}`, text);
    } else {
      check(res.status === 200, `link ${href}: ${res.status}`);
    }
  }
}

async function headAndMeta() {
  const html = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/sl`)).text();
  check(html.includes('property="og:locale" content="sl_SI"'), "sl: og:locale sl_SI");
  check(html.includes('hrefLang="x-default"') || html.includes('hreflang="x-default"'), "sl: hreflang x-default");
  const og = html.match(/property="og:image" content="([^"]+)"/)?.[1];
  const ogRes = og ? await fetch(og) : null;
  check(ogRes?.status === 200 && (ogRes.headers.get("content-type") ?? "").includes("jpeg"), `sl: og:image ${og}`);
  const ld = html.match(/<script type="application\/ld\+json">([^<]+)<\/script>/)?.[1];
  let parsed = null;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(ld ?? ""); } catch {}
  check(!!parsed, "sl: JSON-LD parses");
  check(!!ld && !/aggregateRating|"review"|"offers"/.test(ld), "sl: JSON-LD has no rating, review or offer");
  const robots = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/robots.txt`)).text();
  check(robots.includes("Disallow: /sl/app") && robots.includes("Sitemap:"), "robots.txt");
  const sitemap = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/sitemap.xml`)).text();
  check(sitemap.includes(`<loc>${BASE}/sl</loc>`) || sitemap.includes("/sl</loc>"), "sitemap.xml lists /sl");
}

async function perf(browser) {
  const runs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ ...VIEW.phone, locale: "sl-SI" });
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const cdp = await context.newCDPSession(page);
    await cdp.send("Network.enable");
    await cdp.send("Network.setCacheDisabled", { cacheDisabled: true });
    await cdp.send("Network.emulateNetworkConditions", FAST3G);
    await page.addInitScript(() => {
      window.__lcp = { t: 0, el: "" };
      new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        for (const e of list.getEntries()) window.__lcp = { t: e.startTime, el: `${e.element?.tagName ?? "?"}.${e.element?.className ?? ""} ${e.url ?? ""}`.slice(0, 160) };
      }).observe({ type: "largest-contentful-paint", buffered: true });
    });
    await page.goto(`${BASE}/sl`, { waitUntil: "load", timeout: 120000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
    const m = await page.evaluate(() => ({ lcp: Math.round(window.__lcp.t), el: window.__lcp.el, fcp: Math.round(performance.getEntriesByName("first-contentful-paint")[0]?.startTime ?? 0) }));
    console.log(`     fast 3G run ${i + 1}: FCP ${m.fcp} ms, LCP ${m.lcp} ms on ${m.el}`);
    runs.push(m.lcp);
    await context.close();
  }
  const median = runs.sort((a, b) => a - b)[1];
  check(median < 2500, `sl phone Fast 3G: median LCP ${median} ms under 2500`);
}

async function claims(browser) {
  const { PERSONA, OTHER_SUB_PROJECT, signedInContext } = await import("../marketing/session.mjs");
  for (const [who, mustSee] of [["sub", false], ["epc", true]]) {
    const context = await signedInContext(browser, PERSONA[who], { viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const res = await page.goto(`${BASE}/sl/app/${OTHER_SUB_PROJECT}`, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
    const sees = res?.status() === 200 && page.url().includes(OTHER_SUB_PROJECT) && (await page.locator(".e-bar, .e-proj-ring").count()) > 0;
    check(sees === mustSee, `${who} ${mustSee ? "sees" : "cannot see"} Montaža Kos's project (status ${res?.status()}, at ${new URL(page.url()).pathname})`);
    await context.close();
  }
}

const browser = await chromium.launch();
const found = [];
for (const locale of ["sl", "de", "en"]) {
  for (const kind of ["phone", "desk"]) found.push(...(await inspect(browser, locale, kind)));
}
await links(found);
await headAndMeta();
if (PERF) await perf(browser);
if (CLAIMS) await claims(browser);
await browser.close();

console.log(failures.length ? `\n${failures.length} FAILED` : "\nALL GREEN");
process.exit(failures.length ? 1 : 0);
```

  (The `.e-bar, .e-proj-ring` selectors come from `scripts/marketing/shoot.mjs`; if Wave 5 renamed the dashboard classes, use the selector `shoot.mjs` uses after Gate 5.)

## Wave 8: No-brainer extras (after Gate 5, only while the clock allows)

Wave 8 is the surprise layer. Nothing in it is needed for the meeting to work; each task makes one moment of the meeting stronger or makes tonight's self-serve signup safer. Every task is independent, lands as its own commit on its own branch, and can be skipped without touching any other task; a few pairs edit the same file and therefore never run at the same time (listed under the cut lines). Two tasks are P1 and should be attempted first: 8.1 (prove who sees what, because real customers enter the shared database tonight and the AVESOL conflict-of-interest question is the most likely objection in the room) and 8.2 (the one-page pilot agreement, which turns the meeting into a pilot with a date; 8.2 is not built tonight, the paper blank of Task 9.5 carries the close, see the run order). ### Rules every Wave 8 task follows

1. **Namespaces.** Each task owns exactly one NEW namespace in `messages/sl.json`, `de.json`, `en.json`, appended at the end of each file: `pilot` (8.2), `reportDraft` (8.3), `forYou` (8.4), `expiryAlert` (8.5), `penaltyGuard` (8.6), `evidence` (8.7), `receipt` (8.8), `shortfall` (8.9), `wallMode` (8.10). 8.1 adds no keys. Before adding, confirm the name is free: `node -e "const m=require('./messages/sl.json'); console.log(['pilot','reportDraft','forYou','expiryAlert','penaltyGuard','evidence','receipt','shortfall','wallMode'].filter(k=>k in m))"` must print `[]`. A task may READ keys from other namespaces (for example `hours.daysLeft`) but never edit them.
2. **Slovenian placeholders in de and en.** de and en carry the Slovenian string (founder mandate 2026-07-19). `tests/messages-parity.test.ts` has a test, "carry no Slovenian left over in de or en" (line 81 at e89f2de), that fails on exactly that. The ONE exemption mechanism is Task 1.4a's translation-debt ledger (01-index rule 6): no Wave 8 task edits `tests/messages-parity.test.ts`, and no prefix list, namespace exemption or `PENDING_*` array is ever added. Procedure for each task that adds keys: add the keys to all three catalogs, run `npm test -- tests/messages-parity.test.ts`, write exactly the keys it reports into the task's own ledger file `tests/translation-debt/<task-id>-<namespace>.json` (a JSON array of full keys, for example `tests/translation-debt/8.2a-pilot.json`; the ledger command in the Wave 4 preamble writes it: `node -e "..." 8.2a-pilot.json pilot`), rerun until green, and log "de and en carry Slovenian placeholders for namespace X (tests/translation-debt/<file>)" as debt in CHANGELOG.md.
3. **CSS.** A task that needs CSS appends one block at the very end of `app/globals.css`, opened by `/* === 8.N: <title> === */`, and never edits a rule above it. Colours use the existing `--e-*` tokens (or the semantic tokens Task 5.1 added, if 5.1 named an equivalent).
4. **Landing a task.** Branch `w8-<id>` from main in the free lane's worktree. When green (`npm test`, `npm run lint`), hand it to the orchestrator, who merges with `--no-ff`, re-runs both, pushes, waits for Vercel READY, and runs the task's production check. CHANGELOG.md lines go under `## 2026-10-06`. `git add` by path only.
5. **Screenshots are looked at.** Every PNG and PDF named in a Verify step is opened with the Read tool at the size it renders and described in one sentence in the session log. A file name is not evidence (memory: verify-rendered-geometry). Screenshots go to the executing session's scratchpad folder `w8/`, never into the repo.
6. **No em dash or en dash** in any string, comment, commit message or document. `grep -nP "[\x{2013}\x{2014}]" <changed files>` prints nothing before every commit.

### Shared verification helper (created by whichever Wave 8 task runs first, reused by the rest)

Wave 8 checks drive the real app as a real seeded person, the way `scripts/marketing/shoot.mjs` does, but with a session row instead of the email round trip. Create these two files if they do not exist yet; if they exist, use them unchanged.

`scripts/qa/persona.mjs`:
```js
// Signs a browser in as one seeded demo persona for a QA check, then cleans up.
//
// The session row is real, because a faked session proves nothing about the
// page a real person gets. It is deleted again when the work finishes, pass or
// fail. Personas are the seed's fixed ids (scripts/seed-demo.mjs). The key of
// the Demo Door is substituted for {DOOR} in a path so it never appears in a
// command line, a log or a chat.
import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const PERSONAS = {
  epc: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666605", // EPC office admin
  bauleiter: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666601", // EPC Bauleiter
  sub: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666603", // AVESOL office admin
  crew: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666602", // AVESOL crew
};
export const PROJECT_CURRENT = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333";
export const PROJECT_DAY1 = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333334";

export function base() {
  return (process.env.QA_BASE ?? "http://localhost:3000").replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

export function fillDoor(path) {
  return path.replaceAll("{DOOR}", process.env.DEMO_DOOR_KEY ?? "");
}

export async function withPersona(who, options, work) {
  const { width = 1440, height = 900, reducedMotion = false } = options ?? {};
  const personId = who === "none" ? null : PERSONAS[who];
  if (who !== "none" && !personId) throw new Error(`unknown persona ${who}`);

  const db = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  });

  let sessionId = null;
  let cookie = null;
  if (personId) {
    const raw = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
    const { data, error } = await db
      .from("sessions")
      .insert({
        person_id: personId,
        token_hash: createHash("sha256").update(raw, "utf8").digest("hex"),
        expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 20 * 60_000).toISOString(),
      })
      .select("id")
      .single();
    if (error) throw new Error(`session: ${error.message}`);
    sessionId = data.id;
    cookie = `p:${raw}`;
  }

  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  try {
    const mobile = width < 768;
    const context = await browser.newContext({
      viewport: { width, height },
      deviceScaleFactor: mobile ? 3 : 1,
      isMobile: mobile,
      hasTouch: mobile,
      locale: "sl-SI",
      reducedMotion: reducedMotion ? "reduce" : "no-preference",
    });
    if (cookie) await context.addCookies([{ name: "belin_session", value: cookie, url: base() }]);
    const page = await context.newPage();
    return await work(page, { db });
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
    if (sessionId) await db.from("sessions").delete().eq("id", sessionId);
  }
}
```

`scripts/qa/shot.mjs`:
```js
// One full-page screenshot of one screen as one persona, plus two numbers that
// are easy to fake by eye: horizontal overflow and console errors.
//
//   node --env-file=.env.local scripts/qa/shot.mjs --as crew --path /sl/app/<id> \
//        --out <scratchpad>/w8/x.png [--w 390 --h 844] [--reduced-motion] \
//        [--wait 1500] [--eval "<js expression>"]
//
// QA_BASE selects the server (default http://localhost:3000).
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { withPersona, base, fillDoor } from "./persona.mjs";

const args = {};
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
  if (!argv[i].startsWith("--")) continue;
  const next = argv[i + 1];
  args[argv[i].slice(2)] = next !== undefined && !next.startsWith("--") ? argv[++i] : "1";
}
if (!args.as || !args.path || !args.out) {
  console.error("usage: --as epc|bauleiter|sub|crew|none --path /sl/... --out file.png");
  process.exit(2);
}

const result = await withPersona(
  args.as,
  { width: Number(args.w ?? 1440), height: Number(args.h ?? 900), reducedMotion: Boolean(args["reduced-motion"]) },
  async (page) => {
    const consoleErrors = [];
    page.on("console", (m) => {
      if (m.type() === "error") consoleErrors.push(m.text());
    });
    await page.goto(base() + fillDoor(args.path), { waitUntil: "load", timeout: 60_000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(Number(args.wait ?? 1500));
    const overflowPx = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth);
    const measured = args.eval ? await page.evaluate(args.eval) : null;
    mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.resolve(args.out)), { recursive: true });
    await page.screenshot({ path: args.out, fullPage: true });
    return { url: page.url().replace(process.env.DEMO_DOOR_KEY || "\u0000", "{DOOR}"), overflowPx, measured, consoleErrors };
  },
);
console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
```

Both files are under `scripts/`, which tsconfig excludes, so `npm run lint` does not type-check them. They write one session row per run to the shared database and delete it again.

- [ ] **Step 4: The static guard over every server action.** A server action is a public HTTP endpoint; an exported function in a `"use server"` file that never asks who is calling is a hole that no page test finds. Create `tests/server-actions-guarded.test.ts`:
  ```ts
  import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
  import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
  import path from "node:path";

  // Every exported function in a "use server" file is a public endpoint: anyone
  // can call it with any arguments, page or no page. This test fails when one
  // of them never establishes who is calling. It cannot prove the check is the
  // RIGHT one (the live suite does that); it proves nobody forgot to ask.
  //
  // A local helper that itself calls a guard counts as a guard for that file,
  // which is how actorFor(), officeActor() and requirePerson() work today.

  const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
  const SCAN = ["app", "lib", "components"];

  const GUARDS = [
    "resolveActorFromSession(",
    "resolveActorFromToken(",
    "resolveTokenActorFromSession(",
    "requireProjectActor(",
    "requireOfficeActor(",
    // Demo Door (Task 2.3) and the pilot (Task 8.2a).
    "doorOpen(",
    "hasPresenterCookie(",
  ];

  // Public on purpose. Each entry was READ, and the reason says what protects it.
  const PUBLIC_BY_DESIGN: Record<string, string> = {
    "app/actions/auth.ts#requestMagicLink": "the login form; answers identically for every address",
    "app/actions/auth.ts#logoutAction": "ends the caller's own session only",
    "app/actions/auth.ts#loginAction": "DEMO_LOGIN password path, refuses unless DEMO_LOGIN is exactly 1",
    "app/actions/auth.ts#switchScenarioAction": "DEMO_LOGIN only, swaps between the two demo links",
    "app/[locale]/auth/verify/[token]/actions.ts#confirmLoginAction": "authorized by the single-use login token it consumes",
    "app/[locale]/invite/[token]/actions.ts#acceptInviteAction": "authorized by the invite token it consumes",
    "app/[locale]/p/[token]/claim-actions.ts#claimCrewAction": "authorized by the project link token, checked in findOrCreateCrewByEmail",
  };

  function filesUnder(dir: string): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
      const full = path.join(dir, name);
      if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) out.push(...filesUnder(full));
      else if (/\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(name)) out.push(full);
    }
    return out;
  }

  type Chunk = { name: string; exported: boolean; text: string };

  // Splits a file at top-level function declarations (column zero).
  function chunks(source: string): Chunk[] {
    const re = /^(export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+(\w+)\s*\(/gm;
    const starts = [...source.matchAll(re)];
    return starts.map((match, i) => ({
      name: match[2],
      exported: Boolean(match[1]),
      text: source.slice(match.index, i + 1 < starts.length ? starts[i + 1].index : source.length),
    }));
  }

  function unguardedActions(): string[] {
    const missing: string[] = [];
    for (const dir of SCAN) {
      for (const file of filesUnder(path.join(ROOT, dir))) {
        const source = readFileSync(file, "utf8");
        if (!/^\s*["']use server["']/.test(source)) continue;
        const rel = path.relative(ROOT, file).split(path.sep).join("/");
        const parts = chunks(source);
        const guards = [...GUARDS];
        for (const part of parts) {
          if (!part.exported && GUARDS.some((g) => part.text.includes(g))) guards.push(`${part.name}(`);
        }
        for (const part of parts) {
          if (!part.exported) continue;
          if (PUBLIC_BY_DESIGN[`${rel}#${part.name}`]) continue;
          if (!guards.some((g) => part.text.includes(g))) missing.push(`${rel}#${part.name}`);
        }
      }
    }
    return missing.sort();
  }

  describe("server actions", () => {
    it("all establish who is calling, or are listed as public on purpose", () => {
      expect(unguardedActions()).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("list no public exception that no longer exists", () => {
      for (const id of Object.keys(PUBLIC_BY_DESIGN)) {
        const [file, name] = id.split("#");
        const source = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), "utf8");
        expect(source, id).toMatch(new RegExp(`export\\s+async\\s+function\\s+${name}\\s*\\(`));
      }
    });
  });
  ```

  ```sql
  -- The browser holds the anon key, and the design relies on deny-all RLS for
  -- it (lib/supabase/client.ts). Two objects broke that rule.

  -- 1. The only public table created without RLS.
  alter table public.material_check_docs enable row level security;
  revoke all on table public.material_check_docs from anon, authenticated;

  -- 2. Functions are executable by PUBLIC by default, and Supabase also grants
  --    anon and authenticated explicitly. The app calls every one of these
  --    with the service role, so nobody else needs them. The SECURITY DEFINER
  --    one matters most: it writes projects with the owner's rights.
  -- create_project_from_review: the argument list is the one the live database
  -- prints just before this file is written (see below). Written here for the
  -- nine-argument signature Task 4.5a creates (p_scope added).
  revoke execute on function public.create_project_from_review(uuid, uuid, uuid, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, jsonb, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
  revoke execute on function public.submit_daily_report from public, anon, authenticated;
  revoke execute on function public.submit_material_check from public, anon, authenticated;
  revoke execute on function public.scope_installed from public, anon, authenticated;
  grant execute on function public.create_project_from_review(uuid, uuid, uuid, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, jsonb, jsonb) to service_role;
  grant execute on function public.submit_daily_report to service_role;
  grant execute on function public.submit_material_check to service_role;
  grant execute on function public.scope_installed to service_role;
  ```

  ```ts
  import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
  import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
  import path from "node:path";
  import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
  import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
  import { chromium, type Browser } from "playwright";

  // WHO SEES WHAT, proven against the real database and a running site.
  //
  // Writes, and removes again: one throwaway second EPC (with AVESOL as its
  // subcontractor, which is the situation Task 4.7 creates tonight) and one
  // session row per persona. Run by the orchestrator only, on main, at a gate:
  //   npm run test:authz                                  (localhost:3000)
  //   AUTHZ_BASE=https://getbelin.com npm run test:authz  (production)
  //
  // The second EPC never opens its own dashboard: rendering a dashboard claims
  // the subcontractor's document reminders (document_reminders is keyed by
  // document, not by project), and a test must not use up the demo's warning.

  vi.mock("server-only", () => ({}));

  import { requireOfficeActor, requireProjectActor, resolvePersonActor, type PersonActor } from "@/lib/actor";
  import { listProjectsForPerson } from "@/lib/data/projects-list";
  import { getPortfolio } from "@/lib/data/portfolio";
  import { listKnownSubs } from "@/lib/data/plan-imports";

  function env(name: string): string {
    const value = process.env[name];
    if (!value) throw new Error(`${name} is missing. Run this through npm run test:authz, which loads .env.local.`);
    return value;
  }

  const SUPABASE_URL = env("NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL");
  const admin = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, env("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"), { auth: { persistSession: false } });
  const anon = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, env("NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"), { auth: { persistSession: false } });
  const BASE = (process.env.AUTHZ_BASE ?? "http://localhost:3000").replace(/\/+$/, "");

  // The seed's fixed ids (scripts/seed-demo.mjs). If Wave 2 changed them, the
  // first test says so rather than every test failing mysteriously.
  const ORG = {
    epc: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
    avesol: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  } as const;
  const PROJECT = {
    current: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
    kosTrebnje: "3333333a-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
    kosVelenje: "3333333a-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
    vrhnika: "3333333a-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  } as const;
  const FIXTURE = {
    org: "a11ce000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    person: "a11ce000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
    project: "a11ce000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
  } as const;
  const PERSON = {
    epcAdmin: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666605",
    bauleiter: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666601",
    subAdmin: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666603",
    crew: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666602",
    epcB: FIXTURE.person,
  } as const;
  type Persona = keyof typeof PERSON;

  type ProjectRow = { id: string; name: string; epc_org_id: string; sub_org_id: string | null };
  type OrgRow = { id: string; name: string; iban: string | null };
  let projects: ProjectRow[] = [];
  let orgs: OrgRow[] = [];
  const isParty = (orgId: string, p: ProjectRow) => p.epc_org_id === orgId || p.sub_org_id === orgId;

  const actors = new Map<string, PersonActor>();
  async function actorOf(personId: string): Promise<PersonActor> {
    const cached = actors.get(personId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const actor = await resolvePersonActor(personId);
    if (!actor) throw new Error(`Person ${personId} does not resolve: the seed ids changed or the fixture failed.`);
    actors.set(personId, actor);
    return actor;
  }

  async function removeFixture(): Promise<void> {
    await admin.from("projects").delete().eq("id", FIXTURE.project);
    await admin.from("people").delete().eq("id", FIXTURE.person);
    await admin.from("organizations").delete().eq("id", FIXTURE.org);
  }

  async function createFixture(): Promise<void> {
    const org = await admin.from("organizations").insert({
      id: FIXTURE.org,
      type: "epc",
      name: "Preizkus dostopa d.o.o.",
      country: "si",
      is_demo: true,
    });
    if (org.error) throw new Error(`fixture org: ${org.error.message}`);
    const person = await admin.from("people").insert({
      id: FIXTURE.person,
      org_id: FIXTURE.org,
      full_name: "Preizkusna Oseba",
      role: "admin",
      email: null,
    });
    if (person.error) throw new Error(`fixture person: ${person.error.message}`);
    const project = await admin.from("projects").insert({
      id: FIXTURE.project,
      epc_org_id: FIXTURE.org,
      sub_org_id: ORG.avesol,
      name: "Preizkus dostopa, projekt B",
      country: "si",
      language: "sl",
      status: "active",
    });
    if (project.error) throw new Error(`fixture project: ${project.error.message}`);
  }

  const sessionIds: string[] = [];
  const cookieOf = new Map<Persona, string>();
  async function mintSession(personId: string): Promise<string> {
    const raw = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
    const { data, error } = await admin
      .from("sessions")
      .insert({
        person_id: personId,
        token_hash: createHash("sha256").update(raw, "utf8").digest("hex"),
        expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60_000).toISOString(),
      })
      .select("id")
      .single();
    if (error || !data) throw new Error(`session for ${personId}: ${error?.message}`);
    sessionIds.push(data.id);
    return `p:${raw}`;
  }

  let browser: Browser | undefined;
  let notFoundHeading: string | null = null;

  type Visit = { finalPath: string; heading: string | null; html: string };
  async function visit(cookie: string, pathname: string): Promise<Visit> {
    if (!browser) throw new Error("browser not started");
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, locale: "sl-SI" });
    try {
      await context.addCookies([{ name: "belin_session", value: cookie, url: BASE }]);
      const page = await context.newPage();
      await page.goto(BASE + pathname, { waitUntil: "load", timeout: 60_000 });
      // A redirect raised after streaming started arrives client side.
      await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle", { timeout: 5_000 }).catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      const heading = await page.locator("h1").first().textContent({ timeout: 3_000 }).catch(() => null);
      return { finalPath: new URL(page.url()).pathname, heading: heading?.trim() ?? null, html: await page.content() };
    } finally {
      await context.close();
    }
  }

  // Refused means: sent somewhere else, or shown the same page an id that does
  // not exist gets. Calibrated at start, so it survives Task 1.4's new 404.
  const refused = (v: Visit, requested: string) =>
    v.finalPath !== requested || (notFoundHeading !== null && v.heading === notFoundHeading);

  // Everything a persona must never see anywhere in a page, serialized props
  // included: names of projects its organization is not party to, and names of
  // organizations it shares no project with.
  function forbiddenFor(orgId: string): string[] {
    const mine = projects.filter((p) => isParty(orgId, p));
    const allowedNames = new Set(mine.map((p) => p.name));
    const partners = new Set<string>([orgId]);
    for (const p of mine) {
      partners.add(p.epc_org_id);
      if (p.sub_org_id) partners.add(p.sub_org_id);
    }
    const allowedOrgNames = new Set(orgs.filter((o) => partners.has(o.id)).map((o) => o.name));
    const projectNames = projects.filter((p) => !isParty(orgId, p) && !allowedNames.has(p.name)).map((p) => p.name);
    const orgNames = orgs.filter((o) => !partners.has(o.id) && !allowedOrgNames.has(o.name)).map((o) => o.name);
    return [...projectNames, ...orgNames].filter((s) => s.trim().length >= 6);
  }

  function publicTables(): string[] {
    const text = readFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname, "../lib/database.types.ts"), "utf8");
    const start = text.indexOf("    Tables: {");
    const end = text.indexOf("    Views: {", start);
    const names = [...text.slice(start, end).matchAll(/^      ([a-z_]+): \{\r?$/gm)].map((m) => m[1]);
    if (names.length < 30) throw new Error(`parsed only ${names.length} tables from lib/database.types.ts`);
    return names;
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    for (const id of [PERSON.epcAdmin, PERSON.bauleiter, PERSON.subAdmin, PERSON.crew]) {
      const { data } = await admin.from("people").select("id").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
      if (!data) throw new Error(`Seed person ${id} is missing: update PERSON in tests-live/authz.live.ts.`);
    }
    await removeFixture();
    await createFixture();

    const projectRes = await admin.from("projects").select("id, name, epc_org_id, sub_org_id");
    const orgRes = await admin.from("organizations").select("id, name, iban");
    if (projectRes.error || orgRes.error) throw new Error("could not read the oracle");
    projects = projectRes.data as ProjectRow[];
    orgs = orgRes.data as OrgRow[];

    for (const persona of Object.keys(PERSON) as Persona[]) {
      cookieOf.set(persona, await mintSession(PERSON[persona]));
    }
    browser = await chromium.launch();
    const calibration = await visit(cookieOf.get("epcAdmin")!, "/sl/app/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000");
    notFoundHeading = calibration.heading;
    if (!notFoundHeading) throw new Error("The not-found page has no h1, so refusals cannot be told from pages.");
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await browser?.close();
    if (sessionIds.length) await admin.from("sessions").delete().in("id", sessionIds);
    await removeFixture();
  });

  describe("the project gate, against every project in the database", () => {
    it.each(Object.keys(PERSON) as Persona[])("T1 %s reaches exactly the projects its organization is party to", async (persona) => {
      const actor = await actorOf(PERSON[persona]);
      const wrong: string[] = [];
      for (const p of projects) {
        const allowed = await requireProjectActor(actor, p.id).then(() => true, () => false);
        if (allowed !== isParty(actor.orgId, p)) wrong.push(`${p.name} (${p.id}): gate said ${allowed}`);
      }
      expect(wrong).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  describe("the cases the meeting promises", () => {

    it("T6 crew and Bauleiter are refused office acts", async () => {

  const ALLOWED: [Persona, string[]][] = [
    ["epcAdmin", ["/sl/app", `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}/hours`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}/po`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}/final`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.kosVelenje}`, "/sl/app/settings"]],
    ["subAdmin", ["/sl/app", `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}/hours`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}/po`, `/sl/app/${PROJECT.current}/final`, "/sl/app/settings"]],

    ["epcAdmin", [`/sl/app/${FIXTURE.project}`]],

  describe("pages on the running site", () => {

  describe("documents", () => {
    async function status(cookie: string, url: string): Promise<number> {

    it("T8 a naročilnica PDF opens only for the offices of its own project", async () => {
      const { data: pos } = await admin
        .from("purchase_orders")

        expect(await status(cookieOf.get("subAdmin")!, url), url).toBe(isParty(ORG.avesol, project) ? 200 : 404);
  ```

**Not built tonight** (run order): the meeting signs the paper blank from Task 9.5, whose text the founder approves at the 08:00 checkpoint. This task is the on-screen version for a later session, and it must then carry the same founder-approved text (Step 2).

**Why:** the meeting must end with a pilot, a project and a start date, not a promise (no-brainer ideas 26 and 42; market-benchmark section 4 idea 5: "pilot until Abnahme" ends the pilot on the product's best moment, J). There is no pilot file in the GTM base (docs/gtm/INDEX.md), so the terms below are a DRAFT the founder approves before it can be signed. The signature reuses the product's own SignaturePad, so the close uses the same gesture as the Zapisnik o prevzemu ten minutes earlier. An on-screen signature is a simple electronic signature, which "shall not be denied legal effect and admissibility as evidence in legal proceedings solely on the grounds that it is in an electronic form" (eIDAS, Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, Article 25(1), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32014R0910, accessed 2026-10-05). Tonight it is not started at all (see the note above): the paper blank of Task 9.5 is signed instead, and it carries the same text as Step 2.

**Founder approval is a hard stop.** The founder approves ONE pilot text at the 08:00 checkpoint, on the paper blank of Task 9.5. When this task is built, Step 2's keys are first brought in line with that approved text (Step 2, "One text, screen and paper"), and the orchestrator posts the resulting clause text to the founder in chat for a final yes. Code is built and verified with `PILOT_TEXT_APPROVED = false`, which shows the draft banner and refuses to sign. Flipping it to `true` is a one-line commit made only after the founder writes that he approves the text; it is allowed after the 12:00 freeze because the founder approves it himself.

  ```sql
  -- One row per signed pilot agreement. WRITE-ONCE: a signed agreement is
  -- evidence, so nothing in it may change after the insert except the two
  -- columns that record whether the emails went out, and no row may be deleted.
  create table public.pilot_agreements (
    id uuid primary key,
    created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
    text_version text not null,
    client_name text not null,
    client_address text,
    client_vat_id text,
    client_signer_name text not null,
    client_email text not null,
    provider_name text not null,
    provider_signer_name text not null,
    project_name text not null,
    start_date date not null,
    criterion_1 text not null,
    criterion_2 text not null,
    client_signature_path text not null,
    provider_signature_path text not null,
    pdf_path text not null,
    pdf_sha256 text not null check (pdf_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    emailed_client_status text,
    emailed_operator_status text
  );

  alter table public.pilot_agreements enable row level security;
  revoke all on table public.pilot_agreements from anon, authenticated;

  create or replace function public.pilot_agreements_write_once()
  returns trigger
  language plpgsql
  set search_path = public
  as $$
  begin
    if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
      raise exception 'pilot_agreements is write-once: rows cannot be deleted';
    end if;
    if (to_jsonb(new) - array['emailed_client_status', 'emailed_operator_status'])
       is distinct from
       (to_jsonb(old) - array['emailed_client_status', 'emailed_operator_status']) then
      raise exception 'pilot_agreements is write-once: only the email status may change';
    end if;
    return new;
  end;
  $$;

  revoke execute on function public.pilot_agreements_write_once() from public, anon, authenticated;

  create trigger pilot_agreements_write_once
    before update or delete on public.pilot_agreements
    for each row execute function public.pilot_agreements_write_once();
  ```
  Hand the file to the orchestrator, who applies it with `apply_migration`, runs `npm run gen:types` on main, and the lane rebases. Until then, steps 2 to 7 can be written; only the insert in Step 5 needs the new types.

- [ ] **Step 3: The pure text module.** Create `lib/pilot-text.ts`:
  ```ts
  // The pilot agreement's text and its assembly into a document input.
  //
  // Pure on purpose (no server-only, no database): the PDF test renders through
  // exactly the same function the server action uses, so the test sees the
  // document a customer signs, not a copy of it.
  import { docString } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
  import { formatTemplate } from "@/lib/notify-shared";
  import type { PilotDocInput } from "@/lib/pdf/pilot";

  /** Bumped whenever the clause text changes; printed on every signed copy. */
  export const PILOT_TEXT_VERSION = "2026-10-06-1";

  /**
   * False until the founder approves the text in chat. While false the page
   * shows the draft banner and the action refuses to sign.
   */
  export const PILOT_TEXT_APPROVED = false;

  export const CLAUSES = ["c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "c5", "c6", "c7", "c8", "c9"] as const;

  const ZONE = "Europe/Ljubljana";

  const t = (key: string, vars: Record<string, string> = {}) => formatTemplate(docString("sl", `pilot.${key}`), vars);

  export function dayLabel(iso: string): string {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sl-SI", { timeZone: ZONE, day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" }).format(
      new Date(`${iso.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00Z`),
    );
  }

  /** The calendar day of an instant at the site, not of its UTC date. */
  export function instantDayLabel(at: Date): string {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sl-SI", { timeZone: ZONE, day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" }).format(at);
  }

  export function clockLabel(at: Date): string {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sl-SI", { timeZone: ZONE, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false }).format(at);
  }

  /** The Monday after the given site-local day: the default start date. */
  export function nextMondayIso(todayIso: string): string {
    const day = new Date(`${todayIso.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00Z`);
    const add = ((8 - day.getUTCDay()) % 7) || 7;
    return new Date(day.getTime() + add * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  export interface PilotValues {
    clientName: string;
    clientAddress: string;
    clientVat: string;
    clientSigner: string;
    providerName: string;
    providerAddress: string;
    providerVat: string;
    providerSigner: string;
    projectName: string;
    startDate: string;
    criterion1: string;
    criterion2: string;
    signedAt: Date;
    docNo: string;
    clientSignature: Buffer;
    providerSignature: Buffer;
  }

  function party(name: string, address: string, vat: string, signer: string): string {
    return [name, address, vat ? t("doc.vat", { vat }) : "", t("doc.represented", { signer })]
      .filter((part) => part.trim().length > 0)
      .join(", ");
  }

  export function buildPilotDocInput(v: PilotValues): PilotDocInput {
    const vars = { project: v.projectName };
    return {
      title: t("doc.title"),
      docNo: t("doc.docNo", { no: v.docNo }),
      rows: [
        { label: t("doc.client"), value: party(v.clientName, v.clientAddress, v.clientVat, v.clientSigner) },
        { label: t("doc.provider"), value: party(v.providerName, v.providerAddress, v.providerVat, v.providerSigner) },
        { label: t("doc.project"), value: v.projectName },
        { label: t("doc.start"), value: dayLabel(v.startDate) },
      ],
      clauses: CLAUSES.map((c) => ({
        title: t(`doc.${c}Title`),
        body: t(`doc.${c}Body`, vars),
        items: c === "c7" ? [v.criterion1, v.criterion2] : undefined,
      })),
      signing: t("doc.signing", { version: PILOT_TEXT_VERSION }),
      client: { caption: t("doc.signClient"), name: v.clientSigner, image: v.clientSignature },
      provider: { caption: t("doc.signProvider"), name: v.providerSigner, image: v.providerSignature },
      signedAt: t("doc.signedAt", { date: instantDayLabel(v.signedAt), time: clockLabel(v.signedAt) }),
      generated: t("doc.generated"),
    };
  }
  ```
  `instantDayLabel` formats the signing instant in Ljubljana time, so a signature at 00:30 local time prints the right day; `dayLabel` is only for date-only values such as the start date.
- [ ] **Step 4: The presenter gate.** The pilot is gated by the presenter cookie, never by the key in its URL, because it is signed at the buyer's table: a key in the address bar, in the page's serialized props or in the done screen's download link would let a buyer who photographs the screen enter every persona until 13.10.
