  ```tsx
  // The one-page pilot agreement. Same paper, fonts and signature slots as the
  // Zapisnik o prevzemu, so the close of the meeting looks like the product.
  import { Document, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
  import { C, Footer, Header, LabelValue, SignatureBox, styles } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

  export interface PilotClause {
    title: string;
    body: string;
    items?: string[];
  }

  export interface PilotDocInput {
    title: string;
    docNo: string;
    rows: { label: string; value: string }[];
    clauses: PilotClause[];
    signing: string;
    client: { caption: string; name: string; image: Buffer };
    provider: { caption: string; name: string; image: Buffer };
    signedAt: string;
    generated: string;
  }

  export function PilotDocument(input: PilotDocInput) {
    return (
      <Document title={input.title}>
        <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
          <Header title={input.title} docNo={input.docNo} />

          <View style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
            {input.rows.map((row) => (
              <LabelValue key={row.label} label={row.label} value={row.value} />
            ))}
          </View>

          {input.clauses.map((clause) => (
            <View key={clause.title} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }} wrap={false}>
              <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 9, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 1.5 }}>{clause.title}</Text>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 8.6, lineHeight: 1.3, color: C.inkSoft }}>{clause.body}</Text>
              {clause.items?.map((item, i) => (
                <Text key={i} style={{ fontSize: 8.6, lineHeight: 1.3, color: C.ink, marginLeft: 10, marginTop: 1.5 }}>
                  {`${i + 1}. ${item}`}
                </Text>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}

          <Text style={{ fontSize: 8, color: C.muted, marginTop: 4 }}>{input.signing}</Text>

          <View style={{ marginTop: 14, flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between" }} wrap={false}>
            <SignatureBox name={input.client.name} image={input.client.image} caption={input.client.caption} />
            <SignatureBox name={input.provider.name} image={input.provider.image} caption={input.provider.caption} />
          </View>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 8, color: C.muted, marginTop: 4 }}>{input.signedAt}</Text>

          <Footer generatedLabel={input.generated} />
        </Page>
      </Document>
    );
  }
  ```

  Create `lib/data/pilot.ts`:
  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
  import { PilotDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/pilot";
  import { OPERATOR, legalPublished } from "@/lib/legal";
  import { PILOT_TEXT_APPROVED, PILOT_TEXT_VERSION, buildPilotDocInput } from "@/lib/pilot-text";

  // Signing a pilot agreement. Order matters, and every write is create-only:
  // the two signature images, then the PDF built from those exact bytes, then
  // ONE insert of the row that points at all three. Nothing is ever uploaded
  // with upsert, and storeReportPdf is deliberately not used, because it
  // deletes before writing and a signed agreement must never be overwritten.

  export interface PilotSignInput {
    clientName: string;
    clientAddress: string;
    clientVat: string;
    clientSigner: string;
    clientEmail: string;
    projectName: string;
    startDate: string;
    criterion1: string;
    criterion2: string;
    providerSigner: string;
    clientSignaturePng: Buffer;
    providerSignaturePng: Buffer;
  }

  export interface PilotSignResult {
    id: string;
    sha256: string;
    clientEmail: string;
    clientMail: "sent" | "failed" | "skipped";
    founderMail: "sent" | "failed" | "skipped";
  }

  export function operatorName(): string {
    return [OPERATOR.legalName, OPERATOR.legalForm].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
  }

  export function operatorAddress(): string {
    return [OPERATOR.street, [OPERATOR.zip, OPERATOR.city].filter(Boolean).join(" "), OPERATOR.country]
      .filter((part): part is string => Boolean(part && part.trim()))
      .join(", ");
  }

  export async function signPilotAgreement(input: PilotSignInput): Promise<PilotSignResult> {
    if (!PILOT_TEXT_APPROVED) throw new Error("pilot.errNotApproved");
    if (!legalPublished()) throw new Error("pilot.errOperator");

    const id = randomUUID();
    const signedAt = new Date();
    const db = createAdminClient();

    const clientSignaturePath = `pilot/${id}/narocnik.png`;
    const providerSignaturePath = `pilot/${id}/ponudnik.png`;
    for (const [target, bytes] of [
      [clientSignaturePath, input.clientSignaturePng],
      [providerSignaturePath, input.providerSignaturePng],
    ] as const) {
      const { error } = await db.storage.from("signatures").upload(target, bytes, { contentType: "image/png", upsert: false });
      if (error) throw new Error(`pilot signature upload: ${error.message}`);
    }

    const pdf = await renderDocument(
      PilotDocument(
        buildPilotDocInput({
          clientName: input.clientName,
          clientAddress: input.clientAddress,
          clientVat: input.clientVat,
          clientSigner: input.clientSigner,
          providerName: operatorName(),
          providerAddress: operatorAddress(),
          providerVat: OPERATOR.vatId ?? "",
          providerSigner: input.providerSigner,
          projectName: input.projectName,
          startDate: input.startDate,
          criterion1: input.criterion1,
          criterion2: input.criterion2,
          signedAt,
          docNo: id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase(),
          clientSignature: input.clientSignaturePng,
          providerSignature: input.providerSignaturePng,
        }),
      ),
    );
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(pdf).digest("hex");

    const pdfPath = `pilot/${id}.pdf`;
    const stored = await db.storage.from("reports").upload(pdfPath, pdf, { contentType: "application/pdf", upsert: false });
    if (stored.error) throw new Error(`pilot pdf upload: ${stored.error.message}`);

    const { error: insertError } = await db.from("pilot_agreements").insert({
      id,
      created_at: signedAt.toISOString(),
      text_version: PILOT_TEXT_VERSION,
      client_name: input.clientName,
      client_address: input.clientAddress || null,
      client_vat_id: input.clientVat || null,
      client_signer_name: input.clientSigner,
      client_email: input.clientEmail,
      provider_name: operatorName(),
      provider_signer_name: input.providerSigner,
      project_name: input.projectName,
      start_date: input.startDate,
      criterion_1: input.criterion1,
      criterion_2: input.criterion2,
      client_signature_path: clientSignaturePath,
      provider_signature_path: providerSignaturePath,
      pdf_path: pdfPath,
      pdf_sha256: sha256,
    });
    if (insertError) throw new Error(`pilot row: ${insertError.message}`);

    // 8.2b replaces this line with the two emails.
    return { id, sha256, clientEmail: input.clientEmail, clientMail: "skipped", founderMail: "skipped" };
  }

  export async function readPilotPdf(id: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const { data: row } = await db.from("pilot_agreements").select("pdf_path").eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
    if (!row) return null;
    const file = await db.storage.from("reports").download(row.pdf_path);
    if (file.error || !file.data) return null;
    return new Uint8Array(await file.data.arrayBuffer());
  }
  ```
- [ ] **Step 6: The action and the download route.** Create `app/[locale]/demo/pilot/actions.ts`:
  ```ts
  "use server";
  import { hasPresenterCookie } from "@/lib/demo/session";
  import { signPilotAgreement, type PilotSignResult } from "@/lib/data/pilot";

  // Returns error CODES rather than throwing: a production build blanks the
  // message of a thrown server-action error (Task 1.5's finding).

  export interface PilotFormPayload {
    clientName: string;
    clientAddress: string;
    clientVat: string;
    clientSigner: string;
    clientEmail: string;
    projectName: string;
    startDate: string;
    criterion1: string;
    criterion2: string;
    providerSigner: string;
    clientSignature: string;
    providerSignature: string;
  }

  export type PilotActionResult =
    | ({ ok: true } & PilotSignResult)
    | { ok: false; error: "forbidden" | "invalid" | "notApproved" | "operator" | "failed" };

  const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  const PNG_MAGIC = Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47]);

  function png(base64: unknown): Buffer | null {
    if (typeof base64 !== "string" || base64.length > 2_000_000) return null;
    const bytes = Buffer.from(base64, "base64");
    if (bytes.length < 100 || bytes.length > 1_500_000) return null;
    return bytes.subarray(0, 4).equals(PNG_MAGIC) ? bytes : null;
  }

  function text(value: unknown, min: number, max: number): string | null {
    if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    return trimmed.length >= min && trimmed.length <= max ? trimmed : null;
  }

  export async function signPilotAction(payload: PilotFormPayload): Promise<PilotActionResult> {
    if (!(await hasPresenterCookie())) return { ok: false, error: "forbidden" };

    const clientName = text(payload.clientName, 2, 200);
    const clientSigner = text(payload.clientSigner, 2, 120);
    const clientEmail = text(payload.clientEmail, 5, 200);
    const projectName = text(payload.projectName, 2, 200);
    const criterion1 = text(payload.criterion1, 5, 300);
    const criterion2 = text(payload.criterion2, 5, 300);
    const providerSigner = text(payload.providerSigner, 2, 120);
    const clientAddress = typeof payload.clientAddress === "string" ? payload.clientAddress.trim().slice(0, 300) : "";
    const clientVat = typeof payload.clientVat === "string" ? payload.clientVat.trim().slice(0, 30) : "";
    const startDate =
      typeof payload.startDate === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(payload.startDate) && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(payload.startDate))
        ? payload.startDate
        : null;
    const clientSignaturePng = png(payload.clientSignature);
    const providerSignaturePng = png(payload.providerSignature);

    if (
      !clientName || !clientSigner || !clientEmail || !EMAIL.test(clientEmail) || !projectName ||
      !criterion1 || !criterion2 || !providerSigner || !startDate || !clientSignaturePng || !providerSignaturePng
    ) {
      return { ok: false, error: "invalid" };
    }

    try {
      const result = await signPilotAgreement({
        clientName, clientAddress, clientVat, clientSigner, clientEmail, projectName, startDate,
        criterion1, criterion2, providerSigner, clientSignaturePng, providerSignaturePng,
      });
      return { ok: true, ...result };
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "";
      if (message === "pilot.errNotApproved") return { ok: false, error: "notApproved" };
      if (message === "pilot.errOperator") return { ok: false, error: "operator" };
      return { ok: false, error: "failed" };
    }
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
  import { hasPresenterCookie } from "@/lib/demo/session";
  import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";
  import { readPilotPdf } from "@/lib/data/pilot";

  export const runtime = "nodejs";
  export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

  export async function GET(
    _request: Request,
    { params }: { params: Promise<{ locale: string; id: string }> },
  ) {
    const { id } = await params;
    if (!(await hasPresenterCookie()) || !isUuid(id)) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });
    const bytes = await readPilotPdf(id);
    if (!bytes) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });
    return new NextResponse(bytes, {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
        "Content-Disposition": 'inline; filename="pilotni-dogovor.pdf"',
        "Cache-Control": "private, no-store",
      },
    });
  }
  ```

  Create `components/pilot/PilotForm.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  "use client";
  import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
  import { SignaturePad } from "@/components/SignaturePad";
  import { signPilotAction, type PilotActionResult } from "@/app/[locale]/demo/pilot/actions";

  // The pilot agreement, filled in at the table and signed by both.
  //
  // No door key anywhere in this component, its props or its links: the page,
  // the action and the download are gated by the presenter cookie (Step 4).
  //
  // The signature pads are read ONCE, when "Podpiši in pošlji" is pressed: the
  // latest canvas PNG is kept in state and nothing is uploaded per stroke
  // (the bug Task 3.1 fixed in the Zapisnik). If Task 3.1 changed
  // SignaturePad's interface, read the canvas the way 3.1's AcceptanceFlow does
  // at confirm time; the rule stays the same.

  const CLAUSES = ["c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "c5", "c6", "c7", "c8", "c9"] as const;

  async function toBase64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
    let binary = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
    return btoa(binary);
  }

  export function PilotForm({
    locale,
    canSign,
    provider,
    version,
    defaultStart,
  }: {
    locale: string;
    canSign: boolean;
    provider: { name: string; address: string; representative: string };
    version: string;
    defaultStart: string;
  }) {
    const t = useTranslations("pilot");
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [values, setValues] = useState({
      clientName: "",
      clientAddress: "",
      clientVat: "",
      clientSigner: "",
      clientEmail: "",
      projectName: "",
      startDate: defaultStart,
      criterion1: t("default.criterion1"),
      criterion2: t("default.criterion2"),
      providerSigner: provider.representative,
    });
    const [clientInk, setClientInk] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
    const [providerInk, setProviderInk] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
    const [result, setResult] = useState<PilotActionResult | null>(null);

    const set = (name: keyof typeof values) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
      setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: e.target.value }));

    const submit = () => {
      if (!clientInk || !providerInk) {
        setResult({ ok: false, error: "invalid" });
        return;
      }
      startTransition(async () => {
        const clientSignature = await toBase64(clientInk);
        const providerSignature = await toBase64(providerInk);
        const res = await signPilotAction({ ...values, clientSignature, providerSignature });
        setResult(res);
      });
    };

    if (result?.ok) {
      const mailLine = (status: string, email: string) =>
        status === "sent" ? t("done.mailed", { email }) : status === "failed" ? t("done.mailFailed", { email }) : null;
      return (
        <section className="pl8-done" aria-live="polite">
          <h2 className="pl8-h2">{t("done.title")}</h2>
          <p>{t("done.body")}</p>
          <p className="pl8-hash">{t("done.hash", { hash: result.sha256 })}</p>
          {mailLine(result.clientMail, result.clientEmail) ? <p>{mailLine(result.clientMail, result.clientEmail)}</p> : null}
          <div className="pl8-actions">
            <a className="hr-pdf" href={`/${locale}/demo/pilot/${result.id}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
              {t("done.download")}
            </a>
            <button type="button" className="pl8-again" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
              {t("done.again")}
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>
      );
    }

    const vars = { project: values.projectName || t("field.projectHint") };

    return (
      <div className="pl8-form">
        <div className="pl8-grid">
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.clientName")}</span><input className="b-field" value={values.clientName} onChange={set("clientName")} autoComplete="organization" /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.clientAddress")}</span><input className="b-field" value={values.clientAddress} onChange={set("clientAddress")} autoComplete="street-address" /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.clientVat")}</span><input className="b-field" value={values.clientVat} onChange={set("clientVat")} /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.clientSigner")}</span><input className="b-field" value={values.clientSigner} onChange={set("clientSigner")} autoComplete="name" /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.clientEmail")}</span><input className="b-field" type="email" inputMode="email" value={values.clientEmail} onChange={set("clientEmail")} autoComplete="email" /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.projectName")}</span><input className="b-field" value={values.projectName} onChange={set("projectName")} placeholder={t("field.projectHint")} /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.startDate")}</span><input className="b-field" type="date" value={values.startDate} onChange={set("startDate")} /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f"><span className="b-label">{t("field.providerSigner")}</span><input className="b-field" value={values.providerSigner} onChange={set("providerSigner")} /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f pl8-wide"><span className="b-label">{t("field.criterion1")}</span><textarea className="b-field" rows={2} value={values.criterion1} onChange={set("criterion1")} /></label>
          <label className="pl8-f pl8-wide"><span className="b-label">{t("field.criterion2")}</span><textarea className="b-field" rows={2} value={values.criterion2} onChange={set("criterion2")} /></label>
        </div>

        <section className="pl8-paper" aria-label={t("preview")}>
          <h2 className="pl8-paper-h">{t("doc.title")}</h2>
          {CLAUSES.map((c) => (
            <div key={c} className="pl8-clause">
              <b>{t(`doc.${c}Title`)}</b>
              <p>{t(`doc.${c}Body`, vars)}</p>
              {c === "c7" ? (
                <ol>
                  <li>{values.criterion1}</li>
                  <li>{values.criterion2}</li>
                </ol>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ))}
          <p className="pl8-version">{t("doc.signing", { version })}</p>
        </section>

        <div className="pl8-signs">
          <div>
            <span className="b-label">{t("signClient")}</span>
            <SignaturePad name={values.clientSigner} onCapture={setClientInk} disabled={!canSign || pending} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="b-label">{t("signProvider")}</span>
            <SignaturePad name={values.providerSigner} onCapture={setProviderInk} disabled={!canSign || pending} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {result && !result.ok ? <p className="ic-error" role="alert">{t(`err.${result.error}`)}</p> : null}
        <button type="button" className="b-btn pl8-submit" disabled={!canSign || pending} onClick={submit}>
          {pending ? t("submitting") : t("submit")}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```js
      await fields.nth(5).fill("Preizkusni projekt, Kranj");

          await page.mouse.up();

      await page.locator(".pl8-done").waitFor({ timeout: 60_000 });
  ```

  ```ts
  import { renderEmail, sendEmail } from "@/lib/email";
  import { appBaseUrl } from "@/lib/app-url";
  import { docString } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
  import { formatTemplate } from "@/lib/notify-shared";
  import { dayLabel } from "@/lib/pilot-text";

  const mt = (key: string, vars: Record<string, string> = {}) => formatTemplate(docString("sl", `pilot.email.${key}`), vars);

  function fileSlug(name: string): string {
    const slug = name
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
      .slice(0, 40);
    return slug || "narocnik";
  }

  // email_log is written by sendEmail on every attempt (lib/email.ts rule 2), so
  // it is the one place that says what happened, whatever sendEmail returns.
  async function mailPdf(to: string, vars: Record<string, string>, pdf: Buffer, filename: string): Promise<"sent" | "failed"> {
    const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const base = appBaseUrl() ?? "https://getbelin.com";
    const html = renderEmail(mt("heading"), [mt("line1", vars), mt("line2", vars), mt("line3", vars)], mt("cta"), `${base}/sl/registracija`);
    await sendEmail({
      to,
      kind: "pilot_agreement",
      projectId: null,
      subject: mt("subject", vars),
      html,
      attachments: [{ filename, content: pdf }],
    });
    const { data } = await createAdminClient()
      .from("email_log")
      .select("status")
      .eq("to_email", to.trim())
      .eq("kind", "pilot_agreement")
      .gte("created_at", startedAt)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();
    return data?.status === "sent" ? "sent" : "failed";
  }
  ```

### Task 8.3: The crew report draft survives closing the app (P2, any lane, 1.25 h)

**Why:** D12 says "osnutek se ne izgubi" may only be said if this ships. A roofer whose phone locks, or who swipes the app away mid-report, today loses every photo and number (no-brainer F10: no IndexedDB, no outbox anywhere; crew-walk idea "Outbox"). This is the small, honest half of offline: the draft lives on the device until it is sent. It does NOT queue sends without signal, and nothing in copy may say it does. Do not start after 10:45.

**Files:**

Produces `loadDraft`, `saveDraft`, `clearDraft`, `parseDraft`, `isEmptyDraft`, and the sentence the run of show (Task 9.2) may now use: "Če zaprete aplikacijo, se osnutek poročila ne izgubi."

Photos are stored as `ArrayBuffer` plus MIME type, never as `Blob`: WebKit has a long-running IndexedDB defect where storing or re-storing Blobs fails with "Error preparing Blob/File data to be stored in object store" (WebKit bug 188438, https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=188438; recurring reports, e.g. https://github.com/dfahlander/Dexie.js/issues/1227; accessed 2026-10-05). The founder demos on an iPhone.

**Steps:**

- [ ] **Step 1: The storage module.** Create `lib/report-draft.ts`:
  ```ts
  // The crew report draft, kept on the device so that closing the app, a locked
  // phone or a crash does not lose what was typed and photographed.
  //
  // One draft per project per device, keyed by project id. Photos are stored as
  // ArrayBuffer plus type, never as Blob (WebKit bug 188438). Every IndexedDB
  // call is wrapped: a private window or a browser that refuses storage simply
  // gets the old behaviour, never an error on the roof.

  const DB_NAME = "belin";
  const STORE = "report-drafts";
  const VERSION = 1;
  const MAX_AGE_MS = 7 * 86_400_000;

  export interface StoredPhoto {
    type: string;
    data: ArrayBuffer;
  }

  export interface ReportDraft {
    v: 1;
    projectId: string;
    draftId: string;
    headcount: number;
    note: string;
    qty: Record<string, number>;
    photos: StoredPhoto[];
    savedAt: number;
  }

  /** Validates whatever came back from storage. Anything odd is no draft at all. */
  export function parseDraft(value: unknown, projectId: string, now: number): ReportDraft | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
    const d = value as Partial<ReportDraft>;
    if (d.v !== 1 || d.projectId !== projectId || typeof d.draftId !== "string") return null;
    if (typeof d.savedAt !== "number" || now - d.savedAt > MAX_AGE_MS || d.savedAt > now + 60_000) return null;
    if (typeof d.headcount !== "number" || typeof d.note !== "string") return null;
    if (!d.qty || typeof d.qty !== "object" || Array.isArray(d.qty)) return null;
    if (!Array.isArray(d.photos)) return null;
    const qty: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const [key, n] of Object.entries(d.qty)) if (typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n)) qty[key] = n;
    const photos = d.photos.filter(
      (p): p is StoredPhoto => Boolean(p) && typeof p.type === "string" && p.data instanceof ArrayBuffer,
    );
    return { v: 1, projectId, draftId: d.draftId, headcount: d.headcount, note: d.note, qty, photos, savedAt: d.savedAt };
  }

  /** Nothing worth keeping: no text, no photo, no quantity. Headcount alone is a default. */
  export function isEmptyDraft(d: Pick<ReportDraft, "note" | "qty" | "photos">): boolean {
    return d.note.trim() === "" && d.photos.length === 0 && Object.values(d.qty).every((n) => !n);
  }

  function open(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (typeof indexedDB === "undefined") {
        reject(new Error("no indexedDB"));
        return;
      }
      const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, VERSION);
      request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        if (!request.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) request.result.createObjectStore(STORE);
      };
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error("blocked"));
    });
  }

  async function run<T>(mode: IDBTransactionMode, work: (store: IDBObjectStore) => IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T> {
    const db = await open();
    try {
      return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE, mode);
        const request = work(tx.objectStore(STORE));
        tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(request.result);
        tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
        tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
      });
    } finally {
      db.close();
    }
  }

  export async function loadDraft(projectId: string): Promise<ReportDraft | null> {
    try {
      return parseDraft(await run("readonly", (store) => store.get(projectId)), projectId, Date.now());
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  export async function saveDraft(draft: ReportDraft): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await run("readwrite", (store) => store.put(draft, draft.projectId));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  export async function clearDraft(projectId: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await run("readwrite", (store) => store.delete(projectId));
    } catch {
      // Nothing to clear is the same as cleared.
    }
  }
  ```
- [ ] **Step 2: The test.** Create `tests/report-draft.test.ts`:

    ```tsx
    // mount (never during render, so server and client markup agree), then
    // saved 400 ms after the last change. Never saved while a send is in flight.
    const [restoredAt, setRestoredAt] = useState<number | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {

        if (!draft || isEmptyDraft(draft)) return;

          setDraftSaved(false);

        setDraftSaved(await saveDraft(draft));
      }, 400);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(handle);
    }, [projectId, headcount, note, qty, blobs, busy]);

      await clearDraft(projectId);
      draftId.current = crypto.randomUUID();
      setBlobs([]);
      setNote("");
      setQty({});
      setHeadcount(1);
      setRestoredAt(null);
      setDraftSaved(false);
    };
    ```

  ```ts
  // The "Za vas" queue: what is waiting on the EPC office for one project, in
  // the order it should be done. Money with a clock on it first, then people
  // waiting for an answer, then paperwork, then information.

  export type QueueItem =
    | { kind: "hours"; id: string; number: number; hours: number; deadlineAt: string; daysLeft: number }
    | { kind: "changeOrder"; id: string; number: number; title: string }
    | { kind: "request"; id: string; text: string }
    | { kind: "po"; id: string; number: number; state: "draft" | "rejected" | "sent"; since: string }
    | { kind: "document"; id: string; type: string; title: string; validUntil: string; expired: boolean }
    | { kind: "silence"; weekdays: number };

  function rank(item: QueueItem): number {
    switch (item.kind) {
      case "hours":
        return 0;
      case "changeOrder":
        return 1;
      case "request":
        return 2;
      case "po":
        return item.state === "sent" ? 5 : 3;
      case "document":
        return 4;
      case "silence":
        return 6;
    }
  }

  export function sortQueue(items: QueueItem[]): QueueItem[] {
    return [...items].sort((a, b) => {
      const byRank = rank(a) - rank(b);
      if (byRank !== 0) return byRank;
      if (a.kind === "hours" && b.kind === "hours") return a.daysLeft - b.daysLeft;
      if (a.kind === "document" && b.kind === "document") {
        return Number(b.expired) - Number(a.expired) || a.validUntil.localeCompare(b.validUntil);
      }
      return 0;
    });
  }

  /** Days without a report before the queue says the site has gone quiet (J). */
  export const SILENCE_WEEKDAYS = 2;

  /**
   * Full Monday to Friday days strictly between the last report and today.
   * Today does not count: the day is not over, and the report may still come.
   */
  export function weekdaysBetween(lastIso: string, todayIso: string): number {
    const DAY = 86_400_000;
    const start = Date.parse(`${lastIso.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);
    const end = Date.parse(`${todayIso.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);
    if (Number.isNaN(start) || Number.isNaN(end)) return 0;
    let count = 0;
    for (let day = start + DAY, guard = 0; day < end && guard < 400; day += DAY, guard++) {
      const weekday = new Date(day).getUTCDay();
      if (weekday !== 0 && weekday !== 6) count++;
    }
    return count;
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: The loader.** Create `lib/data/action-queue.ts`:
  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import type { ProjectActor } from "@/lib/actor";
  import { effectiveStatus, workingDaysLeft, type Country, type SheetStatus } from "@/lib/hours-shared";
  import { expiryState } from "@/lib/vault-shared";
  import { projectToday } from "@/lib/project-time";
  import { SILENCE_WEEKDAYS, sortQueue, weekdaysBetween, type QueueItem } from "@/lib/action-queue-shared";

  // Everything here is read for ONE project the actor has already been proven
  // to stand on the EPC side of. Six small queries in parallel.
  export async function getEpcActionQueue(actor: ProjectActor): Promise<QueueItem[]> {
    if (actor.role !== "epc") return [];
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const id = actor.projectId;

    const [projectRes, sheetRes, requestRes, coRes, poRes, entryRes] = await Promise.all([
      db.from("projects").select("country, status, sub_org_id").eq("id", id).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("hour_sheets").select("id, number, status, deadline_at, hour_sheet_lines (hours)").eq("project_id", id).eq("status", "submitted"),
      db.from("requests").select("id, text").eq("project_id", id).eq("status", "open").order("created_at"),
      db.from("change_orders").select("id, number, title").eq("project_id", id).eq("status", "submitted").order("number"),
      db.from("purchase_orders").select("id, number, status, created_at").eq("project_id", id).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("daily_entries").select("entry_date").eq("project_id", id).order("entry_date", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
    ]);

    const project = projectRes.data;
    if (!project) return [];
    const country = (["si", "de", "at"].includes(project.country) ? project.country : "si") as Country;
    const now = new Date();
    const items: QueueItem[] = [];

    for (const sheet of sheetRes.data ?? []) {
      if (!sheet.deadline_at) continue;
      if (effectiveStatus({ status: sheet.status as SheetStatus, deadline_at: sheet.deadline_at }, now) !== "submitted") continue;
      items.push({
        kind: "hours",
        id: sheet.id,
        number: sheet.number,
        hours: (sheet.hour_sheet_lines ?? []).reduce((sum, line) => sum + Number(line.hours), 0),
        deadlineAt: sheet.deadline_at,
        daysLeft: workingDaysLeft(sheet.deadline_at, now, country),
      });
    }
    for (const co of coRes.data ?? []) items.push({ kind: "changeOrder", id: co.id, number: co.number, title: co.title });
    for (const request of requestRes.data ?? []) items.push({ kind: "request", id: request.id, text: request.text });

    const po = poRes.data;
    if (po && (po.status === "draft" || po.status === "rejected" || po.status === "sent")) {
      items.push({ kind: "po", id: po.id, number: po.number, state: po.status, since: po.created_at });
    }

    if (project.sub_org_id) {
      const { data: docs } = await db.from("documents").select("id, type, title, valid_until").eq("org_id", project.sub_org_id);
      for (const doc of docs ?? []) {
        const state = expiryState(doc.valid_until, now);
        if ((state === "expiringSoon" || state === "expired") && doc.valid_until) {
          items.push({ kind: "document", id: doc.id, type: doc.type, title: doc.title, validUntil: doc.valid_until, expired: state === "expired" });
        }
      }
    }

    const last = entryRes.data?.entry_date ?? null;
    if (project.status === "active" && last) {
      const quiet = weekdaysBetween(last, projectToday(country));
      if (quiet >= SILENCE_WEEKDAYS) items.push({ kind: "silence", weekdays: quiet });
    }

    return sortQueue(items);
  }
  ```
  `po.status` narrows to the three literals inside the `if`; if TypeScript does not narrow a `string` column, cast with `po.status as "draft" | "rejected" | "sent"` inside that block.
- [ ] **Step 4: The component.** Create `components/epc/dashboard/ForYouQueue.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  "use client";
  import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
  import Link from "next/link";
  import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
  import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
  import { toast } from "sonner";
  import { decideSheetAction } from "@/app/[locale]/app/[projectId]/hours/actions";
  import { unwrap } from "@/lib/action-result";
  import type { QueueItem } from "@/lib/action-queue-shared";

  // What is waiting on the office, under the hero. One click where the act is
  // safe to make in one click (approving an hour sheet, which Task 5.3 can
  // undo); a link where it needs words (an answer, a reason, a price).

  export function ForYouQueue({ projectId, locale, items }: { projectId: string; locale: string; items: QueueItem[] }) {
    const t = useTranslations("forYou");
    const tHours = useTranslations("hours");
    const tVault = useTranslations("vault");
    const router = useRouter();
    const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
    const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const date = (iso: string) =>
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale === "en" ? "en-GB" : locale, {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "2-digit",
        year: "numeric",
        timeZone: "Europe/Ljubljana",
      }).format(new Date(iso.length === 10 ? `${iso}T12:00:00Z` : iso));
    const number = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale === "en" ? "en-GB" : locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

    const approve = (id: string, sheetNumber: number) => {
      setBusy(id);
      startTransition(async () => {
        try {
          // Task 1.5: the action returns ActionResult instead of throwing.
          // unwrap throws ActionError(code) on { ok: false }, so a refusal
          // (already deemed approved, stale state) lands in the catch below
          // and never shows "approved".
          unwrap(await decideSheetAction(projectId, id, true));
          toast.success(t("approved", { number: sheetNumber }));
          router.refresh();
        } catch {
          toast.error(t("failed"));
        } finally {
          setBusy(null);
        }
      });
    };

    const hoursHref = `/${locale}/app/${projectId}/hours`;

    return (
      <section className="e-sec fy8" aria-labelledby="fy8-h">
        <div className="e-sec-h" id="fy8-h">{t("title")}</div>
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="fy8-empty">{t("empty")}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="fy8-list">
            {items.map((item) => {
              const key = "id" in item ? `${item.kind}-${item.id}` : item.kind;
              let head = "";
              let detail: string | null = null;
              let tone: "money" | "wait" | "doc" | "info" = "info";
              let action: React.ReactNode = null;

              switch (item.kind) {
                case "hours":
                  tone = "money";
                  head = t("hours", { number: item.number, hours: number.format(item.hours) });
                  detail = `${tHours("daysLeft", { n: item.daysLeft })} · ${tHours("deadline", { date: date(item.deadlineAt) })}`;
                  action = (
                    <button type="button" className="fy8-btn" disabled={pending && busy === item.id} onClick={() => approve(item.id, item.number)}>
                      {t("approve")}
                    </button>
                  );
                  break;
                case "changeOrder":
                  tone = "money";
                  head = t("changeOrder", { number: item.number, title: item.title });
                  action = <Link className="fy8-link" href={hoursHref}>{t("decide")}</Link>;
                  break;
                case "request":
                  tone = "wait";
                  head = t("request", { text: item.text });
                  action = <a className="fy8-link" href="#zahteve">{t("answer")}</a>;
                  break;
                case "po":
                  tone = item.state === "sent" ? "info" : "wait";
                  head = item.state === "draft" ? t("poDraft", { number: item.number }) : item.state === "rejected" ? t("poRejected", { number: item.number }) : t("poSent", { number: item.number, date: date(item.since) });
                  action = <Link className="fy8-link" href={`/${locale}/app/${projectId}/po`}>{t("open")}</Link>;
                  break;
                case "document":
                  tone = "doc";
                  head = t(item.expired ? "docExpired" : "docExpiring", { title: item.title || tVault(`types.${item.type}`), date: date(item.validUntil) });
                  action = <a className="fy8-link" href="#dokumenti">{t("show")}</a>;
                  break;
                case "silence":
                  head = t("silence", { n: item.weekdays });
                  break;
              }

              return (
                <li key={key} className="fy8-item">
                  <span className={`fy8-dot fy8-dot--${tone}`} aria-hidden />
                  <div className="fy8-text">
                    <b>{head}</b>
                    {detail ? <span>{detail}</span> : null}
                  </div>
                  {action ? <div className="fy8-act">{action}</div> : null}
                </li>
              );
            })}
  ```

  ```tsx
  import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
  import type { ComplianceDoc } from "@/lib/data/epc-dashboard";

  // One line per subcontractor document that is expiring or expired, at the
  // top of the dashboard, in the same gold strip as the review request.
  export async function ExpiryAlert({ docs, subName, locale }: { docs: ComplianceDoc[]; subName: string | null; locale: string }) {
    const due = docs.filter((doc) => doc.state === "expiringSoon" || doc.state === "expired").slice(0, 3);
    if (!subName || due.length === 0) return null;
    const t = await getTranslations("expiryAlert");
    const tVault = await getTranslations("vault");
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale === "en" ? "en-GB" : locale, {
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "2-digit",
      year: "numeric",
      timeZone: "Europe/Ljubljana",
    });
    return (
      <div className="e-alert ea8" role="status">
        <div className="e-alert-in">
          <span className="e-alert-ic" aria-hidden>!</span>
          <span className="e-alert-t">
            {due.map((doc) => (
              <span key={doc.id} className="ea8-line">
                {t(doc.state === "expired" ? "expired" : "expiring", {
                  sub: subName,
                  title: doc.title || tVault(`types.${doc.type}`),
                  date: doc.validUntil ? fmt.format(new Date(`${doc.validUntil}T12:00:00Z`)) : "",
                })}
              </span>
            ))}
            <span className="ea8-hint">{t("hint")}</span>
          </span>
          <a className="e-alert-b" href="#dokumenti">{t("show")}</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 1: The pure rule.** Create `lib/penalty-guard.ts`:
  ```ts
  // Is the handover late against the agreed deadline? Pure, so it is tested.
  //
  // Calendar days, deliberately: the question is only "late or not", and a
  // calendar count cannot be confused with the Monday to Saturday count the
  // hour sheets use (D9).

  export interface Lateness {
    days: number;
    deadline: string;
    basis: "po" | "plan";
    reference: "handover" | "today";
  }

  export function daysLate(deadlineIso: string, referenceIso: string): number {
    const deadline = Date.parse(`${deadlineIso.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);
    const reference = Date.parse(`${referenceIso.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);
    if (Number.isNaN(deadline) || Number.isNaN(reference)) return 0;
    return Math.max(0, Math.round((reference - deadline) / 86_400_000));
  }

  /**
   * The naročilnica's deadline wins over the plan's, because it is the one the
   * subcontractor accepted. The reference day is when the work was handed over
   * (the latest finalization request, which is the conservative choice: a
   * later date lights the box more often, and an unlit box loses the penalty
   * for good), or today when nobody requested a handover yet.
   */
  export function lateness(input: {
    poDeadline: string | null;
    plannedEnd: string | null;
    handoverDate: string | null;
    today: string;
  }): Lateness | null {
    const deadline = input.poDeadline ?? input.plannedEnd;
    if (!deadline) return null;
    const days = daysLate(deadline, input.handoverDate ?? input.today);
    if (days === 0) return null;
    return {
      days,
      deadline: deadline.slice(0, 10),
      basis: input.poDeadline ? "po" : "plan",
      reference: input.handoverDate ? "handover" : "today",
    };
  }
  ```
- [ ] **Step 2: Its test.** Create `tests/penalty-guard.test.ts`:

  ```ts
  describe("lateness", () => {
    it("is null on or before the deadline", () => {
      expect(lateness({ poDeadline: "2026-10-10", plannedEnd: null, handoverDate: "2026-10-10", today: "2026-10-20" })).toBeNull();
      expect(daysLate("2026-10-10", "2026-10-01")).toBe(0);
    });
    it("counts calendar days from the naročilnica deadline to the handover", () => {
      expect(lateness({ poDeadline: "2026-09-30", plannedEnd: "2026-09-01", handoverDate: "2026-10-06", today: "2026-10-20" })).toEqual({
        days: 6,
        deadline: "2026-09-30",
        basis: "po",
        reference: "handover",
      });
    });
    it("falls back to the plan and to today", () => {
      expect(lateness({ poDeadline: null, plannedEnd: "2026-10-01", handoverDate: null, today: "2026-10-03" })).toMatchObject({
        days: 2,
        basis: "plan",
        reference: "today",
      });
    });
  ```

  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import { projectToday } from "@/lib/project-time";
  import { lateness, type Lateness } from "@/lib/penalty-guard";

  /** Callers must already have proven the actor is a party to the project. */
  export async function getLateness(projectId: string): Promise<Lateness | null> {
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const [projectRes, poRes, handoverRes] = await Promise.all([
      db.from("projects").select("planned_end, country").eq("id", projectId).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("purchase_orders").select("deadline").eq("project_id", projectId).eq("status", "accepted").order("accepted_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("activity").select("created_at").eq("project_id", projectId).eq("kind", "finalization_requested").order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle(),
    ]);
    const country = projectRes.data?.country ?? null;
    return lateness({
      poDeadline: poRes.data?.deadline ?? null,
      plannedEnd: projectRes.data?.planned_end ?? null,
      handoverDate: handoverRes.data ? projectToday(country, new Date(handoverRes.data.created_at)) : null,
      today: projectToday(country),
    });
  }
  ```

**Interfaces:** consumes `getPortfolio(actor).projects` ids (already scoped to the actor's organization). Produces `getEvidenceCounts(projectIds)`.

**Steps:**

- [ ] **Step 1: The counts.** Create `lib/data/evidence.ts`:
  ```ts
  import "server-only";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";

  export interface EvidenceCounts {
    reports: number;
    photos: number;
    signed: number;
    decidedSheets: number;
  }

  /**
   * What the record holds, counted, for projects the caller has ALREADY scoped
   * to the actor (the portfolio's own ids). Null on any read error: a quiet
   * line that undercounts would be a small lie, so it disappears instead.
   */
  export async function getEvidenceCounts(projectIds: string[]): Promise<EvidenceCounts | null> {
    const ids = projectIds.filter(isUuid);
    if (ids.length === 0) return null;
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const head = { count: "exact" as const, head: true };
    const [reports, photos, acceptances, orders, sheets] = await Promise.all([
      db.from("daily_entries").select("id", head).in("project_id", ids),
      db.from("entry_photos").select("entry_id, daily_entries!inner (project_id)", head).in("daily_entries.project_id", ids),
      db.from("acceptances").select("id", head).in("project_id", ids).eq("status", "signed"),
      db.from("purchase_orders").select("id", head).in("project_id", ids).eq("status", "accepted"),
      db.from("hour_sheets").select("id", head).in("project_id", ids).in("status", ["approved", "rejected", "deemed_approved"]),
    ]);
    if ([reports, photos, acceptances, orders, sheets].some((res) => res.error || res.count === null)) return null;
    return {
      reports: reports.count ?? 0,
      photos: photos.count ?? 0,
      signed: (acceptances.count ?? 0) + (orders.count ?? 0),
      decidedSheets: sheets.count ?? 0,
    };
  }
  ```
- [ ] **Step 2: The line.** Create `components/app/EvidenceLine.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
  import type { EvidenceCounts } from "@/lib/data/evidence";

  // One quiet sentence under the portfolio numbers: what is on record. Counts
  // of real rows, nothing estimated. Zero parts are left out, and the whole
  // line is absent when there is nothing to count.
  export async function EvidenceLine({ counts }: { counts: EvidenceCounts | null }) {
    if (!counts) return null;
    const t = await getTranslations("evidence");
    const parts = [
      counts.reports > 0 ? t("reports", { n: counts.reports }) : null,
      counts.photos > 0 ? t("photos", { n: counts.photos }) : null,
      counts.signed > 0 ? t("signed", { n: counts.signed }) : null,
      counts.decidedSheets > 0 ? t("sheets", { n: counts.decidedSheets }) : null,
    ].filter((part): part is string => part !== null);
    if (parts.length === 0) return null;
    return (
      <p className="ev8">
        <span className="ev8-l">{t("label")}</span>
        {parts.join(" · ")}
      </p>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  /**
   * When the server stored the entry, on the site's wall clock: the crew's
   * receipt. created_at is written once, so a retried send of the same draft
   * shows the first receipt, which is the true one.
   */
  export async function entryReceivedAt(actor: ProjectActor, entryId: string): Promise<string> {
    const db = createAdminClient();
    const [{ data: entry }, { data: project }] = await Promise.all([
      db.from("daily_entries").select("created_at").eq("id", entryId).eq("project_id", actor.projectId).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("projects").select("country").eq("id", actor.projectId).maybeSingle(),
    ]);
    return hhmm(entry?.created_at ?? new Date().toISOString(), project?.country ?? null);
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  // Reklamacija dobavitelju: the day-one material check turned into the claim
  // the EPC sends to the wholesaler. Facts and photographs only; it cites no
  // law, because which rule applies to a quantity shortfall is unverified.
  import { Document, Image, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
  import { C, FlexTable, Footer, Header, LabelValue, SignatureBox, styles } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";

  export interface ShortfallStrings {
    title: string; docNo: string; buyer: string; supplier: string; project: string; site: string;
    checkedAt: string; checkedBy: string; intro: string; colItem: string; colOrdered: string;
    colMissing: string; colStatus: string; partial: string; missing: string; crewNote: string;
    photos: string; sign: string; generated: string;
  }

  export interface ShortfallInput {
    buyerName: string;
    supplierName: string | null;
    projectName: string;
    siteAddress: string | null;
    checkedAt: string;
    checkedBy: string | null;
    rows: { name: string; ordered: string; missing: string; status: "partial" | "missing" }[];
    crewNote: string | null;
    photos: Buffer[];
    s: ShortfallStrings;
  }

  export function ShortfallDocument(input: ShortfallInput) {
    const { s } = input;
    return (
      <Document title={`${s.title} ${input.projectName}`}>
        <Page size="A4" style={styles.page}>
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: The route.** Create `app/api/pdf/reklamacija/[checkId]/route.ts`:
  ```ts
  import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
  import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
  import { resolveActorFromSession } from "@/lib/auth";
  import { requireProjectActor } from "@/lib/actor";
  import { isUuid } from "@/lib/actor-shared";
  import { renderDocument } from "@/lib/pdf/theme";
  import { ShortfallDocument, type ShortfallStrings } from "@/lib/pdf/reklamacija";
  import { docString, type DocLocale } from "@/lib/pdf/strings";
  import { formatTemplate } from "@/lib/notify-shared";
  import { hhmm } from "@/lib/project-time";

  // Same three rules as every PDF route: person sessions only, no token in the
  // URL, the document streamed by the server. EPC side only: the EPC bought
  // the material, so the EPC claims it.

  export const runtime = "nodejs";
  export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

  const KEYS = ["title", "buyer", "supplier", "project", "site", "checkedAt", "checkedBy", "intro", "colItem", "colOrdered", "colMissing", "colStatus", "partial", "missing", "crewNote", "photos", "sign", "generated"] as const;

  export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ checkId: string }> }) {
    const { checkId } = await params;
    if (!isUuid(checkId)) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });

    const actor = await resolveActorFromSession();
    if (!actor || actor.kind !== "person" || actor.role === "crew") return new NextResponse("Forbidden", { status: 403 });

    const db = createAdminClient();
    const { data: check } = await db
      .from("material_checks")
      .select("id, project_id, checked_at, note, people:checked_by_person (full_name), material_check_items (material_item_id, status, missing_qty), material_check_docs (kind, storage_path, sort_order)")
      .eq("id", checkId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!check) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });

    try {
      const projectActor = await requireProjectActor(actor, check.project_id);
      if (projectActor.role !== "epc") return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });
    } catch {
      return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });
    }

    const [{ data: project }, { data: items }] = await Promise.all([
      db.from("projects").select("name, language, country, address_street, address_zip, address_city, epc:epc_org_id (name)").eq("id", check.project_id).maybeSingle(),
      db.from("material_items").select("id, name, qty, unit").eq("project_id", check.project_id),
    ]);
    if (!project) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });

    const locale = (project.language === "de" || project.language === "en" ? project.language : "sl") as DocLocale;
    const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale === "en" ? "en-GB" : locale);
    const byId = new Map((items ?? []).map((item) => [item.id, item]));

    const rows = (check.material_check_items ?? [])
      .filter((line) => line.status !== "present")
      .map((line) => {
        const item = byId.get(line.material_item_id);
        const ordered = Number(item?.qty ?? 0);
        const missing = line.status === "missing" ? ordered : Number(line.missing_qty ?? 0);
        return {
          name: item?.name ?? "",
          ordered: `${nf.format(ordered)} ${item?.unit ?? ""}`.trim(),
          missing: `${nf.format(missing)} ${item?.unit ?? ""}`.trim(),
          status: (line.status === "missing" ? "missing" : "partial") as "partial" | "missing",
        };
      });
    if (rows.length === 0) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });

    // Delivery notes first, then material photos, at most four.
    const docs = [...(check.material_check_docs ?? [])]
      .sort((a, b) => (a.kind === b.kind ? a.sort_order - b.sort_order : a.kind === "delivery_note" ? -1 : 1))
      .slice(0, 4);
    const photos: Buffer[] = [];
    for (const doc of docs) {
      const file = await db.storage.from("photos").download(doc.storage_path);
      if (!file.error && file.data) photos.push(Buffer.from(await file.data.arrayBuffer()));
    }

    const s = Object.fromEntries(KEYS.map((key) => [key, docString(locale, `shortfall.doc.${key}`)])) as unknown as ShortfallStrings;
    s.docNo = formatTemplate(docString(locale, "shortfall.doc.docNo"), { no: check.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase() });
    const checkedDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale === "en" ? "en-GB" : locale, { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric", timeZone: "Europe/Ljubljana" }).format(new Date(check.checked_at));
    const supplier = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("dobavitelj")?.trim().slice(0, 120) || null;
    const epcName = (project.epc as { name: string } | null)?.name ?? "";

    const buffer = await renderDocument(
      ShortfallDocument({
        buyerName: epcName,
        supplierName: supplier,
        projectName: project.name,
        siteAddress: [project.address_street, [project.address_zip, project.address_city].filter(Boolean).join(" ")].filter((part) => part && part.trim()).join(", ") || null,
        checkedAt: formatTemplate(docString(locale, "shortfall.doc.checkedAtValue"), { date: checkedDate, time: hhmm(check.checked_at, project.country) }),
        checkedBy: (check.people as { full_name: string } | null)?.full_name ?? null,
        rows,
        crewNote: check.note,
        photos,
        s,
      }),
    );

    return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
        "Content-Disposition": `inline; filename="reklamacija-${check.id.slice(0, 8)}.pdf"`,
        "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=0, must-revalidate",
      },
    });
  }
  ```
  Write `KEYS` one per line. If the `people` and `epc` embeds are typed as arrays by the generated types, narrow them as other routes do.

**Why:** "That goes on the screen in our office" (no-brainer idea 36, J). `?wall=1` on a project shows a chrome-free, glanceable view sized for a TV, refreshed live by the existing realtime ping, rotating through the organization's active projects, and keeping the screen awake where the browser allows. Do not start after 10:30.

**Files:**

**Interfaces:** consumes `getEpcDashboard` data, `ProgressRing`, `ProjectionPanel`, `LatestOnSite`, `PhotoGallery`, `LiveRefresh`, `projectTopic`, `listProjectsForPerson`, the kWp formatter from `lib/format.ts` (Task 1.11; the same call EpcDashboard uses after Task 5.5). **Steps:**

- [ ] **Step 1: Keep the screen awake.** Create `components/epc/WallKeepAwake.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  "use client";
  import { useEffect } from "react";

  type Sentinel = { release: () => Promise<void> };
  type WakeLockNavigator = Navigator & { wakeLock?: { request: (type: "screen") => Promise<Sentinel> } };

  // A TV that dims after ten minutes is not a wall display. The lock is lost
  // whenever the tab is hidden, so it is taken again on every return.
  export function WallKeepAwake() {
    useEffect(() => {
      const nav = navigator as WakeLockNavigator;
      let lock: Sentinel | null = null;
      const acquire = () => {
        if (document.visibilityState !== "visible" || !nav.wakeLock) return;
        nav.wakeLock.request("screen").then((l) => { lock = l; }).catch(() => {});
      };
      acquire();
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", acquire);
      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", acquire);
        lock?.release().catch(() => {});
      };
    }, []);
    return null;
  }
  ```
- [ ] **Step 2: Rotate.** Create `components/epc/WallRotate.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  "use client";
  import { useEffect } from "react";
  import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

  export function WallRotate({ href, seconds }: { href: string; seconds: number }) {
    const router = useRouter();
    useEffect(() => {
      const handle = window.setTimeout(() => router.push(href), seconds * 1000);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(handle);
    }, [href, seconds, router]);
    return null;
  }
  ```

One "Kontrola" button on the crew phone showing per worker A1, the ZKO notification and the logged hours; Austrian law accepts electronic access at inspection (§ 21 and § 22 LSD-BG, https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/NormDokument.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=20009555&Paragraf=21, accessed 2026-10-05) and missing documents cost up to 20,000 EUR (§ 26, § 28 LSD-BG, same source).
- **Preverba skladnosti na dan plačila** (4 to 6 h). When the EPC releases a payment, Belin records that the Freistellungsbescheinigung was valid on that day (Germany, the § 48a Abs. 3 EStG defence, https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__48a.html, accessed 2026-10-05) or that the subcontractor was on the HFU list at payment (Austria, USP page in recon/market-benchmark/sources.md, accessed 2026-10-05), and writes a one-page protocol.
- **Strukturiran e-račun (e-SLOG)** (6 to 10 h). From 1.1.2028 a PDF is no longer a valid B2B invoice between Slovenian businesses under ZIERDED (https://www.bdo.global/en-gb/insights/tax/indirect-tax/slovenia-e-invoicing-to-be-mandatory-for-b2b-transactions-starting-in-2028, accessed 2026-10-05); Belin already builds the invoice from approved data, so structured export is a natural next step. Say "na načrtu", never "že obstaja".
- **Pošiljanje brez signala** (4 to 5 h on top of 8.3). A real outbox that sends by itself when the signal returns; until it exists the meeting says nothing about offline (D12).
- **Povezava za investitorja, samo za branje** (3 h). The EPC's own client sees progress and photos, no money and no actions, so Belin also produces the weekly report the EPC owes upward (epc-walk idea, J).

## Wave 9: freeze, rehearsal and the run of show

Wave 9 turns a working product into a meeting that cannot surprise the founder. It builds one command that says green or red (`npm run preflight`), writes the meeting in Slovenian minute by minute with a one-page cheat sheet and honest objection answers, packs an offline folder for the day the network dies, runs the final reset and the device setup in a fixed order, prints what goes on the table, closes the session logs, and after the meeting reverts the personalization, sends the leave-behind and watches for the signup.

Three facts shape everything below.

1. **Page views write to the database** (late finding LF12) and **the reseed revokes demo sessions** (LF23). So the last reseed runs after the last rehearsal, and every device enters through the Demo Door after that reseed, never before.
2. **On Vercel Hobby an Instant Rollback reaches only the immediately previous production deployment** (FACT: "On the Hobby plan, you can only roll back to the immediately previous production deployment", vercel.com/docs/deployments/rollback-production-deployment, accessed 2026-10-05). So nothing is pushed to main between the code freeze (12:00) and the end of the meeting except a blocker fix the founder approves in chat. Wave 9's own commits stay local until Task 9.6 Part 2.
3. **The Demo Door key never enters git.** The cheat sheet template is committed; the filled copy with the door QR is written only to the desktop folder `C:\Users\ejand\Desktop\BELIN OFFLINE`.

````js
// Every id here is one scripts/seed-demo.mjs writes. They are COPIED rather
// than imported because the seed is a top-level script that runs the moment it

  subOrg: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  subOrg2: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222223",
  subOrg3: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222224",
  project: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  projectStart: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333334",
  velenje: "3333333a-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",

/**

/**
 * Every row the seed writes with a fixed id uses a first group of seven equal
 * hex digits plus one (66666666, 3333333a, aaaaaaaa). gen_random_uuid() lands
 * on that shape about once in sixteen million, so a row in a demo table whose
 * id does not match it was made by a person, a rehearsal or a script, not by
 * the seed.
 */
const SEEDED = /^([0-9a-f])\1{6}[0-9a-f]-/i;
export function isSeededId(id) {
  return typeof id === "string" && SEEDED.test(id);
}

/** Same list as the seed's CLOSING_EVENTS: the once-only end of the story. */
export const CLOSING_EVENTS = [
  "finalization_requested",
  "acceptance_signed",
  "invoice_generated",
  "invoice_sent",
];

/**
 * Activity the APP writes on its own when a page is viewed (LF12): the expiry
 * reminder claim and the deemed approval. These appear after every reseed the
 * moment anyone opens a dashboard, including the preflight warm-up, so they are
 * not rehearsal debris.
 */
export const AUTOMATIC_EVENTS = ["document_expiring", "hours_deemed_approved"];

/** Never on stage: a real company (D2, GTM base) and AVESOL's real rate (D3). */
export const FORBIDDEN_TEXT = ["Sonce Energija", "sonce-demo", "118.500", "48,00 EUR"];

/** Phrases only the old Belin 1.0.0 site on getbelin.com carries (D13). */
export const OLD_SITE_MARKERS = ["Every kWh starts here", "Trusted by solar companies"];

export function normalizeText(text) {
  return String(text ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

export function forbiddenHits(text, extra = []) {
  const flat = normalizeText(text);
  return [...FORBIDDEN_TEXT, ...extra].filter((needle) => flat.includes(needle));
}

function isoPlusDays(iso, days) {
  return new Date(Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`) + days * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function weekday(iso) {
  return new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`).getUTCDay();
}

/** The Monday to Friday day before `todayIso`, optionally also skipping holidays. */
export function previousWeekday(todayIso, holidays = []) {
  let cursor = isoPlusDays(todayIso, -1);
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 30; guard++) {
    const day = weekday(cursor);
    if (day >= 1 && day <= 5 && !holidays.includes(cursor)) return cursor;
    cursor = isoPlusDays(cursor, -1);
  }
  return cursor;
}

/**
 * The running project's diary must end today or on the last working day before
 * it. Both readings of "working day" are accepted (the seed's Monday to Friday,
 * and the same minus Slovenian holidays) so this check does not care which one
 * Task 2.2 settled on.
 */
export function lastEntryIsFresh(lastIso, todayIso) {
  if (!lastIso) return false;
  const last = String(lastIso).slice(0, 10);
  return [todayIso, previousWeekday(todayIso), previousWeekday(todayIso, HOLIDAYS.si)].includes(last);
}

/**
 * Paths that may differ between what production runs and local HEAD without the
 * demo running different code: documents, the logs, the meeting scripts
 * themselves, and what Task 9.3a commits locally after the freeze (the
 * regenerated marketing assets, the brochure sources, the marketing scripts).
 * Everything else is code and must be deployed before it is shown.
 */
const NOT_SHIPPED = [
  /^docs\//,
  /^CHANGELOG\.md$/,
  /^DECISIONS\.md$/,
  /^scripts\/preflight\.mjs$/,
  /^scripts\/lib\//,
  /^scripts\/demo\//,
  /^tests\/demo-truth\.test\.ts$/,
  // Only scripts/marketing/brochure.mjs imports these (lib/pdf/brochure.tsx
  // imports brochure-copy.ts; nothing under app, components or lib imports
  // either, verified 2026-10-05). assets/ is never imported by the app.
  /^assets\//,
  /^lib\/pdf\/brochure(-copy)?\.tsx?$/,
  // Task 9.3a Step 4 may fix a selector in scripts/marketing/video-takes.mjs;
  // the app never imports scripts/.
  /^scripts\/marketing\//,
];

export function classifyDrift(paths) {
  const code = paths.filter((p) => !NOT_SHIPPED.some((rule) => rule.test(p)));
  return { docsOnly: code.length === 0, code };
}

/**
 * A package.json diff that only adds or edits npm script entries ships nothing.
 * Task 9.3a adds "demo:kit" after the freeze, which also adds a comma to the
 * entry before it; a dependency line in the diff makes this false.
 */
export function scriptsOnlyPackageDiff(diffText) {
  const lines = String(diffText)
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .filter((l) => /^[+-]/.test(l) && !/^(\+\+\+|---)/.test(l));
  return lines.length > 0 && lines.every((l) => /^[+-]\s*"(demo|preflight|qa|marketing|landing|test)[\w:-]*":/.test(l));
}

/** `fra1::fra1::abc-123` is edge then function region; a static file has no function part. */
export function parseVercelId(header) {
  if (!header) return { edge: null, fn: null };
  const parts = String(header).split("::");
  if (parts.length >= 3) return { edge: parts[0], fn: parts[1] };
  return { edge: parts[0] || null, fn: null };
}

/**
 * A Slovenian count with its noun: singular, dual, plural for 3 and 4, and the
 * genitive plural for everything else (1 projekt, 2 projekta, 3 projekti,
 * 5 projektov). Decided by the last two digits, so 102 is dual like 2.
 */
export function slPlural(n, [one, two, few, many]) {
  const rest = Math.abs(n) % 100;
  const word = rest === 1 ? one : rest === 2 ? two : rest === 3 || rest === 4 ? few : many;
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat("sl-SI").format(n)} ${word}`;
}

export function slDays(n) {
  return slPlural(n, ["dan", "dneva", "dni", "dni"]);
}
````

````js
//
// Used by scripts/preflight.mjs and scripts/demo/offline-kit.mjs.

import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { PERSONA_LABEL } from "./demo-truth.mjs";

const SPEC = {
  // Task 2.3 marks every door button with data-persona (epcAdmin, bauleiter,
  // subOffice, crew) and data-project (trenutno, dan1, portfelj). Accessible
  // names are the project labels, shared by every persona: never match by name.
  // The crew card has no Portfelj button, so the crew enters on Dan 1.
  epc: { selector: 'button[data-persona="epcAdmin"][data-project="portfelj"]', viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, mobile: false },
  sub: { selector: 'button[data-persona="subOffice"][data-project="portfelj"]', viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, mobile: false },
  crew: { selector: 'button[data-persona="crew"][data-project="dan1"]', viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, mobile: true },
};

export async function launchBrowser() {
  try {
    return await chromium.launch();
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message.split("\n")[0] : String(error);
    throw new Error(`Chromium se ne zažene (${reason}). Zaženite: npx playwright install chromium`);
  }
}

/**
 * A fresh browser context signed in as `persona` through the door. The session
 * cookie is the proof of entry, because the door may either redirect into the
 * app or stay on the panel and confirm; both are fine, a missing cookie is not.
 */
export async function enterAs(browser, { base, key, persona }) {
  const spec = SPEC[persona];
  if (!spec) throw new Error(`neznana oseba ${persona}`);
  if (!key) throw new Error("DEMO_DOOR_KEY manjka v .env.local");

  const context = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: spec.viewport,
    locale: "sl-SI",
    isMobile: spec.mobile,
    hasTouch: spec.mobile,
    deviceScaleFactor: spec.mobile ? 3 : 1,
  });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const response = await page.goto(`${base}/sl/demo/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`, {
    waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",
    timeout: 45000,
  });
  if (!response || response.status() !== 200) {
    await context.close();
    throw new Error(`vrata vrnejo ${response?.status() ?? "brez odgovora"}`);
  }

  const button = page.locator(spec.selector).first();
  if ((await button.count()) === 0) {
    await context.close();
    throw new Error(`na vratih ni gumba ${spec.selector} (Task 2.3)`);
  }
  await button.click();

  const deadline = Date.now() + 20000;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const cookies = await context.cookies(base);
    if (cookies.some((cookie) => cookie.name === "belin_session" && cookie.value)) {
      await page.close();
      return context;
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
  }
  await context.close();
  throw new Error(`${PERSONA_LABEL[persona]}: po kliku ni seje (piškotek belin_session)`);
}
````

````ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  IDS,
  classifyDrift,
  forbiddenHits,
  isSeededId,
  lastEntryIsFresh,
  parseVercelId,
  previousWeekday,
  scriptsOnlyPackageDiff,
  slDays,
} from "../scripts/lib/demo-truth.mjs";

// The seed may have moved into a module (Task 2.1 or 2.2); read whichever exists.
const SEED_SOURCES = ["scripts/seed-demo.mjs", "lib/demo/seed.ts", "lib/demo/ids.ts", "lib/demo/door.ts"];
const seedText = SEED_SOURCES.filter((path) => existsSync(path))
  .map((path) => readFileSync(path, "utf8"))
  .join("\n");

describe("demo truth", () => {
  it("copies only ids the seed really writes", () => {
    expect(seedText.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const velenjeRow = "3333333a-0000-4000-8000-00000000000";
    for (const [name, id] of Object.entries(IDS)) {
      // The book projects are built from a template string, so Velenje's id
      // appears in the seed as its prefix plus n = 4.
      const present = name === "velenje" ? seedText.includes(velenjeRow) && /n:\s*4\b/.test(seedText) : seedText.includes(id);
      expect(present, `${name} ${id} is not in the seed`).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it("tells seeded ids from app-made ones", () => {
    for (const id of Object.values(IDS)) expect(isSeededId(id)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSeededId("12121212-1212-4121-8121-121212121212")).toBe(false);
    for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) expect(isSeededId(randomUUID())).toBe(false);
  });

  it("finds the last weekday before a date", () => {
    expect(previousWeekday("2026-10-06")).toBe("2026-10-05");
    expect(previousWeekday("2026-10-05")).toBe("2026-10-02");
    expect(previousWeekday("2026-11-02", ["2026-10-30"])).toBe("2026-10-29");
  });

  it("accepts a diary that ends today or on the last working day", () => {
    expect(lastEntryIsFresh("2026-10-05", "2026-10-06")).toBe(true);
    expect(lastEntryIsFresh("2026-10-06", "2026-10-06")).toBe(true);
    expect(lastEntryIsFresh("2026-10-02", "2026-10-06")).toBe(false);
    expect(lastEntryIsFresh("2026-08-28", "2026-10-06")).toBe(false);
    expect(lastEntryIsFresh(null, "2026-10-06")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("lets documents differ from production but not code", () => {
    expect(classifyDrift(["docs/demo/2026-10-06-run-of-show.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "scripts/demo/cheat-sheet.mjs"]).docsOnly).toBe(true);
    expect(classifyDrift(["app/[locale]/page.tsx", "CHANGELOG.md"]).code).toEqual(["app/[locale]/page.tsx"]);
    // What Task 9.3a commits locally after the freeze ships nothing.
    expect(classifyDrift(["lib/pdf/brochure-copy.ts", "assets/marketing/belin-predstavitev-sl.pdf"]).docsOnly).toBe(true);
    expect(classifyDrift(["lib/pdf/narocilnica.tsx"]).docsOnly).toBe(false);
  });

  it("lets npm script entries differ in package.json but not dependencies", () => {
    expect(
      scriptsOnlyPackageDiff('-    "marketing:workflow": "node x"\n+    "marketing:workflow": "node x",\n+    "demo:kit": "tsx y"'),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(scriptsOnlyPackageDiff('+    "next": "15.5.21",')).toBe(false);
    expect(scriptsOnlyPackageDiff("")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("finds a real company and AVESOL's rate in document text", () => {
    expect(forbiddenHits("Naročnik  Sonce\nEnergija d.o.o. 118.500,00 EUR")).toEqual(["Sonce Energija", "118.500"]);
    expect(forbiddenHits("Naročnik Primer d.o.o. 100.000,00 EUR, 40,00 EUR na uro")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reads the function region from x-vercel-id", () => {
    expect(parseVercelId("fra1::fra1::q2rtr-1791-abc")).toEqual({ edge: "fra1", fn: "fra1" });
    expect(parseVercelId("fra1::iad1::q2rtr-1791-abc")).toEqual({ edge: "fra1", fn: "iad1" });
    expect(parseVercelId("fra1::2f54v-1791-abc")).toEqual({ edge: "fra1", fn: null });
    expect(parseVercelId(null)).toEqual({ edge: null, fn: null });
  });

  it("counts days in Slovenian", () => {
    expect(slDays(1)).toBe("1 dan");
    expect(slDays(2)).toBe("2 dneva");
    expect(slDays(3)).toBe("3 dni");
    expect(slDays(18)).toBe("18 dni");
    expect(slDays(102)).toBe("102 dneva");
  });
});
````
