- [ ] **Step 5: Create `scripts/preflight.mjs`.**

````js
// npm run preflight: one green or red screen before the meeting.
//
// Run it at T minus 3 h, after every reseed, and in the car park at T minus 15.
// Exit code 1 on any FAIL. WARN prints in yellow and does not fail the run.
//
// What it touches. It READS the database with the service role and production
// over HTTPS. It does not write anything itself, but two of its steps make the
// APP write, and both are named here so nobody is surprised:
//   - the warm-up enters through the Demo Door as each persona, which creates
//     one session row per persona (the reseed revokes demo sessions), and
//     opening the dashboards lets the app claim its expiry reminders (LF12);
//   - --warm-report generates one completion report on Trenutno, which is why
//     it is a flag and not the default.
//
// Usage, from C:\DevEnv\belin-app:
//   npm run preflight
//   npm run preflight -- --warm-report
//   npm run preflight -- --no-warm
//   npm run preflight -- --base https://belin-app.vercel.app
//   npm run preflight -- --buyer-vat SI12345678
//   npm run preflight -- --allow-old-domain
//   npm run preflight -- --out "C:\Users\ejand\Desktop\BELIN OFFLINE\preflight.md"
//   npm run preflight -- --shots .tmp-qa/preflight   (one screenshot per warmed screen)
// PREFLIGHT_BASE in .env.local replaces the default base for every run.

import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { Resolver } from "node:dns/promises";
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { extractText, getDocumentProxy } from "unpdf";
import { addWorkingDays, workingDaysLeft } from "@/lib/hours-shared";
import { expiryState } from "@/lib/vault-shared";
import { projectToday } from "@/lib/project-time";
import {
  AUTOMATIC_EVENTS,
  CLOSING_EVENTS,
  IDS,
  MUST_NOT_SEE,
  OLD_SITE_MARKERS,
  PDF_ROUTES,
  PERSONA_LABEL,
  ROUTES,
  STAGE_ORGS,
  classifyDrift,
  forbiddenHits,
  isSeededId,
  lastEntryIsFresh,
  normalizeText,
  parseVercelId,
  scriptsOnlyPackageDiff,
  slDays,
} from "./lib/demo-truth.mjs";
import { enterAs, launchBrowser } from "./lib/door.mjs";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const has = (name) => args.includes(`--${name}`);
function option(name, fallback) {
  const index = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  const value = index >= 0 ? args[index + 1] : undefined;
  return value && !value.startsWith("--") ? value : fallback;
}

const BASE = option("base", process.env.PREFLIGHT_BASE || "https://getbelin.com").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const APEX = "https://getbelin.com";
const KEY = process.env.DEMO_DOOR_KEY?.trim() ?? "";
const SHOTS = option("shots", "");
if (SHOTS) mkdirSync(SHOTS, { recursive: true });
const NOW = new Date();
const TODAY = projectToday("si", NOW);
// The seed writes everything it writes within a minute or two. A row in a
// random-id demo table created more than this long after the seed wrote the
// vault came from a person, not from the seed.
const SEED_WINDOW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) {
  console.error("Manjkata NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL ali SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Zaženite: npm run preflight");
  process.exit(1);
}
const db = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } });

// Button labels come from the catalog, so a copy fix in Wave 5 cannot break the
// warm-up silently.
const sl = JSON.parse(readFileSync("messages/sl.json", "utf8"));
const LABEL_GENERATE = sl.final.generate;
const LABEL_DOWNLOAD = sl.final.download;

const results = [];
const pass = (detail) => ({ status: "PASS", detail });
const warn = (detail) => ({ status: "WARN", detail });
const fail = (detail) => ({ status: "FAIL", detail });

function record(group, name, status, detail) {
  results.push({ group, name, status, detail: String(detail ?? "") });
}

async function check(group, name, run) {
  try {
    const outcome = await run();
    record(group, name, outcome.status, outcome.detail);
  } catch (error) {
    record(group, name, "FAIL", `napaka: ${firstLine(error)}`);
  }
}

function firstLine(error) {
  return (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)).split("\n")[0];
}

async function get(target, { redirect = "follow", timeoutMs = 20000, method = "GET", headers, body } = {}) {
  const started = performance.now();
  const response = await fetch(target, {
    method,
    redirect,
    headers,
    body,
    cache: "no-store",
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  return {
    status: response.status,
    headers: response.headers,
    text,
    finalUrl: response.url,
    ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
  };
}

async function rows(query, label) {
  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw new Error(`${label}: ${error.message}`);
  return data ?? [];
}

function git(...gitArgs) {
  return execFileSync("git", gitArgs, { encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] }).trim();
}

console.log(`Belin preflight, ${TODAY} ${NOW.toLocaleTimeString("sl-SI")}, ${BASE}`);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Platform
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

let health = null;
let prodCommit = null;

await check("Platforma", "Baza Supabase dosegljiva", async () => {
  const times = [];
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    const started = performance.now();
    const { error } = await db.from("organizations").select("id").limit(1);
    if (error) return fail(`poizvedba ne uspe: ${error.message}`);
    times.push(Math.round(performance.now() - started));
  }
  const median = [...times].sort((a, b) => a - b)[1];
  return median < 1500 ? pass(`${median} ms (mediana treh)`) : warn(`počasno: ${median} ms (mediana treh)`);
});

async function commitFromVercelApi() {
  const token = process.env.VERCEL_TOKEN?.trim();
  if (!token) return null;
  const response = await get(
    "https://api.vercel.com/v6/deployments?projectId=belin-app&target=production&state=READY&limit=1&slug=jans-projects-86a733fa",
    { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  );
  if (response.status !== 200) return null;
  return JSON.parse(response.text).deployments?.[0]?.meta?.githubCommitSha ?? null;
}

await check("Platforma", "Produkcija teče na lokalni kodi", async () => {
  health = await get(`${BASE}/api/health`);
  if (health.status !== 200) return fail(`${BASE}/api/health vrne ${health.status} (Task 1.8)`);
  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(health.text);
  } catch {
    return fail("/api/health ne vrne JSON");
  }
  prodCommit = typeof body.commit === "string" && body.commit ? body.commit : await commitFromVercelApi();
  if (!prodCommit) {
    return warn("verzije ne izvem: /api/health nima polja commit in VERCEL_TOKEN ni nastavljen; preverite z Vercel konektorjem");
  }
  const head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD");
  if (prodCommit === head) return pass(`produkcija = HEAD ${head.slice(0, 7)}`);
  try {
    git("cat-file", "-e", `${prodCommit}^{commit}`);
  } catch {
    return fail(`produkcija teče na ${prodCommit.slice(0, 7)}, ki ga lokalno ni (git fetch, nato znova)`);
  }
  const changed = git("diff", "--name-only", prodCommit, "HEAD").split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
  const drift = classifyDrift(changed);
  // Task 9.3a adds the demo:kit script after the freeze; a package.json diff
  // made only of npm script entries changes nothing that is deployed.
  let code = drift.code;
  if (code.includes("package.json") && scriptsOnlyPackageDiff(git("diff", "-U0", prodCommit, "HEAD", "--", "package.json"))) {
    code = code.filter((p) => p !== "package.json");
  }
  return code.length === 0
    ? pass(`produkcija ${prodCommit.slice(0, 7)}, HEAD ${head.slice(0, 7)}: razlika so le dokumenti, skripte in gradivo (${changed.length})`)
    : fail(`produkcija ${prodCommit.slice(0, 7)} ni HEAD ${head.slice(0, 7)}; drugačna koda: ${code.slice(0, 5).join(", ")}`);
});

await check("Platforma", "Lokalno ni nepotrjene kode", async () => {
  const dirty = git("status", "--porcelain")
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => line.slice(3).replace(/^"|"$/g, ""));
  const drift = classifyDrift(dirty);
  if (drift.docsOnly) return pass(dirty.length ? `nepotrjeni so le dokumenti (${dirty.length})` : "čisto");
  return warn(`nepotrjeno: ${drift.code.slice(0, 5).join(", ")}`);
});

await check("Platforma", "Funkcije tečejo v Frankfurtu (fra1)", async () => {

await check("Platforma", "VIES za Slovenijo", async () => {

const sendingDomain = (process.env.EMAIL_FROM?.match(/@([^>\s]+)/)?.[1] ?? "getbelin.com").toLowerCase();

await check("E-pošta", `DKIM zapis za ${sendingDomain}`, async () => {
  const resolver = new Resolver();
  resolver.setServers(["8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1"]);
  try {
    const records = await resolver.resolveTxt(`resend._domainkey.${sendingDomain}`);
    const joined = records.map((parts) => parts.join("")).join(" ");
    return joined.includes("p=") ? pass("zapis obstaja (8.8.8.8)") : fail("zapis je, a brez ključa p=");
  } catch (error) {
    return fail(`zapisa ni (${error?.code ?? firstLine(error)}); Task 0.2`);

});

  const response = await get("https://api.resend.com/domains", { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${resendKey}` } });
  if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
    return warn("ključ sme samo pošiljati; stanje domene preverite v Resend ali s konektorjem");
  }
  if (response.status !== 200) return fail(`Resend API vrne ${response.status}`);
  const domain = JSON.parse(response.text).data?.find((row) => row.name === sendingDomain);
  if (!domain) return fail(`domene ${sendingDomain} ni v tem računu Resend`);
  return domain.status === "verified" ? pass("verified") : fail(`stanje: ${domain.status}`);
});

await check("E-pošta", "Zadnja prava pošta je odšla", async () => {
  const [last] = await rows(
    db
      .from("email_log")
      .select("kind, status, error, created_at")
      .not("to_email", "ilike", "%-demo.si")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1),
    "email_log",
  );
  if (!last) return warn("še nobene prave pošte; pošljite si prijavno povezavo");
  const hours = (NOW.getTime() - Date.parse(last.created_at)) / 3600000;
  if (last.status !== "sent") {
    return fail(`${last.kind} ob ${last.created_at.slice(0, 16)}: ${last.status} (${last.error ?? "brez razloga"})`);

  return hours <= 24
    ? pass(`${last.kind}, pred ${hours.toFixed(1)} h, sent`)
    : warn(`zadnja uspešna pred ${Math.round(hours)} h; pošljite si prijavno povezavo in preverite prejem`);
});

let epcName = null;

await check("Demo", "Dnevnik Trenutno je svež", async () => {
  const entries = await rows(
    db.from("daily_entries").select("id, entry_date, created_at").eq("project_id", IDS.project),
    "daily_entries",
  );
  const seeded = entries.filter((entry) => isSeededId(entry.id));
  if (!seeded.length) return fail("Trenutno nima vnosov iz seeda; zaženite npm run seed");
  // The seed's own run time. Task 2.2a files diary, incident, request and
  // activity rows on their HISTORICAL day, so none of them can mark the run.
  // The vault rows are inserted on the database clock by the same run.
  const { data: vaultRows } = await db
    .from("documents")
    .select("created_at")
    .eq("org_id", IDS.subOrg)
    .like("storage_path", `${IDS.subOrg}/vault/seed-%`);
  seedMark = vaultRows?.length ? Math.min(...vaultRows.map((row) => Date.parse(row.created_at))) : null;
  const last = seeded.map((entry) => entry.entry_date).sort().at(-1);
  const seededOn = seedMark ? projectToday("si", new Date(seedMark)) : "?";
  return lastEntryIsFresh(last, TODAY)
    ? pass(`zadnji vnos ${last}, dnevi v dnevniku: ${seeded.length}, seed ${seededOn}`)
    : fail(`zadnji vnos ${last}, danes je ${TODAY}; zaženite npm run seed`);
});

await check("Demo", "Odštevanje režijskih ur: še 2 dneva", async () => {
  const sheets = await rows(
    db.from("hour_sheets").select("number, status, submitted_at, deadline_at").eq("project_id", IDS.project),
    "hour_sheets",
  );
  const open = sheets.filter((sheet) => sheet.status === "submitted");
  if (open.length !== 1) return fail(`odprti listi: ${open.length}, pričakovan 1 (LF12: ogled lahko list potrdi)`);
  const [sheet] = open;
  if (!sheet.deadline_at || Date.parse(sheet.deadline_at) <= NOW.getTime()) {
    return fail(`rok ${sheet.deadline_at ?? "manjka"} je mimo; zaženite npm run seed`);
  }
  // Exactly the call components/hours/SheetList.tsx makes for the badge.
  const left = workingDaysLeft(sheet.deadline_at.slice(0, 10), NOW, "si");
  if (left !== 2) return fail(`list ${sheet.number}: še ${slDays(left)}, pričakovano 2; zaženite npm run seed`);
  const deadlineDay = projectToday("si", new Date(sheet.deadline_at));
  const expected = sheet.submitted_at ? addWorkingDays(projectToday("si", new Date(sheet.submitted_at)), 6, "si") : null;
  return expected === deadlineDay
    ? pass(`list ${sheet.number}: še 2 dneva, rok ${deadlineDay}, oddan 6 dni prej`)
    : warn(`še 2 dneva, a oddaja plus 6 dni je ${expected ?? "?"}, rok pa ${deadlineDay} (DR-H1)`);
});

await check("Demo", "Naročilnici: PDF, odtis, besedilo", async () => {
  const orders = await rows(
    db
      .from("purchase_orders")
      .select("id, status, pdf_path, pdf_sha256, sent_at, accepted_at")
      .in("id", [IDS.poCurrent, IDS.poStart]),
    "purchase_orders",
  );
  const problems = [];
  const timings = [];
  for (const order of orders) {
    const label = order.id === IDS.poCurrent ? "Trenutno" : "Dan 1";
    if (!order.pdf_path || !order.pdf_sha256) {
      problems.push(`${label}: brez PDF ali odtisa`);
      continue;
    }
    const started = performance.now();
    const { data: signed, error } = await db.storage.from("reports").createSignedUrl(order.pdf_path, 60);
    if (error || !signed) {
      problems.push(`${label}: podpisan URL ne uspe`);
      continue;
    }
    // Cache-busted signed URL, never download(): the SDK serves a cached copy
    // (scripts/seed-documents.ts, docs/known-issues.md entry 2).
    const response = await fetch(`${signed.signedUrl}&cb=${randomUUID()}`, {
      cache: "no-store",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000),
    });
    const bytes = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
    if (createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex") !== order.pdf_sha256) {
      problems.push(`${label}: odtis se ne ujema, sprejem bi na odru zavrnil`);
      continue;
    }
    const { text } = await extractText(await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(bytes)), { mergePages: true });
    const flat = normalizeText(text);
    const hits = forbiddenHits(flat);
    if (hits.length) problems.push(`${label}: v PDF ${hits.join(", ")}`);
    if (epcName && !flat.includes(normalizeText(epcName))) problems.push(`${label}: PDF ne nosi imena "${epcName}"`);
    timings.push(`${label} ${Math.round(performance.now() - started)} ms`);
  }
  const current = orders.find((order) => order.id === IDS.poCurrent);
  const start = orders.find((order) => order.id === IDS.poStart);
  if (current?.status !== "accepted") problems.push(`Trenutno: ${current?.status ?? "manjka"}, pričakovano accepted`);
  if (current?.sent_at && current?.accepted_at && Date.parse(current.accepted_at) < Date.parse(current.sent_at)) {
    problems.push("Trenutno: sprejeta pred izdajo (Task 3.7)");
  }
  if (start?.status !== "sent") problems.push(`Dan 1: ${start?.status ?? "manjka"}, pričakovano sent`);
  return problems.length ? fail(`${problems.join("; ")}; zaženite npm run seed`) : pass(`odtisa se ujemata; ${timings.join(", ")}`);
});

await check("Demo", "Brez zaključnih dokumentov na Trenutno in Dan 1", async () => {
  const live = [IDS.project, IDS.projectStart];
  const [acceptances, invoices, events, documents, projects] = await Promise.all([
    rows(db.from("acceptances").select("id").in("project_id", live), "acceptances"),
    rows(db.from("invoices").select("id").in("project_id", live), "invoices"),
    rows(db.from("activity").select("kind").in("project_id", live).in("kind", CLOSING_EVENTS), "activity"),
    rows(
      db.from("generated_documents").select("kind").in("project_id", live).neq("kind", "completion_report"),
      "generated_documents",
    ),
    rows(db.from("projects").select("id, status").in("id", live), "projects"),
  ]);
  const problems = [];
  if (acceptances.length) problems.push(`prevzemi: ${acceptances.length}`);
  if (invoices.length) problems.push(`računi: ${invoices.length}`);
  if (events.length) problems.push(`zaključni dogodki: ${events.length} (${[...new Set(events.map((e) => e.kind))].join(", ")})`);
  if (documents.length) problems.push(`dokumenti: ${documents.length} (${[...new Set(documents.map((d) => d.kind))].join(", ")})`);
  for (const project of projects) {
    if (project.status !== "active") problems.push(`${project.id === IDS.project ? "Trenutno" : "Dan 1"} je ${project.status}`);
  }
  return problems.length ? fail(`${problems.join("; ")}; zaženite npm run seed`) : pass("čisto, oba projekta aktivna");
});

await check("Demo", "Rumeni dokument v trezorju AVESOL", async () => {
  const documents = await rows(db.from("documents").select("title, valid_until").eq("org_id", IDS.subOrg), "documents");
  const expired = documents.filter((doc) => expiryState(doc.valid_until, NOW) === "expired");
  const amber = documents.filter((doc) => expiryState(doc.valid_until, NOW) === "expiringSoon");
  if (expired.length) return fail(`potekel: ${expired.map((doc) => doc.title).join(", ")}; zaženite npm run seed`);

  const daysLeft = (iso) => Math.round((Date.parse(`${iso.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`) - today) / 86400000);
  return pass(amber.map((doc) => `${doc.title}: še ${slDays(daysLeft(doc.valid_until))}`).join("; "));
});

await check("Demo", "Brez tujih vrstic v demo podjetjih", async () => {
  const problems = [];
  const orgList = STAGE_ORGS.join(",");

  const people = await rows(db.from("people").select("id, full_name").in("org_id", STAGE_ORGS), "people");
  for (const person of people) if (!isSeededId(person.id)) problems.push(`oseba ${person.full_name}`);

  const projects = await rows(
    db.from("projects").select("id, name, epc_org_id").or(`epc_org_id.in.(${orgList}),sub_org_id.in.(${orgList})`),
    "projects",
  );
  for (const project of projects) {
    if (!isSeededId(project.id)) problems.push(`projekt ${project.name}`);
    else if (!STAGE_ORGS.includes(project.epc_org_id)) problems.push(`projekt ${project.name} tujega naročnika`);
  }
  const stageProjects = projects
    .filter((project) => isSeededId(project.id) && STAGE_ORGS.includes(project.epc_org_id))
    .map((project) => project.id);

  for (const [table, label, columns] of [
    ["purchase_orders", "naročilnice", "id"],
    ["hour_sheets", "listi ur", "id"],
    ["change_orders", "dodatna dela", "id"],
    ["project_tokens", "povezave", "id, label"],
    ["material_items", "postavke materiala", "id"],
    ["scope_items", "postavke napredka", "id"],
    ["daily_entries", "dnevni vnosi", "id"],
    ["material_checks", "prevzemi materiala", "id"],
  ]) {
    const list = await rows(db.from(table).select(columns).in("project_id", stageProjects), table);
    // The app itself creates one crew link per project, labelled "crew", the
    // first time the subcontractor's office opens it (ensureCrewLink in
    // lib/data/invites.ts). That is the product working, not debris.
    const strangers = list.filter((row) => !isSeededId(row.id) && row.label !== "crew");
    if (strangers.length) problems.push(`${label}: ${strangers.length}`);
  }

  const imports = await rows(
    db.from("plan_imports").select("id").in("created_by_person", people.map((person) => person.id)),
    "plan_imports",
  );
  if (imports.length) problems.push(`uvozi načrta: ${imports.length} (LF9)`);

  if (seedMark !== null) {
    const cutoff = new Date(seedMark + SEED_WINDOW_MS).toISOString();
    const late = async (table, column, ids, label, narrow = (query) => query) => {
      const list = await rows(narrow(db.from(table).select("id").in(column, ids).gt("created_at", cutoff)), table);
      if (list.length) problems.push(`${label} po seedu: ${list.length}`);
    };
    await late("incidents", "project_id", stageProjects, "zapleti");
    await late("requests", "project_id", stageProjects, "zahteve");
    await late("documents", "org_id", STAGE_ORGS, "dokumenti v trezorju");
    await late("activity", "project_id", stageProjects, "dogodki", (query) =>
      query.not("kind", "in", `(${AUTOMATIC_EVENTS.join(",")})`),
    );
  }

  return problems.length
    ? fail(`${problems.slice(0, 8).join("; ")}; zaženite npm run seed`)
    : pass(`osebe: ${people.length}, projekti: ${projects.length}, vse iz seeda`);
});

await check("Vrata", "Demo Door odpre, napačen ključ ne", async () => {
  if (KEY.length < 32) return fail("DEMO_DOOR_KEY manjka v .env.local ali je krajši od 32 znakov (Task 0.4)");
  const until = process.env.DEMO_DOOR_UNTIL?.trim();
  if (!until || until <= TODAY) return fail(`DEMO_DOOR_UNTIL ${until ?? "manjka"}: vrata so zaprta`);
  const good = await get(`${BASE}/sl/demo/${encodeURIComponent(KEY)}`);
  const wrongKey = `${KEY.slice(0, -1)}${KEY.endsWith("x") ? "y" : "x"}`;
  const bad = await get(`${BASE}/sl/demo/${encodeURIComponent(wrongKey)}`);
  if (good.status !== 200) return fail(`pravi ključ vrne ${good.status} (je ključ na Vercelu enak kot v .env.local?)`);
  if (bad.status !== 404) return fail(`napačen ključ vrne ${bad.status}, pričakovano 404`);
  const noindex = /<meta[^>]+name="robots"[^>]+noindex/i.test(good.text);
  return noindex ? pass(`odprta do ${until}, ${good.ms} ms; napačen ključ 404`) : warn("odprta, a stran nima noindex");
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Warm-up, as each persona, through the door
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function visit(page, path) {
  const started = performance.now();
  const response = await page.goto(`${BASE}${path}`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 45000 });
  const ms = Math.round(performance.now() - started);
  const ttfb = await page
    .evaluate(() => {
      const nav = performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0];
      return nav ? Math.round(nav.responseStart - nav.requestStart) : null;
    })
    .catch(() => null);
  return { status: response?.status() ?? 0, ms, ttfb, url: page.url() };
}

async function settled(page) {
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle", { timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
}

// Task 1.4: under /app a notFound() after the streamed skeleton arrives as HTTP
// 200 plus the not-found screen, so that screen's own title is the proof.
// errors.notFoundTitle is "Te strani ni" (Task 1.4). Never project.notFoundTitle
// ("Povezava ni veljavna"), which is treated as an error page on 200 routes.
async function looksNotFound(page) {
  const body = await page.locator("body").innerText().catch(() => "");
  return Boolean(sl.errors?.notFoundTitle) && body.includes(sl.errors.notFoundTitle);
}

async function warmRoute(page, persona, label, path, expected) {
  const name = `${PERSONA_LABEL[persona]}: ${label}`;
  try {
    const cold = await visit(page, path);
    const warm = await visit(page, path);
    // The same streaming makes a session redirect to /login client-side, after
    // domcontentloaded: read the URL only once the page has settled.
    await settled(page);
    if (new URL(page.url()).pathname.includes("/login")) {
      return record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", "preusmeri na prijavo, seja ne velja");
    }
    if (expected === 404) {
      if (warm.status !== 404 && !(await looksNotFound(page))) {
        return record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", `${warm.status} brez strani »${sl.errors?.notFoundTitle ?? "ni najdeno"}«, pričakovano 404`);
      }
    } else if (warm.status !== expected) {
      return record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", `${warm.status}, pričakovano ${expected}`);
    }
    if (expected === 200) {
      const body = await page.locator("body").innerText().catch(() => "");
      if (/Povezava ni veljavna|Application error/i.test(body)) {
        return record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", "stran kaže napako");
      }
    }
    // Measured on the element that carries the problem: a page wider than the
    // viewport is the sideways drift a buyer's thumb finds first.
    const overflow = await page
      .evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth)
      .catch(() => 0);
    if (SHOTS) {
      const file = `${persona}-${label}`
        .normalize("NFD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, "-")
        .toLowerCase();
      await page.screenshot({ path: join(SHOTS, `${file}.png`) });
    }
    const detail = `${warm.status}; hladno ${cold.ms} ms, toplo ${warm.ms} ms (TTFB ${warm.ttfb ?? "?"} ms)${overflow > 1 ? `; vodoravni drsnik ${overflow} px` : ""}`;
    record("Ogrevanje", name, warm.ms > 3000 || overflow > 1 ? "WARN" : "PASS", detail);
  } catch (error) {
    record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", firstLine(error));
  }
}

async function warmPdf(context, persona, label, path) {
  const name = `${PERSONA_LABEL[persona]}: PDF ${label}`;
  try {
    const times = [];
    let last = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      const started = performance.now();
      last = await context.request.get(`${BASE}${path}`, { timeout: 60000 });
      times.push(Math.round(performance.now() - started));
    }
    const type = last.headers()["content-type"] ?? "";
    if (last.status() !== 200 || !type.includes("pdf")) {
      return record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", `${last.status()} ${type}`);
    }
    const size = Math.round((await last.body()).length / 1024);
    record("Ogrevanje", name, times[1] > 8000 ? "WARN" : "PASS", `hladno ${times[0]} ms, toplo ${times[1]} ms, ${size} KB`);
  } catch (error) {
    record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", firstLine(error));
  }
}

async function warmReport(page) {
  const name = `${PERSONA_LABEL.epc}: zaključno poročilo (--warm-report)`;
  try {
    await page.goto(`${BASE}/sl/app/${IDS.project}/final`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 45000 });
    const link = page.getByRole("link", { name: LABEL_DOWNLOAD });
    const before = (await link.count()) ? await link.first().getAttribute("href") : null;
    const started = performance.now();
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: LABEL_GENERATE }).first().click();
    await page.waitForFunction(
      ({ label, previous }) => {
        const anchor = [...document.querySelectorAll("a")].find((el) => el.textContent?.trim() === label);
        return Boolean(anchor && anchor.getAttribute("href") !== previous);
      },
      { label: LABEL_DOWNLOAD, previous: before },
      { timeout: 120000 },
    );
    const built = Math.round(performance.now() - started);
    const href = await link.first().getAttribute("href");
    const fetched = performance.now();
    const pdf = await page.context().request.get(`${BASE}${href}`, { timeout: 60000 });
    const ok = pdf.status() === 200 && (pdf.headers()["content-type"] ?? "").includes("pdf");
    const detail = `ustvarjeno v ${built} ms, prenos ${Math.round(performance.now() - fetched)} ms, ${Math.round((await pdf.body()).length / 1024)} KB`;
    record("Ogrevanje", name, ok ? (built > 15000 ? "WARN" : "PASS") : "FAIL", ok ? detail : `${pdf.status()}; ${detail}`);
  } catch (error) {
    record("Ogrevanje", name, "FAIL", firstLine(error));
  }
}

if (!has("no-warm")) {
  let browser = null;
  try {
    browser = await launchBrowser();
  } catch (error) {
    record("Ogrevanje", "Brskalnik", "FAIL", firstLine(error));
  }
  if (browser) {
    try {
      for (const persona of ["epc", "sub", "crew"]) {
        let context;
        try {
          context = await enterAs(browser, { base: BASE, key: KEY, persona });
          record("Ogrevanje", `${PERSONA_LABEL[persona]}: vstop skozi vrata`, "PASS", "seja odprta");
        } catch (error) {
          record("Ogrevanje", `${PERSONA_LABEL[persona]}: vstop skozi vrata`, "FAIL", firstLine(error));
          continue;
        }
        const page = await context.newPage();
        for (const [label, path] of ROUTES[persona]) await warmRoute(page, persona, label, path, 200);
        for (const [label, path] of MUST_NOT_SEE[persona] ?? []) await warmRoute(page, persona, label, path, 404);
        for (const [label, path] of PDF_ROUTES[persona] ?? []) await warmPdf(context, persona, label, path);
        if (persona === "epc" && has("warm-report")) await warmReport(page);
        await context.close();
      }
    } finally {
      await browser.close();
    }
  }
} else {
  record("Ogrevanje", "Ogrevanje izpuščeno (--no-warm)", "WARN", "pred sestankom zaženite brez --no-warm");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The screen
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const COLOR = { PASS: "\x1b[32m", WARN: "\x1b[33m", FAIL: "\x1b[31m" };
const RESET = "\x1b[0m";
const width = Math.min(58, Math.max(...results.map((row) => row.name.length)));
let group = "";
for (const row of results) {
  if (row.group !== group) {
    group = row.group;
    console.log(`\n${group.toUpperCase()}`);
  }
  console.log(`  ${COLOR[row.status]}${row.status.padEnd(4)}${RESET}  ${row.name.padEnd(width)}  ${row.detail}`);
}

const fails = results.filter((row) => row.status === "FAIL").length;
const warns = results.filter((row) => row.status === "WARN").length;
console.log("");
console.log(
  fails
    ? `${COLOR.FAIL}RDEČE: ${fails} od ${results.length}. Ne kažite, dokler ni zeleno.${RESET}`
    : `${COLOR.PASS}VSE ZELENO (${results.length}).${RESET}${warns ? ` ${COLOR.WARN}Opozoril: ${warns}.${RESET}` : ""}`,
);

const out = option("out", "");
if (out) {
  const lines = [
    `# Preflight ${TODAY} ${NOW.toLocaleTimeString("sl-SI")}`,
    "",
    `Osnova: ${BASE}`,
    "",
    "| Skupina | Preverba | Izid | Podrobnosti |",
    "|---|---|---|---|",
    ...results.map((row) => `| ${row.group} | ${row.name} | ${row.status} | ${row.detail.replace(/\|/g, "/")} |`),
    "",
  ];
  writeFileSync(out, lines.join("\n"), "utf8");
  console.log(`Zapisano: ${out}`);
}

process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
````

- »Zaključno poročilo: vsak dan svoja stran, vreme, fotografije, količine, potem ure, dodatna dela in zapleti. In tukaj je današnji dan, z vašo fotografijo mize od pred desetimi minutami. Tega ni nihče tipkal.«
- **Če ne gre:** nalaganje traja. Govorite o naslovnici. Po 30 sekundah: poročilo, ustvarjeno ob 15:45 (pred sestankom, `preflight-ogrej.cmd`), ali natisnjena kopija z mize.

**7c, zapisnik o prevzemu (27:00).** Naročnik: Začni prevzem. Končni prevzem. Prisotni: kupčevo ime in vaše ime. Dodaj pomanjkljivost: »Manjka oznaka na razdelilniku R2«, rok čez 14 dni, Usklajeno. Izjava o prevzemu: **Prevzeto s pridržki**. Obkljukajte »Pridržim si pravico do pogodbene kazni«. Podpis naročnika: obrnite prenosnik h kupcu, »Vi podpišete kot naročnik«, vpiše svoje ime. Kliknite »Potrdi podpis« in počakajte na »Podpis je shranjen.« Podpis podizvajalca: podpišete vi, vpišete svoje ime in priimek. Kliknite »Potrdi podpis« in počakajte na »Podpis je shranjen.« Ko sta shranjena oba podpisa, kliknite Podpiši in zaključi prevzem. Prenesi zapisnik.
- **Kaj kupec vidi:** svoj podpis na zaslonu, nato v PDF zapisniku z vašim, pomanjkljivost z rokom in stavek o pridržku.
- »Zapisnik o prevzemu, z obema podpisoma, s pomanjkljivostjo in rokom za odpravo. Pridržek pogodbene kazni je izpisan dobesedno. To je stavek, ki vam ohrani pravico: brez njega ob prevzemu pravica do pogodbene kazni zaradi zamude ugasne. In prav ta stavek se v zapisniku po spominu najprej izgubi.« (FACT, 251. člen OZ, glejte kartico 11.)
- **Če ne gre:** podpis se ne shrani ali PDF ne nastane. Pokažite natisnjeni zapisnik z mize: »To je isti dokument z današnje vaje.«

**7d, račun (30:00).** Okno »Belin podizvajalec«, **Podizvajalec**: Trenutno, Račun, Ustvari račun, Prenesi račun.
- »Račun se sestavi sam: sprejeta naročilnica, potrjene ure in potrjeno dodatno delo. Ker gre za gradbene storitve med podjetjema, ki sta v Sloveniji identificirani za DDV, velja obrnjena davčna obveznost po 76.a členu ZDDV-1, zato vrstice DDV ni.«
- »Nihče ni ničesar tipkal. Vse so podatki s strehe.«
- **Kaj kupec vidi:** račun AVESOL z naslovoma obeh podjetij, obdobjem storitve, rokom plačila, sklicem na naročilnico, urami in dodatnim delom ter stavkom o obrnjeni davčni obveznosti.
- **Če ne gre:** natisnjeni račun z mize.

### 8. Ponudba (32:00 do 35:00)

- **Naprava in oseba:** brez zaslona. Zaprite prenosnik do polovice.
- **Kaj rečete:**
  »Predlog je preprost. En vaš resnični projekt, brezplačno, do podpisanega zapisnika o prevzemu. Ne štirinajst dni, ker streha traja tedne. Vaši podizvajalci ne plačajo nikoli. Vsakega vašega podizvajalca uvedem jaz, po telefonu.«
  »Po pilotu mesečni pavšal na podjetje, ki ga dogovoriva po prvem projektu, ko oba veva, koliko vam prihrani.«
  »In če želite, na ta projekt pridemo tudi z AVESOL-om kot montažna ekipa. To ni pogoj: Belin deluje s komerkoli od vaših podizvajalcev.«
- **Kaj kupec vidi:** vas. Če vpraša po pogojih, mu pokažite natisnjeni pilotni dogovor.
- **Raven:** J. Ponudba »do prevzema« namesto 14 ali 30 dni je presoja iz recon/market-benchmark (vzorec preizkusov pri Capmo, PlanRadar, Craftnote), ne preverjeno dejstvo o tem kupcu.

### 9. Zaključek: registracija in datum (35:00 do 40:00)

- **Naprava in oseba:** **kupčev telefon**, nato natisnjeni pilotni dogovor (Task 9.5, dva izvoda; Task 8.2 na zaslonu danes ne gre v produkcijo).
- **Kaj naredite:** kupec na svojem telefonu odpre getbelin.com/sl/registracija. Vpiše davčno številko, VIES izpolni ime in naslov podjetja. Vpiše e-pošto, odda, odpre potrditveno pošto, potrdi. Je v svojem praznem Belinu.
- **Kaj rečete:**
  »Imate telefon pri roki? Odprite getbelin.com, registracija. Vpišite davčno številko podjetja.«
  Ko se podjetje izpolni: »Ime in naslov sta iz evropskega sistema VIES, ne tipkate jih.«
  Ko je notri: »To je vaš Belin. Prazen, vaš, nihče drug ga ne vidi.«
  Pilotni dogovor: »Kateri projekt in kateri dan začnemo?« Vpišite projekt in datum začetka, podpišeta oba.
  Zadnji stavek, z datumom: »Pokličem vas v četrtek ob devetih, da skupaj vneseva projekt in povabiva vašega podizvajalca.« (Če se dogovorita drugače, velja dogovorjeno. Brez datuma ne vstanite: J, no-brainer ideja 42.)
- **Kaj kupec vidi:** svoje podjetje, ki se izpolni samo, potrditveno pošto na svojem telefonu, nato svoj prazen Belin; na koncu dogovor s projektom in datumom.
- **Če ne gre:**
  VIES ne izpolni podjetja: »Sistem VIES je trenutno počasen, vpišite ga ročno, deluje enako.«
  Potrditvena pošta ne pride v 60 sekundah: »Poglejte v vsiljeno pošto.« Če je ni: »Povezavo vam pošljem še danes.« Registracijo naredita skupaj po telefonu.
  Stran za registracijo pokaže ekipo namesto obrazca (gostujoča seja iz točke 4): na njegovem telefonu Odjava, nato znova getbelin.com/sl/registracija.
  Pilotnega dogovora ni v aplikaciji: natisnjeni dogovor, dva izvoda, podpis na papirju.

## Lestev rezervnih rešitev

1. **Zaslon se ne premakne:** tri sekunde, znova kliknite zavihek, ne osvežujte. »Shranjeno je, zaslon se ujame.«
2. **Omrežje v prostoru:** prenosnik na osebno dostopno točko iPhona (ime na plonk listku).
3. **Napaka po objavi:** Vercel, belin-app, Deployments, objava s plonk listka, meni, Instant Rollback. Na načrtu Hobby gre povrnitev samo na neposredno prejšnjo produkcijsko objavo (FACT, vercel.com/docs/deployments/rollback-production-deployment, dostop 2026-10-05), zato po zamrznitvi ni nobene objave razen odobrenih popravkov.
4. **Baza ali platforma ne dela:** mapa BELIN OFFLINE. »Platforma ima danes slab dan, zato vam pokažem posnetek istega postopka in dokumente, ki jih je naredila danes popoldne.« Video, nato natisnjeni dokumenti, nato brošura. Ponudba in zaključek (točki 8 in 9) gresta enako, registracija pa po telefonu še isti dan.

## Kartice z ugovori

Vsak odgovor povejte s svojimi besedami, a ne obljubite več, kot piše tukaj.

**1. »Koliko to stane?«**
»Pilot je brezplačen: en vaš resnični projekt, do podpisanega zapisnika o prevzemu. Podizvajalci ne plačajo nikoli. Po pilotu mesečni pavšal na podjetje, ki ga dogovoriva po prvem projektu. Cene vam danes ne povem na pamet, ker jo hočem vezati na to, kar vam prvi projekt prihrani.«
Raven: **J**. Baza docs/gtm nima datoteke o ceni. Za vašo glavo, ne za mizo: PlanRadar 26, 89 in 129 EUR na uporabnika na mesec, Craftnote 14,90 do 49,90 EUR na uporabnika na mesec (FACT, recon/market-benchmark, dostop 2026-10-05). Če ste v Task 0.6 h dali drug stavek, velja vaš.

**2. »Vi ste montažer. Zakaj bi vam dal svoje podatke?«**
»Pošteno vprašanje, zato sem ga postavil sam. Vsako podjetje v Belinu vidi samo projekte, na katerih je stranka; to ste videli pri Velenju. Tega ne preverja zaslon, ampak strežnik ob vsakem odprtju. Kot ponudnik Belina imamo tehnični dostop do baze, kot vsak ponudnik programske opreme v oblaku. Uporabljamo ga samo za delovanje, varnost in podporo, pogodbo o obdelavi osebnih podatkov pa podpiševa pred začetkom pilota. V pilotni dogovor zapišem, da AVESOL podatkov iz Belina ne uporablja za svoje ponudbe.«
Raven: **FACT** za ločitev (app/[locale]/app/[projectId]/page.tsx: kdor ni stranka na projektu, dobi »ne obstaja«; npm run preflight preverja, da Podizvajalec za Velenje dobi 404; test Task 8.1). **J** za strategijo »povej prvi« (docs/gtm/knowledge/founder-groundtruth.md, razdelek 6) in za zavezo v dogovoru, ki jo potrdite pred sestankom.

**3. »Moji podizvajalci tega ne bodo uporabljali.«**
»Za njih je brezplačno, brez aplikacije iz trgovine in brez gesla. Poročilo je trideset sekund z eno roko, kot ste ga pravkar oddali sami. Vsakega vašega podizvajalca uvedem jaz, po telefonu. Če po dveh tednih kdo ne poroča, mi povejte in ga pokličem še isti dan.«
Raven: **PATTERN** (podizvajalci so brezplačni pri PlanRadar, Capmo, conova24, NachweisHub, recon/market-benchmark, dostop 2026-10-05: to je pričakovano, ne prednost). **J** za uvedbo po telefonu (Task 0.6 j) in za »trideset sekund« na tujem telefonu, dokler ga ne izmerimo.

**4. »Imamo Excel in WhatsApp. Deluje.«**
»Deluje, dokler se ne začne obračun. WhatsApp nima roka za potrditev ur, nima podpisa na prevzemu in ne sestavi računa. Belin ne zamenja klepeta, zamenja iskanje dokazil. Fotografija v skupini čez tri mesece ne pove, kateri dan, kateri projekt in kdo je kaj potrdil.«
Raven: **J** in **PATTERN** (lib/pdf/brochure-copy.ts, problem 3; docs/gtm/knowledge/market-icp-si.md, razdelek 2).

**5. »Kaj, če vas čez leto dni ni več?«**
»Vsak dokument, ki ga Belin ustvari, je PDF, ki ga prenesete in ostane vaš: poročila, zapisniki, računi. Podatki so v Evropski uniji, v Frankfurtu. Izvoza celotnega projekta v enem paketu danes še ni; v pilotni dogovor zapišem, da ga dobite ob koncu pilota ali kadarkoli na zahtevo.«
Raven: **FACT** za Frankfurt (baza Supabase v regiji eu-central-1, Supabase konektor get_project, 2026-10-05; funkcije v fra1, Frankfurt, vercel.com/docs/regions, dostop 2026-10-05, po Task 1.2). **FACT** da izvoza ni (recon no-brainer-ideas, ideja 27 ni narejena). **J** za zavezo.

**6. »Kaj pa GDPR?«**
»Za podatke vašega projekta ste upravljavec vi, ponudnik Belina je obdelovalec. Baza in datoteke so pri Supabase v Frankfurtu, aplikacija teče na Vercelu v Frankfurtu, e-pošto pošilja Resend s strežnikov na Irskem. Supabase ima od aprila 2026 certifikat ISO 27001. Pogodbo o obdelavi osebnih podatkov podpiševa pred začetkom pilota.«
Raven: **FACT**: getbelin.com/sl/zasebnost (Task 4.8, lib/legal-copy.ts); Supabase ISO/IEC 27001:2022 od 22. 4. 2026 (supabase.com/blog/supabase-is-now-iso-27001-certified, dostop 2026-10-05); fra1 je Frankfurt (vercel.com/docs/regions, dostop 2026-10-05); pošiljanje prek eu-west-1 (DNS zapis MX za send.getbelin.com kaže na feedback-smtp.eu-west-1.amazonses.com, recon 2026-10-05). **J**: pogodba o obdelavi za kupca še ne obstaja kot dokument; to je vaša zaveza.

**7. »Kaj, če na strehi ni signala?«**
»Belin za oddajo potrebuje povezavo. Stran je lahka, vendar brez signala poročila ne odda, dokler ekipa ni spet v dosegu. Dela brez povezave vam danes ne obljubljam.«
Samo če je Task 8.3 narejen in preizkušen na vaji, dodajte: »Osnutek se ne izgubi: ko je signal nazaj, ga ekipa odda.«
Raven: **FACT** (v repozitoriju ni service workerja ne čakalne vrste brez povezave, recon 2026-10-05; odločitev D12).

**8. »Od leta 2028 morajo biti računi e-računi.«**
»Drži. Od 1. 1. 2028 morajo biti vsi računi med slovenskimi podjetji strukturirani e-računi, PDF ne bo več dovolj. Belin danes račun sestavi iz potrjenih podatkov, kar je težji del. Izvoza v e-SLOG še ni. Narediti ga moramo pred letom 2028 in ga ne bom prodajal, dokler ga ni.«
Raven: **FACT** (ZIERDED; BDO, 2. 1. 2026, bdo.global, »slovenia-e-invoicing-to-be-mandatory-for-b2b-transactions-starting-in-2028«; OZS, »sprejet zakon o izmenjavi elektronskih računov«; oba dostop 2026-10-05). **J** za časovnico izvoza.

**9. »Ne uporabljamo K2.«**
»Belin danes sam prebere poročila iz K2 Base. Brez K2 projekt vnesete na istem zaslonu ročno, v nekaj minutah: naslov, moč, moduli, material. Pošljite mi en načrt iz programa, ki ga uporabljate, in pogledam, ali ga lahko beremo enako.«
Raven: **FACT** za branje K2 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-07-20). **FACT** za ročni vnos samo, če je Task 4.5 narejen (na vaji preverite gumb »Brez načrta?«); če ni: »Danes Belin potrebuje načrt v PDF; ročni vnos dodam pred vašim pilotom.« **J** za drug format.

**10. »Ali AVESOL vidi moje cene?«**
»AVESOL vidi samo naročilnice, ki ste jih poslali AVESOL-u, ker so to njegove pogodbe. Naročilnic in cen drugih podizvajalcev ne vidi; to ste videli pri Velenju. Velja tudi obratno: drug podizvajalec ne vidi cen AVESOL-a.«
Raven: **FACT** (app/[locale]/app/[projectId]/po/page.tsx: kdor ni stranka na projektu, dobi »ne obstaja«; npm run preflight preverja, da Podizvajalec za naročilnico Velenja dobi 404).

**11. »Zakaj je pridržek pogodbene kazni tako pomemben?«** (če vpraša pri točki 7c)
»Ker upnik, ki sprejme izpolnitev in ne sporoči takoj, da si pridržuje pravico do pogodbene kazni, te pravice zaradi zamude ne more več zahtevati. Zapisnik o prevzemu je ravno trenutek, ko to sporočite.«
Raven: **FACT** (251. člen Obligacijskega zakonika, zakonodaja.com/zakon/oz/251-clen-upnikove-pravice, uradno besedilo na pisrs.si, ZAKO1263; dostop 2026-10-05). Ni pravni nasvet; pri sporu odloča pogodba.

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `scripts/demo/cheat-sheet.mjs`.**

````js
// The one-page cheat sheet for the meeting, filled from the live demo.
//
// docs/demo/2026-10-06-cheat-sheet.html is the committed TEMPLATE. This fills
// it with the numbers the demo will actually show, draws the Demo Door as a QR
// code, and writes the printable copy into the offline folder on the desktop.
// The copy never enters the repository: it carries the door key.
//
// Read-only against the database. Refuses to write if any field is unfilled or
// if the printed page would run onto a second sheet.
//
//   npm run demo:cheatsheet -- --rollback dpl_XXXXXXXX
//   npm run demo:cheatsheet -- --rollback dpl_XXXXXXXX --hotspot "iPhone Jan"
//   npm run demo:cheatsheet -- --rollback dpl_XXXXXXXX --meeting "torek 6. 10. 2026 ob 16:00"

import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import QRCode from "qrcode";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { getDocumentProxy } from "unpdf";
import { expiryState } from "@/lib/vault-shared";
import { IDS, slDays, slPlural } from "../lib/demo-truth.mjs";
import { launchBrowser } from "../lib/door.mjs";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
function option(name, fallback) {
  const index = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  const value = index >= 0 ? args[index + 1] : undefined;
  return value && !value.startsWith("--") ? value : fallback;
}

const ROLLBACK = option("rollback", "");
if (!/^dpl_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(ROLLBACK)) {
  console.error("Manjka --rollback dpl_... (produkcijska objava ob zamrznitvi, iz Vercel konektorja list_deployments).");
  process.exit(1);
}
const HOTSPOT = option("hotspot", "iPhone");
const MEETING = option("meeting", "torek 6. 10. 2026 ob 16:00");
const BASE = (process.env.PREFLIGHT_BASE || "https://getbelin.com").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const KEY = process.env.DEMO_DOOR_KEY?.trim() ?? "";
const UNTIL = process.env.DEMO_DOOR_UNTIL?.trim() ?? "";
if (KEY.length < 32 || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(UNTIL)) {
  console.error("DEMO_DOOR_KEY ali DEMO_DOOR_UNTIL manjka v .env.local (Task 0.4).");
  process.exit(1);
}
const OFFLINE = process.env.BELIN_OFFLINE_DIR || join(homedir(), "Desktop", "BELIN OFFLINE");
const QA = process.env.QA_DIR || ".tmp-qa";
const TEMPLATE = new URL("../../docs/demo/2026-10-06-cheat-sheet.html", import.meta.url);

const db = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

async function one(query, label) {
  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw new Error(`${label}: ${error.message}`);
  return data;
}

const money = (value) =>
  `${new Intl.NumberFormat("sl-SI", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(value))} EUR`;
const decimal = (value) => new Intl.NumberFormat("sl-SI", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(Number(value));
const day = (iso) => {
  const [y, m, d] = String(iso).slice(0, 10).split("-");
  return `${d}. ${m}. ${y}`;
};
const escapeHtml = (text) =>
  String(text).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]);

const epc = await one(db.from("organizations").select("name").eq("id", IDS.epcOrg).single(), "naročnik");
const projects = await one(
  db.from("projects").select("id, name, kwp, module_count, status, sub_org_id").eq("epc_org_id", IDS.epcOrg),
  "projekti",
);
const current = projects.find((p) => p.id === IDS.project);
const start = projects.find((p) => p.id === IDS.projectStart);
const velenje = projects.find((p) => p.id === IDS.velenje);
if (!current || !start || !velenje) throw new Error("demo projekti manjkajo; zaženite npm run seed");
const velenjeSub = await one(db.from("organizations").select("name").eq("id", velenje.sub_org_id).single(), "Velenje");
const entries = await one(db.from("daily_entries").select("id").eq("project_id", IDS.project), "dnevnik");
const po = await one(
  db.from("purchase_orders").select("total_net, regie_hourly_rate").eq("id", IDS.poCurrent).single(),
  "naročilnica",
);
const sheets = await one(
  db.from("hour_sheets").select("id, status, deadline_at, hour_sheet_lines(hours)").eq("project_id", IDS.project),
  "listi ur",
);
const hoursOf = (sheet) => sheet.hour_sheet_lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + Number(line.hours), 0);
const approved = sheets.filter((s) => s.status === "approved" || s.status === "deemed_approved").reduce((n, s) => n + hoursOf(s), 0);
const open = sheets.find((s) => s.status === "submitted");
if (!open) throw new Error("ni odprtega lista ur; zaženite npm run seed");
const change = await one(db.from("change_orders").select("amount").eq("id", IDS.changeOrder).single(), "dodatno delo");
const vault = await one(db.from("documents").select("title, valid_until").eq("org_id", IDS.subOrg), "trezor");
const amber = vault.find((doc) => expiryState(doc.valid_until, new Date()) === "expiringSoon");
if (!amber) throw new Error("ni rumenega dokumenta; zaženite npm run seed");
const today = Date.parse(`${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);
const amberDays = Math.round((Date.parse(`${amber.valid_until}T00:00:00Z`) - today) / 86400000);
const portfolioKwp = projects.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.kwp ?? 0), 0);

const doorUrl = `${BASE}/sl/demo/${encodeURIComponent(KEY)}`;
const qr = await QRCode.toString(doorUrl, { type: "svg", margin: 1, errorCorrectionLevel: "M" });

const fields = {
  MEETING: escapeHtml(MEETING),
  BUYER: escapeHtml(process.env.DEMO_EPC_NAME?.trim() || `${epc.name} (izmišljeno ime)`),
  PROJECT_CURRENT: escapeHtml(current.name),
  PROJECT_START: escapeHtml(start.name),
  VELENJE: escapeHtml(velenje.name),
  VELENJE_SUB: escapeHtml(velenjeSub.name),
  DOOR_QR: qr,
  DOOR_URL: escapeHtml(doorUrl),
  DOOR_UNTIL: day(UNTIL),
  SIGNUP_URL: escapeHtml(`${BASE.replace(/^https:\/\//, "")}/sl/registracija`),
  KWP: decimal(current.kwp),
  MODULES: slPlural(current.module_count, ["modul", "modula", "moduli", "modulov"]),
  DAYS_LOGGED: slDays(entries.length),
  PO_TOTAL: money(po.total_net),
  RATE: `${money(po.regie_hourly_rate)} na uro`,
  HOURS: `potrjene ${decimal(approved)} h, čaka ${decimal(hoursOf(open))} h, rok ${day(open.deadline_at)}`,
  CO_AMOUNT: money(change.amount),
  AMBER: escapeHtml(`${amber.title}, še ${slDays(amberDays)}`),
  PORTFOLIO: `${slPlural(projects.length, ["projekt", "projekta", "projekti", "projektov"])}, ${decimal(portfolioKwp)} kWp`,
  ROLLBACK_ID: escapeHtml(ROLLBACK),
  HOTSPOT: escapeHtml(HOTSPOT),
  GENERATED: new Date().toLocaleString("sl-SI"),
};

let html = readFileSync(TEMPLATE, "utf8");
for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(fields)) html = html.replaceAll(`{{${name}}}`, value);
const leftover = html.match(/\{\{[A-Z_]+\}\}/g);
if (leftover) {
  console.error(`Neizpolnjena polja: ${[...new Set(leftover)].join(", ")}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
html = html.replace(/<!--\s*TEMPLATE[\s\S]*?-->/, "<!-- Izpolnjen plonk listek. Ne objavljajte: QR odpre predstavitvena vrata. -->");

mkdirSync(OFFLINE, { recursive: true });
const htmlPath = join(OFFLINE, "plonk-listek.html");
const pdfPath = join(OFFLINE, "plonk-listek.pdf");
writeFileSync(htmlPath, html, "utf8");

// The print check: the same Chromium print path the founder will use.
const browser = await launchBrowser();
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  await page.goto(`file:///${htmlPath.replace(/\\/g, "/")}`, { waitUntil: "load" });
  await page.pdf({ path: pdfPath, format: "A4", printBackground: true, preferCSSPageSize: true });
  mkdirSync(QA, { recursive: true });
  for (const [width, height] of [
    [1440, 900],
    [390, 844],
  ]) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height });
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(QA, `cheat-sheet-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
  }
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
const pages = (await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(pdfPath)))).numPages;
if (pages !== 1) {
  console.error(`Plonk listek ima ${pages} strani, mora imeti eno. Skrajšajte besedilo v predlogi.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log(`Plonk listek: ${htmlPath}`);
console.log(`Za tisk:      ${pdfPath} (1 stran A4)`);
console.log(`Pogled:       ${join(QA, "cheat-sheet-1440.png")}, ${join(QA, "cheat-sheet-390.png")}`);
````

````js
// The BELIN OFFLINE folder on the founder's desktop: everything the meeting
// needs if the network, the database or a deploy fails.
//
//   npm run demo:kit -- assemble
//       Copies the video, the brochure, the AVESOL photographs, the demo K2
//       plan, the run of show and the pilot agreement blank, and writes the
//       three double-click helpers. Touches nothing in the database.
//
//   npm run demo:kit -- pdfs --into dokumenti
//   npm run demo:kit -- pdfs --into sestanek-2026-10-06
//       Downloads the demo's documents as the persona that can open each one,
//       entering through the Demo Door, into that subfolder. Run it after the
//       dress rehearsal (dokumenti) and right after the meeting, BEFORE any
//       reseed (sestanek-2026-10-06), because the reseed deletes them.
//
// The folder lives outside the repository on purpose: it holds the filled
// cheat sheet with the door key, and documents carrying the buyer's name.

import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { IDS } from "../lib/demo-truth.mjs";
import { enterAs, launchBrowser } from "../lib/door.mjs";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
function option(name, fallback) {
  const index = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  const value = index >= 0 ? args[index + 1] : undefined;
  return value && !value.startsWith("--") ? value : fallback;
}

const OFFLINE = process.env.BELIN_OFFLINE_DIR || join(homedir(), "Desktop", "BELIN OFFLINE");
const BASE = (process.env.PREFLIGHT_BASE || "https://getbelin.com").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const REPO = process.cwd();
const command = args[0];

function kb(path) {
  return `${Math.round(statSync(path).size / 1024)} KB`;
}

function listFolder(folder, prefix = "") {
  for (const name of readdirSync(folder).sort()) {
    const path = join(folder, name);
    if (statSync(path).isDirectory()) {
      console.log(`${prefix}${name}\\`);
      listFolder(path, `${prefix}  `);
    } else {
      console.log(`${prefix}${name}  ${kb(path)}`);
    }
  }
}

// The opening two minutes, in the order they are shown: the finished plant
// first, then how it was built, then the people who built it.
const AVESOL_PHOTOS = [
  "anlage-weit.jpg",
  "dach-weit.jpg",
  "flug-1-unterkonstruktion.jpg",
  "flug-2-halbzeit.jpg",
  "flug-3-fertig.jpg",
  "crew-montage.jpg",
  "crew-module.jpg",
  "crew-arbeit.jpg",
  "unterkonstruktion.jpg",
  "dc-verkabelung.jpg",
  "crew-panel.jpg",
];

const README = `BELIN OFFLINE, sestanek torek 6. 10. 2026

Ta mapa je rezerva, če na sestanku odpove omrežje, baza ali objava.
Vse tukaj se odpre brez interneta.

avesol\\          fotografije za prvi dve minuti (odprite 01, nato puščica desno)
video\\           belin-demo.mp4 (ležeči), belin-demo-9x16.mp4 (pokončni)
brosura\\         belin-predstavitev-sl.pdf
dokumenti\\       dokumenti z vaje: naročilnica, režijske ure, poročilo, zapisnik, račun
k2\\              forum1.pdf za korak »Nov projekt« (Izberite datoteko, ne vlecite)
ponudba\\         pilotni dogovor za tisk, če ga ni v aplikaciji
scenarij-2026-10-06.md   potek sestanka (odprite z Beležnico)
plonk-listek.pdf         en list A4 za tisk (nastane z npm run demo:cheatsheet)

preflight.cmd        dvoklik: zeleno ali rdeče, ali je vse pripravljeno
preflight-ogrej.cmd  isto, in enkrat ustvari zaključno poročilo (T minus 15)
reseed.cmd           dvoklik: demo nazaj na začetek, nato preflight
                     POZOR: po reseedu vse naprave znova skozi vrata.

Po sestanku: dokumente prenesite PRED reseedom (glejte plonk listek).
`;

const CMD_PREFLIGHT = `@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
cd /d ${REPO}
call npm run preflight -- --out "${join(OFFLINE, "preflight-zadnji.md")}"
echo.
pause
`;

const CMD_WARM = `@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
cd /d ${REPO}
call npm run preflight -- --warm-report --out "${join(OFFLINE, "preflight-zadnji.md")}"
echo.
pause
`;

const CMD_RESEED = `@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
cd /d ${REPO}
call npm run seed
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo.
  echo SEED NI USPEL. Ne nadaljujte, javite se.
  pause
  exit /b 1
)
call npm run preflight -- --out "${join(OFFLINE, "preflight-zadnji.md")}"
echo.
echo Naprave znova skozi vrata: prenosnik dva profila, iPhone ikona.
pause
`;

async function assemble() {
  const sources = [
    ["assets/marketing/video/belin-demo.mp4", "video/belin-demo.mp4"],
    ["assets/marketing/video/belin-demo-9x16.mp4", "video/belin-demo-9x16.mp4"],
    ["assets/marketing/belin-predstavitev-sl.pdf", "brosura/belin-predstavitev-sl.pdf"],
    // The only K2 fixture that names no person and no company (w7 FACT, 2026-10-05).
    ["tests/fixtures/k2/forum1.pdf", "k2/forum1.pdf"],
    ["docs/demo/2026-10-06-run-of-show.md", "scenarij-2026-10-06.md"],
    ...AVESOL_PHOTOS.map((name, i) => [
      `assets/marketing/site/${name}`,
      `avesol/${String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${name}`,
    ]),
  ];
  const missing = sources.filter(([from]) => !existsSync(join(REPO, from))).map(([from]) => from);
  if (missing.length) {
    console.error(`Manjka v repozitoriju:\n  ${missing.join("\n  ")}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  for (const folder of ["avesol", "video", "brosura", "dokumenti", "k2", "ponudba"]) {
    mkdirSync(join(OFFLINE, folder), { recursive: true });
  }
  for (const [from, to] of sources) copyFileSync(join(REPO, from), join(OFFLINE, to));

  // The pilot agreement blank, printed from the same Chromium as the cheat sheet.
  const blank = join(REPO, "docs/demo/2026-10-06-pilotni-dogovor.html");
  if (existsSync(blank)) {
    const browser = await launchBrowser();
    try {
      const page = await browser.newPage();
      await page.goto(`file:///${blank.replace(/\\/g, "/")}`, { waitUntil: "load" });
      await page.pdf({
        path: join(OFFLINE, "ponudba", "pilotni-dogovor.pdf"),
        format: "A4",
        printBackground: true,
        preferCSSPageSize: true,
      });
    } finally {
      await browser.close();
    }
  }

  writeFileSync(join(OFFLINE, "00-PREBERI.txt"), README, "utf8");
  writeFileSync(join(OFFLINE, "preflight.cmd"), CMD_PREFLIGHT.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n"), "utf8");
  writeFileSync(join(OFFLINE, "preflight-ogrej.cmd"), CMD_WARM.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n"), "utf8");
  writeFileSync(join(OFFLINE, "reseed.cmd"), CMD_RESEED.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n"), "utf8");

  console.log(`${OFFLINE}\\`);
  listFolder(OFFLINE, "  ");
}

async function pdfs() {
  const into = option("into", "dokumenti");
  const target = join(OFFLINE, into);
  mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });

  const key = process.env.DEMO_DOOR_KEY?.trim() ?? "";
  const db = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  });
  const read = async (query, label) => {
    const { data, error } = await query;
    if (error) throw new Error(`${label}: ${error.message}`);
    return data ?? [];
  };

  const sheets = await read(
    db.from("hour_sheets").select("id, number").eq("project_id", IDS.project).order("number"),
    "listi ur",
  );
  const [report] = await read(
    db
      .from("generated_documents")
      .select("id")
      .eq("project_id", IDS.project)
      .eq("kind", "completion_report")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1),
    "poročilo",
  );
  const [acceptance] = await read(
    db
      .from("acceptances")
      .select("id")
      .eq("project_id", IDS.project)
      .eq("status", "signed")
      .order("conducted_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1),
    "prevzem",
  );
  const [invoice] = await read(
    db
      .from("invoices")
      .select("id")
      .eq("project_id", IDS.project)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1),
    "račun",
  );

  const wanted = [
    ["narocilnica-trenutno.pdf", `/api/pdf/po/${IDS.poCurrent}`],
    ["narocilnica-dan-1.pdf", `/api/pdf/po/${IDS.poStart}`],
    ...sheets.map((sheet) => [`rezijske-ure-list-${sheet.number}.pdf`, `/api/pdf/regie/${sheet.id}`]),
    ...(report ? [["zakljucno-porocilo.pdf", `/api/pdf/report/${report.id}`]] : []),
    ...(acceptance ? [["zapisnik-o-prevzemu.pdf", `/api/pdf/abnahme/${acceptance.id}`]] : []),
    ...(invoice ? [["racun.pdf", `/api/pdf/invoice/${invoice.id}`]] : []),
  ];

  const browser = await launchBrowser();
  const saved = [];
  const failed = [];
  try {
    // Some documents open for the client, some for the subcontractor; each is
    // tried as the client first and the subcontractor second.
    const contexts = [
      await enterAs(browser, { base: BASE, key, persona: "epc" }),
      await enterAs(browser, { base: BASE, key, persona: "sub" }),
    ];
    for (const [file, path] of wanted) {
      let done = false;
      for (const context of contexts) {
        const response = await context.request.get(`${BASE}${path}`, { timeout: 90000 });
        if (response.status() === 200 && (response.headers()["content-type"] ?? "").includes("pdf")) {
          writeFileSync(join(target, file), await response.body());
          saved.push(file);
          done = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!done) failed.push(`${file} (${path})`);
    }
    for (const context of contexts) await context.close();
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }

  // Routes this script does not know (Wave 6 adds some) are named, not skipped silently.
  const known = new Set(["po", "regie", "report", "abnahme", "invoice"]);
  const unknown = readdirSync(join(REPO, "app/api/pdf")).filter((name) => !known.has(name));

  console.log(`${target}\\`);
  for (const file of saved) console.log(`  ${file}  ${kb(join(target, file))}`);
  if (!report) console.log("  NI: zaključno poročilo še ni bilo ustvarjeno");
  if (!acceptance) console.log("  NI: podpisanega zapisnika o prevzemu");
  if (!invoice) console.log("  NI: računa");
  for (const line of failed) console.log(`  NI USPELO: ${line}`);
  for (const name of unknown) {
    console.log(`  NI ZBRANO: app/api/pdf/${name}; prenesite ga ročno z zaslona, kjer ga je dodal Wave 6`);
  }
  if (failed.length) process.exit(1);
}

try {
  if (command === "assemble") await assemble();
  else if (command === "pdfs") await pdfs();
  else {
    console.error("Uporaba: npm run demo:kit -- assemble | pdfs [--into dokumenti]");
    process.exit(1);
  }
} catch (error) {
  console.error(`NAPAKA: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message.split(/\r?\n/)[0] : String(error)}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
````

### Conflicts and debts found while planning Wave 9

1. **Siblings unwritten.** Waves 2, 4, 6 and 8 had no section yet; Wave 9 names each interface it needs in the table at the top. The two most likely to differ are the door's button hooks (one `data-persona` and `data-project` selector per persona in `scripts/lib/door.mjs` SPEC, checked in 9.1 Step 7; Task 2.3b's buttons are named after projects, so accessible names cannot tell personas apart) and `/api/health` lacking `commit` (9.1 Step 1 adds it, before the freeze).
2. **The freeze versus Wave 9.** The skeleton schedules Wave 9 after the 12:00 freeze, but 9.1 may need two fields in `/api/health` deployed. 9.1 and the 9.2 files are therefore built and pushed before 12:00; everything after 12:00 is scripts, docs and data, committed locally and pushed after the meeting.
3. **Server-side reset versus personalization.** If Task 2.3 built a reset button that runs on Vercel, pressing it on the meeting day undoes `DEMO_EPC_NAME` (Vercel's env does not carry it). Wave 9 resets only from the laptop.
4. **The guest session versus signup.** If `/sl/registracija` redirects a signed-in guest to the app, beat 9 on the buyer's own phone breaks. Checked in the rehearsal (9.4 Step 7), with a fallback line in beat 9; the fix belongs to Task 4.3.
5. **The QR poster (Task 6.7) is a real crew link.** On the buyer's table it would invite exactly what D18 forbids; its code is covered (9.5 Step 3).
6. **The brochure contradicted D9, D12 and the Austrian finding**, beyond SG-11's one word. Fixed for Slovenian in 9.3a; the German brochure stays debt.
7. **Resend's key in `.env.local` may only send**, so the preflight cannot read the domain status (planning run: 403 on `/domains`). The DKIM DNS check carries that line, and the executor confirms "verified" with the Resend connector.
8. **The app writes on page view:** the first dashboard visit after a seed creates `document_expiring` activity and the sub office's first visit creates a crew link labelled "crew". The stranger check exempts exactly those two, found by running it against production on 2026-10-05.

- [ADD]: icons, toasts, skeletons and one header; Slovenian number and date formats on every sl screen; the branded Slovenian 404; the Dodatno delo PDF; the naročilnica clause.
